import { campaignEventChart, seededEventSettings, campaignEventSettings } from './event-config.js';
import { campaignEnemyRows, pickEndlessEnemy } from './campaign-config.js';
import { enemyTypeStats } from './game-config.js';

/** Stable per-slot random stream: frame rate, kills and unrelated RNG cannot change event choices. */
function eventRandom(seed, index) {
 let state=(Number(seed)^Math.imul(index+1,0x9e3779b9))>>>0;
 return ()=>{state+=0x6d2b79f5;let t=state;t=Math.imul(t^(t>>>15),t|1);t^=t+Math.imul(t^(t>>>7),t|61);return ((t^(t>>>14))>>>0)/4294967296;};
}

/** Seeded event identity and bounded tuning; all regular/Mega variants cycle through the pool. */
export function generatedEvent(seed,index,internalSeconds) {
 const s=seededEventSettings,random=eventRandom(seed,index);
 const stage=internalSeconds<390?'first':internalSeconds<840?'second':internalSeconds<1080?'third':'fourth';
 const endless=pickEndlessEnemy(internalSeconds,()=>0);
 const available=endless ? [...new Set(Array.from({length:14},(_,i)=>pickEndlessEnemy(internalSeconds,()=>i/14).type))] :
  [...new Set(campaignEnemyRows.filter(r=>r.stage===stage&&r.kind==='regular'&&r.start<=internalSeconds&&internalSeconds<r.end).flatMap(r=>r.enemies))];
 const pool=available.length?available:campaignEnemyRows.filter(r=>r.stage===stage&&r.kind==='regular'&&r.start<=internalSeconds).at(-1)?.enemies||['mob'];
 const order=[...pool].sort((a,b)=>{
  const rank=name=>{let n=Number(seed)>>>0;for(const c of name)n=Math.imul(n^c.charCodeAt(0),16777619);return n>>>0;};
  return rank(a)-rank(b);
 });
 const enemy=order[index%order.length],pattern=s.patterns[Math.floor(random()*s.patterns.length)];
 const warning=['stampede','wave','fastball','ambush','airdrop','hordeRush'].includes(pattern);
 return {id:`seeded-${index}`,enemy,pattern,count:pattern==='cluster'?s.clusterCount:s.minCount+Math.floor(random()*(s.maxCount-s.minCount+1)),
  lifetimeSeconds:s.minLifetime+Math.floor(random()*(s.maxLifetime-s.minLifetime+1)),
  entrySide:Math.floor(random()*4),radius:220+Math.floor(random()*81),warningSeconds:warning?1:0,stats:'default',generated:true,timeSeconds:internalSeconds,
  ...(pattern==='hordeRush'?{repeatSeconds:2}:{}),
  nextInterval:s.minInterval+Math.floor(random()*(s.maxInterval-s.minInterval+1))};
}

/** Defaults come from the relevant campaign row, even outside that type's regular spawn window. */
export function eventEnemyProfile(event,type,internalSeconds,stage) {
 const endless=pickEndlessEnemy(internalSeconds,()=>0);
 const endlessProfile=endless && (type==='midori' ? (internalSeconds>=1800 ? pickEndlessEnemy(internalSeconds,()=>.999999)?.row : null) : endless.row);
 const matches=campaignEnemyRows.filter(row=>row.enemies.includes(type));
 const profile=matches.filter(row=>row.stage===stage&&row.start<=internalSeconds).at(-1)||
  matches.filter(row=>row.start<=internalSeconds).at(-1)||matches[0];
 const fallback=enemyTypeStats[type];
 const base=endlessProfile||profile||{hp:fallback?.baseHP||60,atk:fallback?.baseATK||1,spd:fallback?.baseSPD||.35,exp:fallback?.expValue||1,kind:'regular'};
 const stats=event.stats && typeof event.stats==='object'?event.stats:{};
 return {...base,id:event.id,enemies:[type],gate:false,freeze:false,
  hp:stats.hp??base.hp,atk:stats.atk??base.atk,spd:stats.spd??base.spd,exp:stats.exp??base.exp};
}

/** Internal time starts groups; active time controls firing cadence, lifetimes and generated events. */
export function createCampaignEvents({seed=0,getPoints,spawn,onEnd=()=>{},warn=()=>{},chart=campaignEventChart}) {
 let active=0,post17=0,nextGenerated=seededEventSettings.firstDelay,index=0;
 const groups=new Map(),prepared=new Map();
 const ended=new Set();
 const finish=group=>{if(ended.has(group.event.id))return;ended.add(group.event.id);onEnd(group.event.id);groups.delete(group.event.id);};
 function start(event,internalSeconds,stage,points=null,delay=0){
  if(ended.has(event.id)||groups.has(event.id))return;
  const actual={...event,groupId:event.id,runtimeManaged:true};
  groups.set(event.id,{event:actual,stage,started:active+delay,nextWave:0,waves:[],points,announced:false});
 }
 function runGroup(group,internalSeconds,stage,enabled){
  const e=group.event,age=active-group.started;
  if(e.lifetimeSeconds!=null&&age>=e.lifetimeSeconds){finish(group);return;}
  if(age<0){if(!group.announced){const points=group.points||getPoints(e);if(points){group.points=points;warn(e,points,group.started);group.announced=true;}}return;}
  const inWindow=e.endTimeSeconds==null||internalSeconds<=e.endTimeSeconds+1e-7;
  const stageActive=e.generated||group.stage===stage;
  if(enabled&&inWindow&&stageActive) {
   if(e.repeatSeconds){
    while(group.nextWave<=age+1e-7){group.waves.push({index:0,points:null,start:group.nextWave});group.nextWave+=e.repeatSeconds;}
   }else if(group.nextWave===0){group.waves.push({index:0,points:group.points,start:0});group.nextWave=Infinity;}
  }
  if(!inWindow||!stageActive){group.waves=[];if(e.lifetimeSeconds==null){ended.add(e.id);groups.delete(e.id);}return;}
  for(const wave of group.waves){
   if(!enabled)break;
   wave.points??=getPoints(e);
   if(!wave.points)continue;
   const due=e.spawnDuration?Math.min(e.count,1+Math.floor(Math.max(0,age-wave.start)/e.spawnDuration*e.count)):e.count;
   while(wave.index<due){
    const types=Array.isArray(e.enemy)?e.enemy:[e.enemy];
    const type=types[wave.index%types.length];
    const runtime={...e,stage:group.stage,internalSeconds,remainingLife:e.lifetimeSeconds==null?null:Math.max(0,e.lifetimeSeconds-age)};
    if(!spawn(runtime,{...wave.points[wave.index],enemyType:type}))break;
    wave.index++;
   }
  }
  group.waves=group.waves.filter(w=>w.index<e.count);
  if(!e.repeatSeconds&&!group.waves.length&&group.nextWave===Infinity&&e.lifetimeSeconds==null){ended.add(e.id);groups.delete(e.id);}
 }
 return {
  seek(seconds){
   for(const group of [...groups.values()])finish(group);
   groups.clear();prepared.clear();ended.clear();
   for(const event of chart)if(event.timeSeconds<seconds)ended.add(event.id);
  },
  get activeSeconds(){return active;},get activeGroups(){return groups.size;},get generatedSlots(){return index;},
  update(internalSeconds,delta,{stage,enabled=true}={}){
   active+=Math.max(0,delta);
   const allow=enabled&&campaignEventSettings.enabled;
   for(const event of chart){
    if(event.stage!==stage||ended.has(event.id)||groups.has(event.id))continue;
    if(event.endTimeSeconds!=null&&internalSeconds>event.endTimeSeconds+1e-7){ended.add(event.id);continue;}
    if(internalSeconds<event.timeSeconds-(event.warningSeconds||0))continue;
    if(!allow){if(internalSeconds>=event.timeSeconds)ended.add(event.id);continue;}
    if(internalSeconds<event.timeSeconds){
     if(!prepared.has(event.id)){const points=getPoints(event);if(points){prepared.set(event.id,points);warn(event,points,active+event.timeSeconds-internalSeconds);}}
     continue;
    }
    start(event,internalSeconds,stage,prepared.get(event.id)||null);prepared.delete(event.id);
   }
   if(internalSeconds>=seededEventSettings.startSeconds&&seededEventSettings.enabled){
    post17+=Math.max(0,delta);
    while(post17>=nextGenerated){
     const event=generatedEvent(seed,index++,internalSeconds);
     nextGenerated+=event.nextInterval;
     if(allow)start(event,internalSeconds,stage,null,event.warningSeconds);
    }
   }
   for(const group of [...groups.values()])runGroup(group,internalSeconds,stage,allow);
  }
 };
}

import {serveSettings,serveLevelStats,attackTimeFormula,weaponSizeMultiplier} from './game-config.js';
import {ensureCombatStats,totalWeaponDamage,rollAttackDamage} from './combat-stats.js';
import {stationaryWeaponIntervalScale,startingWeaponProjectileCount} from './tuning-parts.js';
import {getAllEnemies,getEnemy,damageEnemy} from './world-state.js';
import {getCombatHitbox,getEnemyHurtbox,segmentHitsBody} from './combat-hitboxes.js';
import {createEnemySpatialIndex} from './enemy-spatial-index.js';

/** Reflect inside the visible screen; the complete ball stays inside its edges. */
export function serveBounce(position,velocity,min,max){
 if(max<=min)return {position:(min+max)/2,velocity:0};
 while(position<min||position>max){if(position<min){position=2*min-position;velocity=Math.abs(velocity);}if(position>max){position=2*max-position;velocity=-Math.abs(velocity);}}
 return {position,velocity};
}
export function createServeAttack({random=Math.random}={}){
 const s=serveSettings;let owner=null,enabled=true,cooldown=0,time=0,balls=[],blasts=[],shots=0,burstCount=0,sprite=null,explosionSprite=null;
 const ballReady=typeof Image==='undefined'?Promise.resolve():new Promise(resolve=>{sprite=new Image();sprite.onload=resolve;sprite.onerror=()=>{sprite=null;resolve();};sprite.src=new URL('../sprites/attacks/Beach Ball.png',import.meta.url).href;});
 const explosionReady=typeof Image==='undefined'?Promise.resolve():new Promise(resolve=>{explosionSprite=new Image();explosionSprite.onload=resolve;explosionSprite.onerror=()=>{explosionSprite=null;resolve();};explosionSprite.src=new URL('../sprites/attacks/ExplosionSheet.png',import.meta.url).href;});
 const ready=Promise.all([ballReady,explosionReady]);
 function reset(){owner=null;cooldown=0;time=0;balls=[];blasts=[];shots=0;burstCount=0;}
 function launch(player,weapon){const stats=serveLevelStats(weapon.level),body=getCombatHitbox(player,false),size=weaponSizeMultiplier(player),count=startingWeaponProjectileCount(player,'serve',stats.count);
  for(let i=0;i<count;i++){const a=random()*Math.PI*2;balls.push({x:body.x,y:body.y,vx:Math.cos(a)*stats.speed,vy:Math.sin(a)*stats.speed,age:0,rotation:random()*Math.PI*2,radius:s.radius*stats.size*size,blastScale:stats.blastArea*size,count,damageBonuses:stats.damageBonuses,hitsLeft:stats.hitLimit,hits:new Map()});shots++;}
 }
 function cast(player,angle=0){const weapon=player.attackSlots?.find(w=>w?.id==='serve');if(!weapon)return false;if(owner!==player){reset();owner=player;}const stats=serveLevelStats(weapon.level),body=getCombatHitbox(player,false),size=weaponSizeMultiplier(player);balls.push({exSkill:true,exMain:true,duration:s.duration*3,normalSpeed:stats.speed,normalHitLimit:stats.hitLimit,x:body.x,y:body.y,vx:Math.cos(angle)*stats.speed*.8,vy:Math.sin(angle)*stats.speed*.8,age:0,rotation:angle,radius:s.radius*stats.size*size*2,blastScale:stats.blastArea*size,count:1,damageBonuses:stats.damageBonuses,hitsLeft:Infinity,hits:new Map()});shots++;return true;}
 function spawnSmallBall(b){const angle=random()*Math.PI*2,speed=b.normalSpeed;balls.push({exSkill:true,globalBlast:true,blastAngle:random()<.5?0:Math.PI/4,duration:s.duration,x:b.x,y:b.y,vx:Math.cos(angle)*speed,vy:Math.sin(angle)*speed,age:0,rotation:angle,radius:b.radius/2,blastScale:b.blastScale,count:b.count,damageBonuses:b.damageBonuses,hitsLeft:b.normalHitLimit,hits:new Map()});shots++;}
 function hit(player,b,enemy,multiplier=1){const damage=totalWeaponDamage(player,'serve',s.damage,b.damageBonuses,{projectileCount:b.count,hitCooldownFrames:s.hitCooldown*60})*multiplier,roll=rollAttackDamage(player,damage,random,{target:enemy,weaponId:'serve',skillAttack:Boolean(b.exSkill)});const accepted=damageEnemy(enemy.id,roll.damage,player,roll.type,{canMiss:true,weaponId:'serve',skillAttack:Boolean(b.exSkill)});if(accepted!==false&&b.exMain&&(enemy.hp<=0||!getEnemy(enemy.id)))spawnSmallBall(b);return accepted;}
 function explode(player,b,view){const effect={x:b.x,y:b.y,scale:b.blastScale,age:0,rotation:b.blastAngle??Math.PI/4};
  if(b.exSkill){effect.halfLength=Math.max(...[view.x,view.x+view.width].flatMap(x=>[view.y,view.y+view.height].map(y=>Math.hypot(x-b.x,y-b.y))))+b.radius*2;effect.thickness=b.radius*2;if(b.globalBlast)for(const enemy of getAllEnemies()){const body=getEnemyHurtbox(enemy);effect.halfLength=Math.max(effect.halfLength,Math.hypot(body.x-b.x,body.y-b.y)+Math.max(body.rx,body.ry)+effect.thickness);}}blasts.push(effect);burstCount++;
  const length=effect.halfLength??s.blastLength*effect.scale/2,width=(effect.thickness??s.blastWidth*effect.scale)/2;
  for(const enemy of getAllEnemies()){const body=getEnemyHurtbox(enemy);if(b.exSkill&&!b.globalBlast&&(body.x+body.rx<view.x||body.x-body.rx>view.x+view.width||body.y+body.ry<view.y||body.y-body.ry>view.y+view.height))continue;if([effect.rotation,effect.rotation+Math.PI/2].some(a=>segmentHitsBody({...body,rx:body.rx+width,ry:body.ry+width},b.x-Math.cos(a)*length,b.y-Math.sin(a)*length,b.x+Math.cos(a)*length,b.y+Math.sin(a)*length)))hit(player,b,enemy,s.explosionMultiplier);}
 }
 function update(delta,player,viewport){const weapon=player.attackSlots?.find(w=>w?.id==='serve');if(!weapon){reset();return;}if(owner!==player){reset();owner=player;}if(!(delta>0))return;
  const body=getCombatHitbox(player,false),view=viewport||{x:body.x-640,y:body.y-360,width:1280,height:720};let left=delta,index=null;
  while(left>1e-8){if(enabled&&cooldown<=1e-8){launch(player,weapon);cooldown=attackTimeFormula(serveLevelStats(weapon.level).interval*(player.tuningParts?stationaryWeaponIntervalScale(player):1),ensureCombatStats(player).hastePercent);}
   const dt=Math.min(left,1/120,enabled&&cooldown>1e-8?cooldown:1/120);left-=dt;time+=dt;cooldown=Math.max(0,cooldown-dt);
   for(let i=blasts.length-1;i>=0;i--){blasts[i].age+=dt;if(blasts[i].age>=s.blastDuration)blasts.splice(i,1);}
   if(!balls.length)continue;if(!index)index=createEnemySpatialIndex(getAllEnemies(),getEnemyHurtbox);
   for(let i=balls.length-1;i>=0;i--){const b=balls[i],from={x:b.x,y:b.y};b.age+=dt;b.rotation+=dt*5;
    const x=serveBounce(b.x+b.vx*dt,b.vx,view.x+b.radius,view.x+view.width-b.radius),y=serveBounce(b.y+b.vy*dt,b.vy,view.y+b.radius,view.y+view.height-b.radius);b.x=x.position;b.vx=x.velocity;b.y=y.position;b.vy=y.velocity;
    for(const enemy of index.querySegment(from,b,b.radius)){if(!getEnemy(enemy.id)||time-(b.hits.get(enemy.id)??-Infinity)<s.hitCooldown-1e-8)continue;const t=getEnemyHurtbox(enemy);if(!segmentHitsBody({...t,rx:t.rx+b.radius,ry:t.ry+b.radius},from.x,from.y,b.x,b.y))continue;b.hits.set(enemy.id,time);if(hit(player,b,enemy)===false)continue;if(--b.hitsLeft<=0)break;}
    if(b.hitsLeft<=0||b.age>=(b.duration??s.duration)-1e-8){explode(player,b,view);balls.splice(i,1);}
   }
  }
 }
 function draw(context,camera){
  for(const b of balls){context.save();context.translate(b.x-camera.x,b.y-camera.y);context.rotate(b.rotation);if(sprite?.complete&&sprite.naturalWidth)context.drawImage(sprite,63,36,180,182,-b.radius,-b.radius,b.radius*2,b.radius*2);else {context.fillStyle='#f5d981';context.beginPath();context.arc(0,0,b.radius,0,Math.PI*2);context.fill();}context.restore();}
  for(const e of blasts)drawServeExplosion(context,camera,explosionSprite,e);

 }
 return {getAuraSources(){return balls;},ready,cast,update,draw,reset,setAutoattackEnabled(value){enabled=Boolean(value);},get shotsFired(){return shots;},get projectileCount(){return balls.length;},get explosionCount(){return blasts.length;},get burstsFired(){return burstCount;}};
}

/** Seven columns: center 48px, horizontal arm 44px, terminal flame 42px. */
export function drawServeExplosion(context,camera,sheet,effect){
 if(!sheet?.complete||!sheet.naturalWidth||effect.age<0||effect.age>=serveSettings.blastDuration)return;
 const frame=Math.min(6,Math.floor(effect.age/serveSettings.blastDuration*7)),sx=frame*48;
 const halfLength=effect.halfLength??serveSettings.blastLength*effect.scale/2,thickness=effect.thickness??serveSettings.blastWidth*effect.scale;
 const tileScale=thickness/44,capWidth=48*tileScale,centerSize=48*tileScale;
 context.save();context.translate(effect.x-camera.x,effect.y-camera.y);context.imageSmoothingEnabled=false;
 // Four arms use the same frame and meet beneath one center tile.
 for(let i=0;i<4;i++){
  context.save();context.rotate((effect.rotation??Math.PI/4)+i*Math.PI/2);
  context.drawImage(sheet,sx,48,48,44,0,-thickness/2,Math.max(0,halfLength-capWidth/2),thickness);
  context.drawImage(sheet,sx,92,48,42,halfLength-capWidth,-42*tileScale/2,capWidth,42*tileScale);
  context.restore();
 }
 context.rotate(effect.rotation??Math.PI/4);
 context.drawImage(sheet,sx,0,48,48,-centerSize/2,-centerSize/2,centerSize,centerSize);
 context.restore();
}

}

--- SNAPSHOT FILE: Development/skill-accuracy.js | sha256=7dfeb9f7cfa8cf7de8703aadb84a5d9cf79e1f5480a667c53df674cd6de9789c | encoding=utf-8-sig ---
import { drawingBounds, normalizeSkillStrokes } from './skill-drawing.js';
import { skillCastSettings } from './game-config.js';

/** Canonical pattern matching the EX Skills reference diagram. */
export function planaReferenceStrokes() {
  return [Array.from({ length: 97 }, (_, i) => ({
    x: 100 + 86 * Math.cos(i / 96 * Math.PI * 2),
    y: 100 + 86 * Math.sin(i / 96 * Math.PI * 2)
  })), [{ x: 100, y: 94 }, { x: 100, y: 43 }],
  [{ x: 76, y: 67 }, { x: 100, y: 43 }, { x: 124, y: 67 }],
  [{ x: 75, y: 119 }, { x: 125, y: 160 }],
  [{ x: 125, y: 119 }, { x: 75, y: 160 }]];
}

/** Uniformly sample ink length, ignoring pen speed, stroke order and direction. */
function normalizedInk(strokes) {
  strokes = normalizeSkillStrokes(strokes);
  const bounds = drawingBounds(strokes);
  if (!bounds) return [];
  const size = Math.max(bounds.right - bounds.left, bounds.bottom - bounds.top, 1);
  const points = [];
  for (const stroke of strokes) for (let i = 1; i < stroke.length; i++) {
    const a = stroke[i - 1], b = stroke[i];
    const count = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(Math.hypot(b.x - a.x, b.y - a.y) / size * 180));
    for (let j = 0; j <= count; j++) points.push({
      x: (a.x + (b.x - a.x) * j / count - (bounds.left + bounds.right) / 2) / size,
      y: (a.y + (b.y - a.y) * j / count - (bounds.top + bounds.bottom) / 2) / size
    });
  }
  // Bound comparison work even for very long mouse strokes.
  const unique = [...new Map(points.map(p => [
    `${Math.round(p.x * 10000)},${Math.round(p.y * 10000)}`, p
  ])).values()].sort((a, b) => Math.round(a.x * 10000) - Math.round(b.x * 10000) ||
    Math.round(a.y * 10000) - Math.round(b.y * 10000));
  return unique.filter((_, i) => i % Math.max(1, Math.ceil(unique.length / 320)) === 0);
}

/** Symmetric ink distance rewards the entire reference, including missing/extra marks. */
export function drawingAccuracy(strokes, referenceStrokes = planaReferenceStrokes()) {
  const actual = normalizedInk(strokes), reference = normalizedInk(referenceStrokes);
  if (!actual.length) return 0;
  const nearestMean = (from, to) => from.reduce((total, p) => total +
    Math.min(...to.map(q => Math.hypot(p.x - q.x, p.y - q.y))), 0) / from.length;
  const error = (nearestMean(actual, reference) + nearestMean(reference, actual)) / 2;
  return Math.max(0, Math.min(1, 1 - error / skillCastSettings.accuracyDistanceTolerance));
}

/** Map successful reference accuracy to minimum/typical/perfect damage anchors. */
export function skillDamageMultiplier(accuracy) {
  const s = skillCastSettings;
  const value = Number.isFinite(accuracy) ? accuracy : s.accuracyAverage;
  const low = value <= s.accuracyAverage;
  const start = low ? s.accuracyMinimum : s.accuracyAverage;
  const end = low ? s.accuracyAverage : s.accuracyPerfect;
  const from = low ? s.damageMinimum : s.damageAverage;
  const to = low ? s.damageAverage : s.damageMaximum;
  return from + (to - from) * Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (value - start) / (end - start)));
}

--- SNAPSHOT FILE: Development/skill-cast-state.js | sha256=c37215db0f23e270142b9581bfd4b66df00fba280a06b5a8b20827420ec32009 | encoding=utf-8-sig ---
import { skillCastSettings } from './game-config.js';

/** List equipped weapon skills and an optional future ultimate, each with its own timer. */
export function equippedSkills(character) {
  const superWeapon=character.attackSlots?.find(w=>w?.id==='decagrammaton');
  if(superWeapon&&!character.ultimateSkill)character.ultimateSkill={id:'decagrammaton-ultimate',name:'Activate Protocol SUPERNOVA',icon:superWeapon.icon,exSkill:true,successCooldown:300};
  if(!superWeapon&&character.ultimateSkill?.id==='decagrammaton-ultimate')delete character.ultimateSkill;
  return [...(character.attackSlots || []), character.ultimateSkill].filter(skill => skill?.icon && skill.exSkill !== false);
}

/** Find availability only; this does not select or equip a weapon. */
export function readySkill(character) {
  return equippedSkills(character).find(skill => !(skill.skillCooldownRemaining > 0));
}

/** Put a cooldown on the exact weapon that initiated a cast, independently of other weapons. */
export function setSkillCooldown(weapon, seconds) {
  weapon.skillCooldownDuration = seconds;
  weapon.skillCooldownRemaining = seconds;
}

/** Tick each equipped weapon once; global pause freezes these timers in the game loop. */
export function advanceSkillCooldowns(characters, delta) {
  const visited = new Set();
  for (const character of characters) for (const weapon of equippedSkills(character)) {
    if (!weapon || visited.has(weapon)) continue;
    visited.add(weapon);
    weapon.skillCooldownRemaining = Math.max(0, (weapon.skillCooldownRemaining || 0) - Math.max(0, delta));
  }
}

/** Drawing-cast state machine; async recognition responses must match the current token. */
export function createSkillCastState(onSubmit = () => {}) {
  let phase = 'idle', owner = null, weapon = null;
  let elapsed = 0, idle = 0, drawing = false, inkLength = 0, token = 0;
  return {
    get phase() { return phase; }, get owner() { return owner; }, get weapon() { return weapon; },
    get token() { return token; }, get inkLength() { return inkLength; },
    get remaining() { return Math.max(0, skillCastSettings.drawingSeconds - elapsed); },
    begin(character, item, adminTest = false) {
      if (phase !== 'idle' || !item?.icon || (!adminTest && item.skillCooldownRemaining > 0)) return false;
      owner = character; weapon = item; elapsed = idle = inkLength = 0; drawing = false;
      phase = 'drawing'; token++;
      return true;
    },
    strokeStart() { if (phase === 'drawing') { drawing = true; idle = 0; } },
    addInk(length) { if (phase === 'drawing') { inkLength += Math.max(0, length); idle = 0; } },
    strokeEnd() { drawing = false; idle = 0; },
    update(delta) {
      if (phase !== 'drawing') return;
      const time = Math.max(0, delta);
      elapsed += time;
      if (!drawing && inkLength > 0) idle += time;
      if (elapsed >= skillCastSettings.drawingSeconds || idle >= skillCastSettings.idleSubmitSeconds) {
        if (inkLength <= skillCastSettings.minimumInkLength) { this.cancel('empty'); return; }
        phase = 'recognizing'; drawing = false;
        onSubmit({ token, owner, weapon });
      }
    },
    cancel(reason, target = weapon) {
      if (phase === 'idle') return false;
      const penalty = reason === 'pause' ? skillCastSettings.pauseCancelCooldown
        : reason === 'right' ? skillCastSettings.rightCancelCooldown
        : reason === 'empty' ? skillCastSettings.failureCooldown : 0;
      if (penalty && inkLength > 0 && target && equippedSkills(owner).includes(target) &&
          !(target.skillCooldownRemaining > 0)) setSkillCooldown(target, penalty);
      token++; phase = 'idle'; drawing = false;
      return true;
    },
    resolve(requestToken, result) {
      if (requestToken !== token || phase !== 'recognizing') return false;
      let valid = Boolean(result && result.valid !== false && typeof result.label === 'string' && result.label.length > 0 &&
        Number.isFinite(result.score) && result.score >= skillCastSettings.minimumConfidence);
      if (valid && result.weapon) {
        if (!equippedSkills(owner).includes(result.weapon) || (!result.adminTest && result.weapon.skillCooldownRemaining > 0)) valid = false;
        else weapon = result.weapon;
      }
      // Unknown/ambiguous/failed recognition is free; never penalize a guessed weapon.
      if (valid) setSkillCooldown(weapon, weapon.successCooldown??skillCastSettings.successCooldown);
      if (valid) {
        weapon.lastSkillDrawing = { label: result.label, score: result.score, skillId: result.skillId, components: result.components,
          accuracy: result.accuracy, damageMultiplier: result.damageMultiplier, clipPredictions: result.clipPredictions };
      }
      phase = 'idle'; token++;
      return Boolean(valid);
    }
  };
}

import { recognizeAdminDigit, adminSkillResult } from './admin-skills.js';
import { recognizeLoadoutPattern, closestDrawingSkill } from './skill-pattern-recognition.js';
import { skillCastSettings } from './game-config.js';
import { createSkillCastState, advanceSkillCooldowns, readySkill, equippedSkills, setSkillCooldown } from './skill-cast-state.js';
import { createDrawingRecognizer } from './drawing-recognizer.js';
import { drawSkillStrokes } from './skill-drawing.js';
import { pointerToCanvas } from './aiming.js';

/** Connect right-click casting, sketch input, recognition and per-weapon cooldowns. */
export function createSkillCasting({ canvas, aiming, getPlayer, getCharacters, isPaused,
  recognizer = createDrawingRecognizer(), getCastAngle = () => 0, onRecognized = () => {} }) {
  const overlay = document.querySelector('#skill-cast-overlay');
  const drawingCanvas = document.querySelector('#skill-drawing-canvas');
  const context = drawingCanvas.getContext('2d');
  const timer = document.querySelector('#skill-cast-timer');
  const bar = document.querySelector('#skill-cast-bar');
  const fill = document.querySelector('#skill-cast-fill');
  const status = document.querySelector('#skill-cast-status');
  const feedback = document.querySelector('#skill-feedback');
  let feedbackTimeout;

  /** Surface recognition/cancellation feedback without requiring the admin panel to be open. */
  function setStatus(text) {
    status.textContent = text;
    if (!feedback) return;
    feedback.textContent = text; feedback.hidden = false;
    clearTimeout(feedbackTimeout);
    feedbackTimeout = setTimeout(() => { feedback.hidden = true; }, 6000);
  }
  let strokes = [], activeStroke = null, pointerId = null;
  let adminNumbersForCast = false;
  const numberMode = () => Boolean(document.querySelector('#admin-number-casting')?.checked);
  let penCursor = 'crosshair';
  const penImage = new Image();
  penImage.onload = () => {
    // Native cursor artwork must be small; align its hotspot with the pen tip.
    const cursorCanvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    cursorCanvas.width = 48;
    cursorCanvas.height = Math.round(48 * penImage.naturalHeight / penImage.naturalWidth);
    cursorCanvas.getContext('2d').drawImage(penImage, 0, 0, cursorCanvas.width, cursorCanvas.height);
    penCursor = `url("${cursorCanvas.toDataURL('image/png')}") 20 36, crosshair`;
    if (!overlay.hidden) drawingCanvas.style.cursor = penCursor;
  };
  penImage.src = new URL('../sprites/pen.png', import.meta.url).href;

  const state = createSkillCastState(async request => {
    request.adminNumbers = adminNumbersForCast;
    const sketch = strokes.map(stroke => stroke.map(point => ({ ...point })));
    closeOverlay();
    setStatus('Checking drawing...');
    try {
      const digit = request.adminNumbers ? recognizeAdminDigit(sketch) : null;
      const result = request.adminNumbers
        ? digit ? adminSkillResult(request.owner, digit - 1) : { valid: false, reason: 'Draw a number from 1 to 6.' }
        : await recognizeLoadoutPattern(sketch, equippedSkills(request.owner), recognizer,
          () => request.token === state.token);
      if (request.token !== state.token) return;
      const accepted = state.resolve(request.token, result);
      if (accepted) {
        // Read restored targeting after recognition, rather than stale drawing-mode facing.
        const angle = getCastAngle();
        setStatus(`${result.label}! Accuracy: ${Math.round(result.accuracy * 100)}% | ${result.damageMultiplier.toFixed(2)}x damage. Cooldown: ${Math.floor((result.weapon?.successCooldown??180)/60)}:00.`);
        onRecognized({ player: request.owner, weapon: result.weapon, angle,
          skillId: result.skillId, accuracy: result.accuracy, damageMultiplier: result.damageMultiplier,
          clipPredictions: result.clipPredictions, predictions: [{ label: result.label, score: result.score }], components: result.components });
      } else setStatus(`${result.reason || 'Drawing not recognized.'} No cooldown applied.`);
    } catch (error) {
      if (request.token !== state.token) return;
      state.resolve(request.token, null);
      setStatus(`Recognition unavailable: ${error.message} No cooldown applied.`);
    }
  });

  /** Restore the previous cursor-aim preference and release the drawing pointer. */
  function closeOverlay() {
    overlay.hidden = true;
    aiming.setDirectionalOverride(false);
    if (pointerId !== null && drawingCanvas.hasPointerCapture?.(pointerId)) drawingCanvas.releasePointerCapture(pointerId);
    activeStroke = null; pointerId = null;
  }

  /** Empty cancellation is free; ink penalties target its closest ready skill instead of a default slot. */
  function cancel(reason) {
    const target = state.inkLength > 0 ? closestDrawingSkill(strokes, equippedSkills(state.owner)) : null;
    if (!state.cancel(reason, target)) return;
    closeOverlay();
    const applied = target?.skillCooldownRemaining > 0;
    setStatus(applied ? `${target.name || 'Skill'} cancelled: ${Math.ceil(target.skillCooldownRemaining)}s cooldown.`
      : 'Cast cancelled. No cooldown applied.');
  }

  /** Open the configured drawing window without freezing movement or enemies. */
  function toggleCast(event) {
    if (event.button !== 2) return;
    event.preventDefault(); event.stopPropagation();
    if (isPaused()) return;
    if (state.phase !== 'idle') { cancel('right'); return; }
    const player = getPlayer();
    adminNumbersForCast = numberMode();
    const weapon = adminNumbersForCast ? equippedSkills(player)[0] : readySkill(player);
    if (!weapon || !state.begin(player, weapon, adminNumbersForCast)) {
      const skills = equippedSkills(player);
      const remaining = Math.min(...skills.map(skill => skill.skillCooldownRemaining || 0));
      setStatus(skills.length
        ? `All skills are on cooldown. Next ready in ${Math.ceil(remaining)} seconds.` : 'Equip a weapon to draw a skill.');

    if (hint) hint.textContent = adminNumbersForCast ? 'Admin: draw slot number 1-6 (bypasses cooldown)' : equippedSkills(player).filter(skill => !(skill.skillCooldownRemaining > 0)).length === 1 && weapon.id === 'plana-umbrella'
      ? 'Circle enclosing an arrow above an X' : 'Draw your weapon pattern';
    updateTimer();
    // Start the download early; recognition retries after a temporary loading error.
    if (!adminNumbersForCast) recognizer.warmup().catch(() => {});
  }

  /** Convert pointer positions to fixed canvas coordinates, including scaled previews. */
  function point(event) {
    const result = pointerToCanvas(event.clientX, event.clientY, drawingCanvas.getBoundingClientRect(),
      drawingCanvas.width, drawingCanvas.height);
    return { x: Math.max(0, Math.min(drawingCanvas.width, result.x)),
      y: Math.max(0, Math.min(drawingCanvas.height, result.y)) };
  }
  /** Preserve cursor aim between strokes; force facing only while ink is being drawn. */

    aiming.trackPointer?.(event);

    drawingCanvas.style.cursor = penCursor;
  }

    updateDrawingAim(event);
  });
  drawingCanvas.addEventListener('pointermove', event => {
    updateDrawingAim(event);
    if (event.pointerId !== pointerId || !activeStroke || state.phase !== 'drawing') return;
    const samples = event.getCoalescedEvents?.();

      const distance = Math.hypot(next.x - previous.x, next.y - previous.y);
      if (distance < 0.75) continue;
      activeStroke.push(next); state.addInk(distance);
    }
    drawSkillStrokes(context, strokes, drawingCanvas.width, drawingCanvas.height);
  });
  function finishStroke(event) {
    if (event.pointerId !== pointerId) return;
    if (activeStroke && state.phase === 'drawing') {
      const next = point(event), previous = activeStroke.at(-1);
      const distance = Math.hypot(next.x - previous.x, next.y - previous.y);
      if (distance >= 0.75) { activeStroke.push(next); state.addInk(distance); }
      drawSkillStrokes(context, strokes, drawingCanvas.width, drawingCanvas.height);
    }
    if (drawingCanvas.hasPointerCapture(pointerId)) drawingCanvas.releasePointerCapture(pointerId);
    activeStroke = null; pointerId = null; state.strokeEnd();
    updateDrawingAim(event);
  }
  drawingCanvas.addEventListener('pointerup', finishStroke);
  drawingCanvas.addEventListener('pointercancel', finishStroke);
  overlay.addEventListener('pointerdown', event => { if (event.button === 2) toggleCast(event); });
  overlay.addEventListener('contextmenu', event => event.preventDefault());
  overlay.addEventListener('click', event => event.stopPropagation());
  canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown', toggleCast);

  /** Match the countdown text and mirrored EXP artwork to the remaining cast time. */
  function updateTimer() {
    const seconds = state.remaining;
    timer.textContent = `${seconds.toFixed(1)}s`;
    bar.setAttribute('aria-valuemax', String(skillCastSettings.drawingSeconds));
    const remainingPercent = seconds / skillCastSettings.drawingSeconds * 100;
    fill.style.clipPath = `inset(0 ${100 - remainingPercent}% 0 0)`;
    // Keep the white leading edge aligned with the shrinking fill each frame.
    bar.style.setProperty('--timer-fill', `${remainingPercent}%`);
    bar.classList.toggle('has-time', seconds > 0);
    bar.setAttribute('aria-valuenow', seconds.toFixed(1));
  }

  window.addEventListener('pagehide', () => { cancel('leave'); clearTimeout(feedbackTimeout); recognizer.dispose(); }, { once: true });
  return {
    cancel,
    /** Clear every character's independent skill timers, including a pending attempt. */
    resetCooldowns() {
      cancel('admin');
      for (const character of getCharacters()) for (const weapon of equippedSkills(character)) {
        weapon.skillCooldownRemaining = 0;
      }
      setStatus('Admin: all skill cooldowns reset.');
    },
    /** Trigger a defined slot directly for effect testing, bypassing its current cooldown. */
    castSlot(slot) {
      if (isPaused()) return;
      const result = adminSkillResult(getPlayer(), slot);
      if (!result.valid) { setStatus(result.reason); return; }
      cancel('admin');
      setSkillCooldown(result.weapon, result.weapon.successCooldown??skillCastSettings.successCooldown);
      onRecognized({ ...result, player: getPlayer(), angle: getCastAngle(), predictions: [] });
      setStatus(`Admin: cast slot ${slot + 1}.`);
    },
    get phase() { return state.phase; },
    update(delta) {
      advanceSkillCooldowns(getCharacters(), delta);
      if (state.phase !== 'idle' && (state.owner !== getPlayer() || !equippedSkills(getPlayer()).includes(state.weapon))) cancel('switch');
      if (state.phase === 'drawing' && (drawingCanvas.width !== canvas.width || drawingCanvas.height !== canvas.height)) cancel('resize');
      state.update(delta);
      if (state.phase === 'drawing') updateTimer();
      else if (!overlay.hidden) { closeOverlay(); if (state.phase === 'idle') setStatus('No drawing submitted. No cooldown applied.'); }
    }
  };
}

--- SNAPSHOT FILE: Development/skill-drawing.js | sha256=899f66b01f1ce46ca4208c746bc8720cf801e999829b16b892133eca0539cc89 | encoding=utf-8-sig ---
import { skillCastSettings } from './game-config.js';

/** Normalize X/Y independently so canvas size and squashed proportions do not affect casting. */
export function normalizeSkillStrokes(strokes) {
  const bounds = drawingBounds(strokes);
  if (!bounds) return [];
  const width = bounds.right - bounds.left, height = bounds.bottom - bounds.top;
  if (!(width > 0) || !(height > 0)) return [];
  return strokes.map(stroke => stroke.map(point => ({
    x: (point.x - bounds.left) / width * 200,
    y: (point.y - bounds.top) / height * 200
  })));
}

/** Measure the drawing alone, excluding the game, HUD, dimmer and decorative stroke glow. */
export function drawingBounds(strokes) {
  const points = strokes.flat();
  if (!points.length) return null;
  return points.reduce((bounds, point) => ({ left: Math.min(bounds.left, point.x),
    top: Math.min(bounds.top, point.y), right: Math.max(bounds.right, point.x),
    bottom: Math.max(bounds.bottom, point.y) }),
    { left: Infinity, top: Infinity, right: -Infinity, bottom: -Infinity });
}

/** Normalize a cropped sketch into a square black-on-white image for QuickDraw. */
export function drawingModelImage(strokes, createCanvas = () => document.createElement('canvas')) {
  const bounds = drawingBounds(strokes);
  if (!bounds) return null;
  const canvas = createCanvas(), size = skillCastSettings.modelInputSize;
  canvas.width = canvas.height = size;
  const context = canvas.getContext('2d');
  context.fillStyle = '#fff'; context.fillRect(0, 0, size, size);
  const usable = size - skillCastSettings.modelPadding * 2;
  const scale = usable / Math.max(1, bounds.right - bounds.left, bounds.bottom - bounds.top);
  const centerX = (bounds.left + bounds.right) / 2, centerY = (bounds.top + bounds.bottom) / 2;
  context.strokeStyle = '#000'; context.lineWidth = skillCastSettings.modelLineWidth;
  context.lineCap = context.lineJoin = 'round';
  for (const stroke of strokes) {
    if (stroke.length < 2) continue;
    context.beginPath();
    stroke.forEach((point, index) => {
      const x = size / 2 + (point.x - centerX) * scale, y = size / 2 + (point.y - centerY) * scale;
      if (index) context.lineTo(x, y); else context.moveTo(x, y);
    });
    context.stroke();
  }
  return canvas.toDataURL('image/png');
}

/** Render the visible Schale-style cyan/blue/lilac line, retaining separate pen strokes. */
export function drawSkillStrokes(context, strokes, width, height) {
  context.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
  const gradient = context.createLinearGradient(0, height, width, 0);
  gradient.addColorStop(0, '#b7fbff'); gradient.addColorStop(0.35, '#45dcff');
  gradient.addColorStop(0.7, '#408dff'); gradient.addColorStop(1, '#d6acff');
  context.save();
  context.strokeStyle = gradient; context.lineWidth = skillCastSettings.lineWidth;
  context.lineCap = context.lineJoin = 'round'; context.shadowColor = '#62dfff'; context.shadowBlur = 9;
  for (const stroke of strokes) {
    if (!stroke.length) continue;
    context.beginPath();
    stroke.forEach((point, index) => index ? context.lineTo(point.x, point.y) : context.moveTo(point.x, point.y));
    context.stroke();
  }
  context.restore();
}

import { decagrammatonReferenceStrokes } from './decagrammaton-ultimate.js';
import { segmentPlanaPattern } from './plana-pattern.js';
import { drawingModelImage, drawingBounds, normalizeSkillStrokes } from './skill-drawing.js';

import { skillCastSettings, luminousNovaSkillSettings } from './game-config.js';

/** Require interior ink in both symbol regions before allowing CLIP to rescue rough geometry. */
function hasBothSymbols(strokes) {
  const b = drawingBounds(strokes);
  if (!b) return false;
  const cx = (b.left + b.right) / 2, cy = (b.top + b.bottom) / 2;
  const w = b.right - b.left, h = b.bottom - b.top;
  if (!(w > 0) || !(h > 0)) return false;
  const inner = strokes.flat().filter(p => Math.hypot((p.x-cx)/(w/2), (p.y-cy)/(h/2)) < .76);
  return inner.some(p => p.y < cy && p.x < cx-w*.04) &&
    inner.some(p => p.y < cy && p.x > cx+w*.04) &&
    inner.some(p => p.y > cy && p.x < cx-w*.04) &&
    inner.some(p => p.y > cy && p.x > cx+w*.04);
}

/** Combine full-symbol CLIP, isolated QuickDraw parts and forgiving spatial validation. */
export async function recognizeWeaponPattern(strokes, weapon, recognizer, isCurrent = () => true) {
  if(!isCurrent())return {valid:false,cancelled:true};
  if(weapon?.id==='decagrammaton-ultimate'){
    const accuracy=drawingAccuracy(strokes,decagrammatonReferenceStrokes());
    const valid=accuracy>=.72;return {valid,skillId:'decagrammaton-ultimate',label:'Activate Protocol SUPERNOVA',score:accuracy,accuracy,matchAccuracy:accuracy,damageMultiplier:1,reason:valid?undefined:'Draw a square overlaid with a diamond.'};
  }
  if(weapon?.id==='decagrammaton')return recognizePrincessKeyPattern(strokes,recognizer,isCurrent);
  if(weapon?.id==='princess-key')return recognizePrincessKeyPattern(strokes,recognizer,isCurrent);
  if (weapon?.id === 'maid-force') return recognizeSqueekyCleanPattern(strokes,isCurrent);
  if (weapon?.id === 'bad-cooking') return recognizeBadCookingPattern(strokes,isCurrent);
  if (weapon?.id === 'moustache-medal') return recognizePrstHonarsPattern(strokes,isCurrent);
  if (weapon?.id === 'cheering-balloons') return recognizeBoundyBloonsPattern(strokes,isCurrent);
  if (weapon?.id === 'saint-predator') return recognizeHolyResonancePattern(strokes,isCurrent);
  if (weapon?.id === 'bean-bag-bomb') return recognizeNuclearBeanPattern(strokes,isCurrent);
  if (weapon?.id === 'serve') return recognizeReturnThisPattern(strokes,isCurrent);
  if (weapon?.id === 'time-to-surf') return recognizeRidingWavesPattern(strokes,isCurrent);
  if (weapon?.id === 'wakamo-bayonet') return recognizeBayonetChargePattern(strokes,isCurrent);
  if (weapon?.id === 'orbital-compass') return recognizeOrbitalCompassPattern(strokes,isCurrent);
  if (weapon?.id === 'water-dousing') return recognizeSplashPattern(strokes,isCurrent);
  if (weapon?.id === 'student-handbook') return recognizeStrictRulesPattern(strokes,isCurrent);
  if (weapon?.id === 'throwing-cards') return recognizeSkilledThrowPattern(strokes,isCurrent);
  if (weapon?.id === 'molotov-cocktail') return recognizeMolotovPattern(strokes,isCurrent);
  if (weapon?.id === 'luminous-nova') return recognizeLuminousNovaPattern(strokes,recognizer,isCurrent);
  if (weapon?.id === 'aris-laser') return recognizeSupernovaPattern(strokes, recognizer, isCurrent);
  if (weapon?.id !== 'plana-umbrella') return { valid: false, reason: 'No drawing skill is defined for this weapon yet.' };
  if(recognizeStrictRulesPattern(strokes).valid)return {valid:false,reason:'This is the Strict Rules circle-and-plus pattern, not Umbrella.'};
  // CLIP can confuse overlapping frames with Umbrella's enclosing circle. Local geometry wins.
  if(linkedFrameEvidence(strokes))return {valid:false,reason:'This is a linked-frame pattern, not Umbrella.'};
  if (!isCurrent()) return { valid: false, cancelled: true };
  strokes = normalizeSkillStrokes(strokes);
  const pattern = segmentPlanaPattern(strokes);
  const accuracy = drawingAccuracy(strokes);
  let clipPredictions = [], clipError;
  try {
    if (recognizer.recognizeSymbol) clipPredictions = await recognizer.recognizeSymbol(drawingModelImage(strokes));
  } catch (error) {
    // Download/inference failure must not disable an otherwise recognized geometric cast.
    clipError = error.message;
  }
  if (!isCurrent()) return { valid: false, cancelled: true };
  const clipMatch = clipPredictions[0]?.label === 'a hand drawn circle enclosing an arrow above an X cross' &&
    clipPredictions[0].score >= skillCastSettings.clipMinimumScore;
  const rescued = clipMatch && accuracy >= skillCastSettings.referenceMinimum && hasBothSymbols(strokes);
  if (!pattern.valid && !rescued) return { ...pattern, clipPredictions, accuracy };
  const components = [];
  // When geometry cannot reliably split rough ink, ask QuickDraw about the whole sketch.
  const parts = pattern.valid ? pattern.parts : [{ name: 'whole pattern', strokes }];
  for (const part of parts) {
    if (!isCurrent()) return { valid: false, cancelled: true };
    try {
      const predictions = await recognizer.recognize(drawingModelImage(part.strokes));
      components.push({ name: part.name, predictions });
    } catch (error) {
      components.push({ name: part.name, predictions: [], error: error.message });
    }
  }
  if (!isCurrent()) return { valid: false, cancelled: true };
  return { valid: true, skillId: 'plana-umbrella-launch', label: 'Plana: Umbrella Launch',
    score: pattern.valid ? pattern.score : clipPredictions[0].score,
    accuracy, damageMultiplier: skillDamageMultiplier(accuracy), components, clipPredictions, clipError };
}


/** Let the drawing identify a ready EX skill; autoattacks never require weapon selection. */
export async function recognizeLoadoutPattern(strokes, skills, recognizer, isCurrent = () => true) {

/** Three crown spikes with open underside; a diamond sits above the crown. */

/** Geometric whole-symbol matching plus isolated QuickDraw assistance, with offline fallback. */
export async function recognizeSupernovaPattern(strokes, recognizer, isCurrent) {
  const normalized = normalizeSkillStrokes(strokes);
  const bounds = drawingBounds(normalized);
  if (!bounds) return {valid:false,reason:'Draw the Supernova pattern.'};
  const width = bounds.right-bounds.left, height = bounds.bottom-bounds.top;
  const split = bounds.top + height*.53;
  const upper = normalized.map(stroke=>stroke.filter(p=>p.y<split)).filter(s=>s.length);
  const lower = normalized.map(stroke=>stroke.filter(p=>p.y>=split)).filter(s=>s.length);
  const diamondBounds=drawingBounds(upper), crownBounds=drawingBounds(lower);
  // The narrow diamond sits above the wider crown; reject enclosing circles/partial symbols.
  if (!diamondBounds || !crownBounds || diamondBounds.right-diamondBounds.left>width*.75 ||
      crownBounds.right-crownBounds.left<width*.75 || diamondBounds.bottom-diamondBounds.top<height*.25) {
    return {valid:false,reason:'Draw a diamond above an open-bottom three-spike crown.'};
  }
  const accuracy = drawingAccuracy(strokes,supernovaReferenceStrokes());
  if (accuracy < .62) return {valid:false, reason:'Draw an open-bottom three-spike crown and a diamond.'};
  const components = [];
  for (const stroke of normalizeSkillStrokes(strokes)) {
    if (!isCurrent()) return {valid:false,cancelled:true};
    try { components.push({name:'Supernova component',predictions:await recognizer.recognize(drawingModelImage([stroke]))}); }
    catch { /* Local reference remains available when model inference is offline. */ }
  }
  return {valid:true,skillId:'supernova-beam',label:'Supernova',score:accuracy,accuracy,
    damageMultiplier:skillDamageMultiplier(accuracy),components};
}

}

/** Vertically flipped triangle: left lower, right higher, third projecting upward between both. */
export function princessKeyReferenceStrokes() {

/** Recognize closed, mostly horizontal/vertical frames without requiring exact reference spacing. */
export function linkedFrameEvidence(strokes) {
  const normalized=normalizeSkillStrokes(strokes);let frames=0,total=0,aligned=0;const frameBounds=[];
  for(const stroke of normalized) {
    if(stroke.length<4)continue;
    const bounds=drawingBounds([stroke]);if(!bounds)continue;
    const width=bounds.right-bounds.left,height=bounds.bottom-bounds.top;
    let length=0,axis=0;
    for(let i=1;i<stroke.length;i++) {
      const dx=Math.abs(stroke[i].x-stroke[i-1].x),dy=Math.abs(stroke[i].y-stroke[i-1].y),distance=Math.hypot(dx,dy);
      length+=distance;if(Math.min(dx,dy)<=Math.max(dx,dy)*.45)axis+=distance;
    }
    total+=length;aligned+=axis;
    const endGap=Math.hypot(stroke[0].x-stroke.at(-1).x,stroke[0].y-stroke.at(-1).y);
    if(width>=20&&height>=20&&endGap<Math.hypot(width,height)*.3&&axis/Math.max(1,length)>.65&&length>1.5*(width+height)){frames++;frameBounds.push(bounds);}
  }
  const interlocked=frameBounds.some((a,i)=>frameBounds.filter((b,j)=>i!==j&&
    Math.min(a.right,b.right)>Math.max(a.left,b.left)&&Math.min(a.bottom,b.bottom)>Math.max(a.top,b.top)).length>=2);
  return frames>=3&&interlocked&&total>0&&aligned/total>.65;
}

/** Reference matching is scale/stroke-order independent; QuickDraw supplies supporting shape predictions. */
export async function recognizePrincessKeyPattern(strokes,recognizer,isCurrent=()=>true) {
  const accuracy=drawingAccuracy(strokes,princessKeyReferenceStrokes()),frames=linkedFrameEvidence(strokes);
  if(accuracy<.88&&!frames)return {valid:false,reason:'Draw three interlocking squares.'};
  const components=[];
  try{components.push({name:'linked rectangles',predictions:await recognizer?.recognize(drawingModelImage(strokes))});}catch{}
  if(!isCurrent())return {valid:false,cancelled:true};
  return {valid:true,skillId:'princess-key-ex',label:'The Princess and the Key',score:Math.max(accuracy,frames ? .8 : 0),accuracy,matchAccuracy:Math.max(accuracy,frames ? .85 : 0),
    damageMultiplier:skillDamageMultiplier(accuracy),components};
}

/** Separate enclosing ink from diamond ink before combining forgiving geometry and AI assistance. */
export async function recognizeLuminousNovaPattern(strokes,recognizer,isCurrent=()=>true) {
  const normalized=normalizeSkillStrokes(strokes),points=[];
  for(const stroke of normalized)for(let i=1;i<stroke.length;i++) {
    const a=stroke[i-1],b=stroke[i],count=Math.max(1,Math.ceil(Math.hypot(b.x-a.x,b.y-a.y)/3));
    for(let j=0;j<=count;j++)points.push({x:a.x+(b.x-a.x)*j/count,y:a.y+(b.y-a.y)*j/count});
  }
  if(!points.length)return {valid:false,reason:'Draw a circle with a diamond inside.'};
  const radius=p=>Math.hypot((p.x-100)/100,(p.y-100)/100);
  const outer=points.filter(p=>radius(p)>.87),inner=points.filter(p=>radius(p)<.84);
  const sectors=new Set(outer.map(p=>(Math.floor((Math.atan2(p.y-100,p.x-100)+Math.PI)/Math.PI*4)+8)%8));
  const bounds=drawingBounds([inner]);
  if(sectors.size<7||!bounds||bounds.right-bounds.left<40||bounds.bottom-bounds.top<40)return {valid:false,reason:'Draw an enclosing circle and a centered diamond.'};
  const cx=(bounds.left+bounds.right)/2,cy=(bounds.top+bounds.bottom)/2;
  const rx=(bounds.right-bounds.left)/2,ry=(bounds.bottom-bounds.top)/2;
  const error=inner.reduce((sum,p)=>sum+Math.abs(Math.abs(p.x-cx)/rx+Math.abs(p.y-cy)/ry-1),0)/inner.length;
  if(Math.abs(cx-100)>25||Math.abs(cy-100)>25||error>.23)return {valid:false,reason:'Draw a diamond outline inside the circle.'};
  const accuracy=drawingAccuracy(strokes,luminousNovaReferenceStrokes());
  if(accuracy<luminousNovaSkillSettings.patternMinimumAccuracy)return {valid:false,reason:'Complete the circle and diamond.'};
  const components=[];
  for(const [name,ink] of [['circle',outer],['diamond',inner]]) {
    if(!isCurrent())return {valid:false,cancelled:true};
    try{components.push({name,predictions:await recognizer?.recognize(drawingModelImage([ink]))});}catch{}
  }
  if(!isCurrent())return {valid:false,cancelled:true};
  return {valid:true,skillId:'luminous-nova-aura',label:'Luminous Nova',score:accuracy,accuracy,damageMultiplier:1,components};
}

/** Upward arrow above a water droplet. */
export function splashReferenceStrokes(){return [[{x:100,y:68},{x:100,y:18}],[{x:75,y:43},{x:100,y:18},{x:125,y:43}],[[100,88],[123,117],[140,144],[143,160],[137,178],[122,190],[100,194],[78,190],[63,178],[57,160],[60,144],[77,117],[100,88]].map(([x,y])=>({x,y}))];}

/** Saturn: a round planet overlaid with a wider, shallow closed ring. */
export function orbitalCompassReferenceStrokes(){return [Array.from({length:65},(_,i)=>({x:100+55*Math.cos(i*Math.PI/32),y:100+55*Math.sin(i*Math.PI/32)})),Array.from({length:65},(_,i)=>({x:100+94*Math.cos(i*Math.PI/32),y:100+25*Math.sin(i*Math.PI/32)}))];}
export function recognizeOrbitalCompassPattern(strokes,isCurrent=()=>true){
 if(!isCurrent())return {valid:false,cancelled:true};
 const shapes=strokes.filter(s=>s.length>=8).map(s=>{const b=drawingBounds([s]),w=b.right-b.left,h=b.bottom-b.top;return {w,h,x:(b.left+b.right)/2,y:(b.top+b.bottom)/2,closed:Math.hypot(s[0].x-s.at(-1).x,s[0].y-s.at(-1).y)<Math.max(w,h)*.3&&s.reduce((sum,p)=>sum+Math.abs(Math.hypot((p.x-(b.left+b.right)/2)/(w/2||1),(p.y-(b.top+b.bottom)/2)/(h/2||1))-1),0)/s.length<.12};});
 const valid=shapes.some(p=>p.closed&&p.w/p.h>.65&&p.w/p.h<1.45&&shapes.some(r=>r!==p&&r.closed&&r.w>p.w*1.3&&((r.h<p.h*.8&&r.h>p.h*.15)||(r.h>p.h*1.3&&r.w/r.h>.65&&r.w/r.h<1.45))&&Math.hypot(r.x-p.x,r.y-p.y)<p.w*.35));
 const accuracy=drawingAccuracy(strokes,orbitalCompassReferenceStrokes());
 return {valid,skillId:'orbital-compass-ex',label:'This Direction?',score:accuracy,accuracy,matchAccuracy:accuracy,damageMultiplier:1,reason:valid?undefined:'Draw a circle with an oval ring like Saturn.'};
}

export function bayonetChargeReferenceStrokes(){return [[100,20],[45,110],[155,110]].flatMap(([x,y])=>[[{x,y:y+60},{x,y}],[{x:x-22,y:y+22},{x,y},{x:x+22,y:y+22}]]);}
/** Validate each arrow locally so varying shaft lengths do not spoil whole-image similarity. */
export function recognizeBayonetChargePattern(strokes,isCurrent=()=>true){
 if(!isCurrent())return {valid:false,cancelled:true};
 const normalized=normalizeSkillStrokes(strokes),groups=[[],[],[]];
 for(const stroke of normalized){const b=drawingBounds([stroke]);if(!b)continue;const cx=(b.left+b.right)/2;groups[cx<65?1:cx>135?2:0].push(stroke);}
 function arrow(group){
  const b=drawingBounds(group);if(!b)return null;const w=b.right-b.left,h=b.bottom-b.top;if(w<18||h<35||h<w*.85)return null;
  const points=[];for(const stroke of group){for(let i=1;i<stroke.length;i++){const a=stroke[i-1],z=stroke[i],n=Math.max(1,Math.ceil(Math.hypot(z.x-a.x,z.y-a.y)/3));for(let j=0;j<=n;j++)points.push({x:a.x+(z.x-a.x)*j/n,y:a.y+(z.y-a.y)*j/n});}}
  const cx=(b.left+b.right)/2,tip=points.filter(p=>p.y<=b.top+h*.08&&Math.abs(p.x-cx)<w*.3).sort((a,b)=>a.y-b.y)[0];
  if(!tip)return null;
  const wing=p=>p.y>b.top+h*.08&&p.y<b.top+h*.52;
  const left=points.some(p=>wing(p)&&p.x<tip.x-w*.25),right=points.some(p=>wing(p)&&p.x>tip.x+w*.25);
  const shaft=points.some(p=>p.y>b.top+h*.85&&Math.abs(p.x-tip.x)<w*.4);
  return left&&right&&shaft?{x:tip.x,y:tip.y}:null;
 }
 const [top,left,right]=groups.map(arrow),geometry=Boolean(top&&left&&right&&top.y+20<Math.min(left.y,right.y)&&left.x+25<top.x&&top.x+25<right.x&&Math.abs(left.y-right.y)<65);
 const accuracy=drawingAccuracy(strokes,bayonetChargeReferenceStrokes()),valid=geometry;
 return {valid,skillId:'bayonet-charge',label:'Charge!',score:accuracy,accuracy,matchAccuracy:geometry?Math.max(.8,accuracy):accuracy,damageMultiplier:1,reason:valid?undefined:'Draw 3 upward arrows in a triangle.'};
}

/** Mouse-drawing safety: bounded jitter tolerance, component coverage and global rivals.
 * Always compare against every symbol, including unavailable/cooling-down skills.
 * AI predictions cannot override this decision or pick a substitute skill.
 */
let bufferedSkillCatalog;
function skillDrawingCatalog(){
 if(bufferedSkillCatalog)return bufferedSkillCatalog;
 const ultimate=()=>typeof decagrammatonReferenceStrokes==='function'?decagrammatonReferenceStrokes():[[[40,40],[160,40],[160,160],[40,160],[40,40]],[[100,15],[185,100],[100,185],[15,100],[100,15]]].map(s=>s.map(([x,y])=>({x,y})));
 const definitions=[
  [['plana-umbrella'],'plana-umbrella-launch','Plana: Umbrella Launch',planaReferenceStrokes,strokes=>segmentPlanaPattern(strokes).valid,true],
  [['aris-laser'],'supernova-beam','Supernova',supernovaReferenceStrokes,null,true],
  [['luminous-nova'],'luminous-nova-aura','Luminous Nova',luminousNovaReferenceStrokes],
  [['princess-key','decagrammaton'],'princess-key-ex','The Princess and the Key',princessKeyReferenceStrokes,linkedFrameEvidence,true],
  [['decagrammaton-ultimate'],'decagrammaton-ultimate','Activate Protocol SUPERNOVA',ultimate],
  [['molotov-cocktail'],'molotov-ex','ARSON!',molotovReferenceStrokes,strokes=>recognizeMolotovPattern(strokes).valid],
  [['throwing-cards'],'skilled-throw','Skilled Throw',skilledThrowReferenceStrokes],
  [['student-handbook'],'strict-rules','Strict Rules',strictRulesReferenceStrokes,strokes=>recognizeStrictRulesPattern(strokes).valid],
  [['water-dousing'],'splash-ex','Water Fight!',splashReferenceStrokes],
  [['orbital-compass'],'orbital-compass-ex','This Direction?',orbitalCompassReferenceStrokes,strokes=>recognizeOrbitalCompassPattern(strokes).valid],
  [['time-to-surf'],'riding-waves','Riding Waves',ridingWavesReferenceStrokes],
  [['serve'],'return-this','Return This!',returnThisReferenceStrokes,strokes=>returnThisAxes(strokes).size===4&&recognizeStrictRulesPattern(strokes).valid],
  [['bean-bag-bomb'],'nuclear-bean-bag','Nuclear Bean Bag',nuclearBeanReferenceStrokes],
  [['saint-predator'],'holy-resonance','Holy Resonance',holyResonanceReferenceStrokes,holyMissileEvidence],
  [['cheering-balloons'],'boundy-bloons','Boundy Bloons',boundyBloonsReferenceStrokes,nestedCircleEvidence],
  [['moustache-medal'],'prst-honars','PRST Honars',prstHonarsReferenceStrokes],
  [['bad-cooking'],'bad-cooking-ex','You really are bad at cooking',badCookingReferenceStrokes,knifeEvidence],
  [['maid-force'],'squeeky-clean','Squeeky Clean',squeekyCleanReferenceStrokes],
  [['wakamo-bayonet'],'bayonet-charge','Charge!',bayonetChargeReferenceStrokes,strokes=>recognizeBayonetChargePattern(strokes).valid]
 ];
 bufferedSkillCatalog=definitions.map(([ids,skillId,label,reference,geometry,scaled])=>{const strokes=normalizeSkillStrokes(reference());const entry={ids,skillId,label,reference,geometry,scaled,parts:strokes.map(s=>sampleBufferedInk([s],24)),points:sampleBufferedInk(strokes,160)};if(skillId==='riding-waves')entry.alternatives=[1,2,3].flatMap(cycles=>[-1,1].map(phase=>{const wave=normalizeSkillStrokes(ridingWavesReferenceStrokes(cycles,phase));return {parts:wave.map(s=>sampleBufferedInk([s],24)),points:sampleBufferedInk(wave,160)};}));return entry;});
 return bufferedSkillCatalog;
}
function sampleBufferedInk(strokes,budget=160){
 const segments=[];let total=0;
 for(const stroke of strokes)for(let i=1;i<stroke.length;i++){const a=stroke[i-1],b=stroke[i],length=Math.hypot(b.x-a.x,b.y-a.y);if(length){segments.push({a,b,length});total+=length;}}
 if(!total)return [];
 const points=[];let segment=0,offset=0;
 for(let i=0;i<budget;i++){const distance=total*(i+.5)/budget;while(segment<segments.length-1&&offset+segments[segment].length<distance){offset+=segments[segment++].length;}const {a,b,length}=segments[segment],t=(distance-offset)/length;points.push({x:a.x+(b.x-a.x)*t,y:a.y+(b.y-a.y)*t});}return points;
}
function bufferedNearest(point,cloud){let best=Infinity;for(const other of cloud){const d=(point.x-other.x)**2+(point.y-other.y)**2;if(d<best)best=d;}return Math.sqrt(best);}
function bufferedInkMetrics(actual,entry){
 const forward=actual.map(p=>bufferedNearest(p,entry.points)),back=entry.points.map(p=>bufferedNearest(p,actual));
 // Four normalized pixels of free jitter; both directions must cover the whole symbol.
 const mean=values=>values.reduce((sum,d)=>sum+Math.max(0,d-4),0)/values.length;
 const score=Math.max(0,1-(mean(forward)+mean(back))/2/24);
 const coverage=entry.parts.every(part=>part.filter(p=>bufferedNearest(p,actual)<=18).length/part.length>=.7);
 const extra=forward.filter(d=>d>20).length/forward.length;
 return {score,coverage,extra};
}
const bufferedDrawingDecisions=new Map();
export function analyzeSkillDrawing(strokes){
 const key=JSON.stringify(strokes.map(s=>s.map(p=>[Math.round(p.x*100),Math.round(p.y*100)])));
 if(bufferedDrawingDecisions.has(key))return bufferedDrawingDecisions.get(key);
 const result=evaluateSkillDrawing(strokes);bufferedDrawingDecisions.set(key,result);
 if(bufferedDrawingDecisions.size>8)bufferedDrawingDecisions.delete(bufferedDrawingDecisions.keys().next().value);
 return result;
}
function bufferedFrameSignature(strokes){
 let axis=0,diagonal=0,closed=0,openWaves=0;
 for(const stroke of strokes){const b=drawingBounds([stroke]);if(!b||stroke.length<4)continue;const w=b.right-b.left,h=b.bottom-b.top;if(w<25||h<15)continue;
  if(Math.hypot(stroke[0].x-stroke.at(-1).x,stroke[0].y-stroke.at(-1).y)>Math.hypot(w,h)*.3){
   if(w>h*.9&&Math.abs(stroke[0].x-stroke.at(-1).x)>w*.7){const points=sampleBufferedInk([stroke],24);let sign=0,turns=0;for(let i=1;i<points.length;i++){const dy=points[i].y-points[i-1].y;if(Math.abs(dy)<h*.025)continue;const next=Math.sign(dy);if(sign&&sign!==next)turns++;sign=next;}if(turns>=2)openWaves++;}continue;
  }
  if(h<25)continue;
  const points=sampleBufferedInk([stroke],24);let total=0,aligned=0;for(let i=1;i<points.length;i++){const dx=Math.abs(points[i].x-points[i-1].x),dy=Math.abs(points[i].y-points[i-1].y),length=Math.hypot(dx,dy);total+=length;if(Math.min(dx,dy)<Math.max(dx,dy)*.45)aligned+=length;}
  const ratio=aligned/Math.max(1,total);closed++;if(ratio>.7)axis++;if(ratio<.25)diagonal++;
 }return {axis,diagonal,closed,openWaves};
}
function evaluateSkillDrawing(strokes){
 const fail=reason=>({valid:false,reason});
 if(!drawingBounds(strokes))return fail('Draw a complete skill symbol.');
 const normalized=normalizeSkillStrokes(strokes),clean=normalized.filter(s=>sampleBufferedInk([s],8).length&&s.reduce((sum,p,i)=>sum+(i?Math.hypot(p.x-s[i-1].x,p.y-s[i-1].y):0),0)>5);
 if(!clean.length)return fail('Draw a complete skill symbol.');
 const base=sampleBufferedInk(clean,160),catalog=skillDrawingCatalog(),frames=bufferedFrameSignature(clean),crossAxes=returnThisAxes(clean);
 const variants=[-15,-10,-5,0,5,10,15].map(degrees=>{const angle=degrees*Math.PI/180,c=Math.cos(angle),s=Math.sin(angle);return base.map(p=>({x:100+(p.x-100)*c-(p.y-100)*s,y:100+(p.x-100)*s+(p.y-100)*c}));});
 const ranked=catalog.map(entry=>{
  let best={score:0,coverage:false,extra:1},complete=null,votes=0;
  for(const actual of variants){const metric=(entry.alternatives||[entry]).map(reference=>bufferedInkMetrics(actual,reference)).sort((a,b)=>b.score-a.score)[0];if(metric.score>best.score)best=metric;if(metric.coverage&&metric.extra<=.2&&metric.score>=.7){votes++;if(!complete||metric.score>complete.score)complete=metric;}}
  best=complete||best;
  const geometry=Boolean(entry.geometry?.(clean));
  return {...entry,...best,geometry,votes,signature:entry.skillId==='luminous-nova-aura'?innerDiamondEvidence(clean):entry.skillId==='strict-rules'?!nestedCircleEvidence(clean,2)&&!crossAxes.has(1)&&!crossAxes.has(3):entry.skillId==='return-this'?crossAxes.size===4&&!segmentPlanaPattern(clean).valid:entry.skillId==='riding-waves'?frames.closed===0:entry.skillId==='orbital-compass-ex'?frames.openWaves===0&&frames.closed<=2:entry.skillId==='boundy-bloons'?nestedCircleEvidence(clean):entry.skillId==='bayonet-charge'?frames.closed===0:entry.skillId==='princess-key-ex'?frames.diagonal===0:entry.skillId==='decagrammaton-ultimate'?frames.closed<=2:true,confidence:entry.skillId==='bad-cooking-ex'&&geometry?1.08:entry.skillId==='orbital-compass-ex'&&nestedCircleEvidence(clean,2)?1.08:best.score+(geometry ? ((entry.skillId==='princess-key-ex'&&frames.diagonal===0)||(entry.skillId==='orbital-compass-ex'&&nestedCircleEvidence(clean,2)) ? .2 : .06) : 0)};
 }).sort((a,b)=>b.confidence-a.confidence);
 const winner=ranked[0],rival=ranked.find((entry,index)=>index>0&&entry.signature)||{confidence:0};
 // Independent shape evidence can rescue unusual proportions, but never a close rival.
 const qualified=winner.signature&&((winner.coverage&&winner.extra<=.2&&winner.score>=.75&&winner.votes>=2)||(winner.geometry&&winner.score>=.45));
 if(!qualified)return {...fail('The symbol is incomplete or too unclear. Please try again.'),recognitionChecks:{candidate:winner.label,score:winner.score,coverage:winner.coverage,extra:winner.extra,votes:winner.votes}};
 if(winner.confidence-rival.confidence<.07)return fail('Drawing matches more than one skill. Please try again. No cooldown applied.');
 // Refuse a rescue if another complete symbol also has independent structural evidence.
 if(ranked.some(other=>other!==winner&&other.signature&&other.geometry&&other.coverage&&other.score>=winner.score-.07))return fail('Drawing is ambiguous. Please try again. No cooldown applied.');
 const accuracy=drawingAccuracy(strokes,winner.reference());
 return {valid:true,ids:winner.ids,skillId:winner.skillId,label:winner.label,accuracy,score:winner.score,matchAccuracy:winner.confidence,damageMultiplier:winner.scaled?skillDamageMultiplier(accuracy):1,components:[],recognitionChecks:{coverage:winner.coverage,geometry:winner.geometry,votes:winner.votes,margin:winner.confidence-rival.confidence}};
}

export function ridingWavesReferenceStrokes(cycles=2,phase=1){return [Array.from({length:97},(_,i)=>({x:10+180*i/96,y:100-40*phase*Math.sin(i/96*Math.PI*2*cycles)}))];}
export function recognizeRidingWavesPattern(strokes,isCurrent=()=>true){if(!isCurrent())return {valid:false,cancelled:true};const decision=analyzeSkillDrawing(strokes);return decision.skillId==='riding-waves'?decision:{valid:false,reason:'Draw a flowing wave pattern.'};}

export function returnThisReferenceStrokes(){return [strictRulesReferenceStrokes()[0],[{x:55,y:100},{x:145,y:100}],[{x:100,y:55},{x:100,y:145}],[{x:63,y:63},{x:137,y:137}],[{x:137,y:63},{x:63,y:137}]];}
/** Straight opposing strokes through the center distinguish plus, X, and all eight spokes. */
function returnThisAxes(strokes){
 const axes=new Set();for(const original of normalizeSkillStrokes(strokes)){const points=sampleBufferedInk([original],32);for(let i=0;i<points.length;i++){const a=points[i];if(Math.hypot(a.x-100,a.y-100)>78)continue;for(let j=i+1;j<points.length;j++){const b=points[j],dx=b.x-a.x,dy=b.y-a.y,length=Math.hypot(dx,dy);if(length<45||Math.hypot(b.x-100,b.y-100)>78||((a.x-100)*(b.x-100)+(a.y-100)*(b.y-100))>=0)continue;const t=((100-a.x)*dx+(100-a.y)*dy)/(length*length);if(t<.15||t>.85||Math.hypot(a.x+dx*t-100,a.y+dy*t-100)>14)continue;let straight=true;for(let k=i+1;k<j;k++)if(Math.abs((points[k].x-a.x)*dy-(points[k].y-a.y)*dx)/length>10){straight=false;break;}if(straight)axes.add((Math.round(Math.atan2(dy,dx)/(Math.PI/4))+8)%4);}}}return axes;
}
export function recognizeReturnThisPattern(strokes,isCurrent=()=>true){if(!isCurrent())return {valid:false,cancelled:true};const decision=analyzeSkillDrawing(strokes);return decision.skillId==='return-this'?decision:{valid:false,reason:'Draw a circle enclosing an overlaid X and +.'};}

function holyMissileEvidence(strokes){
 const normalized=normalizeSkillStrokes(strokes);
 if(!normalized.some(s=>{const b=drawingBounds([s]);return b&&b.bottom-b.top>150&&Math.hypot(s[0].x-s.at(-1).x,s[0].y-s.at(-1).y)<55;}))return false;
 const points=sampleBufferedInk(normalized,160),tip=points.filter(p=>p.y<15&&p.x>60&&p.x<140).sort((a,b)=>a.y-b.y)[0];if(!tip)return false;
 const middle=drawingBounds([points.filter(p=>p.y>55&&p.y<125)]);if(!middle||middle.right-middle.left>155||middle.right-middle.left<40)return false;
 const nose=points.filter(p=>p.y>tip.y+15&&p.y<tip.y+75),fins=points.filter(p=>p.y>145);
 return nose.some(p=>p.x<tip.x-12)&&nose.some(p=>p.x>tip.x+12)&&fins.some(p=>p.x<55)&&fins.some(p=>p.x>145);

export function boundyBloonsReferenceStrokes(){return [90,60,30].map(radius=>Array.from({length:65},(_,i)=>({x:100+radius*Math.cos(i*Math.PI/32),y:100+radius*Math.sin(i*Math.PI/32)})));}
function nestedCircleEvidence(strokes,count=3){const loops=normalizeSkillStrokes(strokes).filter(s=>s.length>=6).map(s=>{const b=drawingBounds([s]);if(!b)return null;const w=b.right-b.left,h=b.bottom-b.top,cx=(b.left+b.right)/2,cy=(b.top+b.bottom)/2;if(w<25||h<25||w/h<.65||w/h>1.55||Math.hypot(s[0].x-s.at(-1).x,s[0].y-s.at(-1).y)>Math.hypot(w,h)*.3)return null;const points=sampleBufferedInk([s],48),error=points.reduce((sum,p)=>sum+Math.abs(Math.hypot((p.x-cx)/(w/2),(p.y-cy)/(h/2))-1),0)/points.length;return error<.14?{...b,w,h,cx,cy}:null;}).filter(Boolean).sort((a,b)=>b.w*b.h-a.w*a.h);if(loops.length!==count)return false;return loops.every((loop,i)=>!i||(loop.w<loops[i-1].w*.88&&loop.h<loops[i-1].h*.88&&loop.left>loops[i-1].left-5&&loop.right<loops[i-1].right+5&&loop.top>loops[i-1].top-5&&loop.bottom<loops[i-1].bottom+5));}
export function recognizeBoundyBloonsPattern(strokes,isCurrent=()=>true){if(!isCurrent())return {valid:false,cancelled:true};const decision=analyzeSkillDrawing(strokes);return decision.skillId==='boundy-bloons'?decision:{valid:false,reason:'Draw 3 circles nested inside each other.'};}

function innerDiamondEvidence(strokes){const points=sampleBufferedInk(normalizeSkillStrokes(strokes),200).filter(p=>Math.hypot(p.x-100,p.y-100)<78),b=drawingBounds([points]);if(!b||b.right-b.left<35||b.bottom-b.top<35)return false;const cx=(b.left+b.right)/2,cy=(b.top+b.bottom)/2,rx=(b.right-b.left)/2,ry=(b.bottom-b.top)/2;if(Math.abs(cx-100)>28||Math.abs(cy-100)>28)return false;const error=points.reduce((sum,p)=>sum+Math.abs(Math.abs(p.x-cx)/rx+Math.abs(p.y-cy)/ry-1),0)/points.length;return error<.22;}

export function prstHonarsReferenceStrokes(){return [[[25,25],[100,10],[175,25],[170,100],[145,150],[100,190],[55,150],[30,100],[25,25]].map(([x,y])=>({x,y}))];}
export function recognizePrstHonarsPattern(strokes,isCurrent=()=>true){if(!isCurrent())return {valid:false,cancelled:true};const decision=analyzeSkillDrawing(strokes);return decision.skillId==='prst-honars'?decision:{valid:false,reason:'Draw a shield outline.'};}

export function badCookingReferenceStrokes(){return [[[80,30],[190,30],[190,150],[80,150],[80,30]],[[80,30],[10,15],[10,70],[80,70],[80,30]]].map(s=>s.map(([x,y])=>({x,y})));}
export function recognizeBadCookingPattern(strokes,isCurrent=()=>true){if(!isCurrent())return {valid:false,cancelled:true};const decision=analyzeSkillDrawing(strokes);return decision.skillId==='bad-cooking-ex'?decision:{valid:false,reason:'Draw a rectangular cleaver blade with a small handle to its left.'};}

function knifeEvidence(strokes){const clean=normalizeSkillStrokes(strokes);if(clean.length!==2)return false;const boxes=clean.map(stroke=>{const b=drawingBounds([stroke]);if(!b||Math.hypot(stroke[0].x-stroke.at(-1).x,stroke[0].y-stroke.at(-1).y)>55)return null;return {...b,w:b.right-b.left,h:b.bottom-b.top};});if(boxes.some(b=>!b))return false;boxes.sort((a,b)=>b.w*b.h-a.w*a.h);const [blade,handle]=boxes;return blade.h>100&&blade.w>75&&handle.w>35&&handle.h>25&&handle.h<blade.h*.7&&handle.left<blade.left-25&&Math.abs(handle.right-blade.left)<35&&handle.top<blade.top+35&&handle.bottom<blade.bottom-35;}

--- SNAPSHOT FILE: Development/slowdown-tuning.js | sha256=d3c8c752e2039f6fa09e2628aef64d6906c949557bcdb7b32df48a674206e05b | encoding=utf-8-sig ---
import {tuningPerk,slowdownTuningSettings} from './tuning-parts.js';
import {damageEnemy} from './world-state.js';
/** Temporary movement reduction, independent of permanent speed and knockback. */
export function applySlowdown(enemy,percent,seconds=5){
  if(enemy.hp<=0||!(percent>0)||!(seconds>0))return false;
  enemy.slowdownRemaining=Math.max(enemy.slowdownRemaining||0,seconds);
  enemy.slowdownPercent=percent;return true;
}
export function updateSlowdown(enemy,delta){
  enemy.ridingWaveSlowRemaining=Math.max(0,(enemy.ridingWaveSlowRemaining||0)-Math.max(0,delta));
  enemy.knockbackMovementRemaining=Math.max(0,(enemy.knockbackMovementRemaining||0)-Math.max(0,delta));
  enemy.flattenedRemaining=Math.max(0,(enemy.flattenedRemaining||0)-Math.max(0,delta));
  enemy.splashSlowRemaining=Math.max(0,(enemy.splashSlowRemaining||0)-Math.max(0,delta));
  if(enemy.splashSlowRemaining<1e-6){enemy.splashSlowRemaining=0;enemy.splashSlowPercent=0;}
  const dt=Math.max(0,delta),delay=enemy.waterRootDelay||0;
  enemy.waterRootDelay=Math.max(0,delay-dt);
  enemy.waterRootRemaining=Math.max(0,(enemy.waterRootRemaining||0)-Math.max(0,dt-delay));
  enemy.slowdownRemaining=Math.max(0,(enemy.slowdownRemaining||0)-Math.max(0,delta));
  if(enemy.slowdownRemaining<1e-6){enemy.slowdownRemaining=0;enemy.slowdownPercent=0;}
}
export function slowdownMultiplier(enemy){if(enemy.knockbackMovementRemaining>0||enemy.flattenedRemaining>0||enemy.waterRootDelay>0||enemy.waterRootRemaining>0)return 0;return Math.min(enemy.ridingWaveSlowRemaining>0?.5:1,enemy.slowdownRemaining>0?1-Math.min(100,Math.max(0,enemy.slowdownPercent||0))/100:1,enemy.splashSlowRemaining>0?1-Math.min(100,Math.max(0,enemy.splashSlowPercent||0))/100:1);}

/** Single bonus hit; does not recursively trigger itself or repeatedly tick. */
export function trySlowdownTuningHit({player,enemy,rollDamage,random=Math.random}){
  const main=player.mainWeaponId??(player.label==='Plana'?'plana-umbrella':null);
  if(main!=='plana-umbrella'||!player.tuningParts||enemy.hp<=0)return false;
  const chance=tuningPerk(player.tuningParts,'slowChance');if(!chance||random()>=chance)return false;
  if(!applySlowdown(enemy,tuningPerk(player.tuningParts,'slowPercent'),slowdownTuningSettings.seconds))return false;
  const hit=rollDamage(enemy,tuningPerk(player.tuningParts,'slowDamagePercent')/100);
  damageEnemy(enemy.id,hit.damage,player,hit.type,{slowdownTuning:true});return true;
}

const cache=new WeakMap();
const animationCache=new WeakMap();

/** Average every aligned pose once, then share one stable oval across the animation set. */
export function animationSpriteHurtbox(character,getFrameRectangle,padding=8) {
  const identity=character.animationFrames||character.image;
  let sizes=animationCache.get(identity);if(!sizes){sizes=new Map();animationCache.set(identity,sizes);}
  const size=character.spriteSize||89.6,key=`${size}:${character.referenceSize||215}:${JSON.stringify(character.gifPoseAnchors||{})}`;
  if(sizes.has(key))return sizes.get(key);
  const scale=(size-padding*2)/(character.referenceSize||215),poses=[];
  if(character.animationFrames) {
    const clips=[['normal',character.animationFrames],...Object.entries(character.actionAnimations||{})];
    for(const [name,frames] of clips)for(const frame of frames) {
      const image=frame.image,anchor=character.gifPoseAnchors?.[name];
      poses.push({image,crop:{x:0,y:0,width:image.naturalWidth,height:image.naturalHeight,footY:anchor?.footY??image.naturalHeight,anchorX:anchor?.anchorX}});
    }
  } else {
    for(const direction of Object.keys(character.rows||{}))for(let frame=0;frame<character.layout.columnEdges.length-1;frame++) {
      poses.push({image:character.image,crop:getFrameRectangle({...character,attack:null,moving:true,direction,facing:direction},frame)});
    }
    for(const name of Object.keys(character.attacks||{}))for(const facing of Object.keys(character.attacks[name].rows))
      for(let frame=0;frame<character.layout.columnEdges.length-1;frame++)
        poses.push({image:character.image,crop:getFrameRectangle({...character,attack:{name,facing}},frame)});
  }
  if(!poses.length)return null;
  for(const pose of poses) {
    const c=pose.crop;pose.width=c.width*scale;pose.height=c.height*scale;
    pose.x=c.anchorX===undefined?-pose.width/2:-(c.anchorX-c.x)*scale;
    pose.y=size/2-padding-(c.footY-c.y)*scale;
  }
  const left=Math.min(...poses.map(p=>p.x)),top=Math.min(...poses.map(p=>p.y));
  const width=Math.max(...poses.map(p=>p.x+p.width))-left,height=Math.max(...poses.map(p=>p.y+p.height))-top;
  const canvas=document.createElement('canvas');canvas.width=canvas.height=32;
  const context=canvas.getContext('2d',{willReadFrequently:true});
  // Add equal alpha contributions instead of source-over, so every pose has equal weight.
  context.globalCompositeOperation='lighter';context.globalAlpha=1/poses.length;
  for(const p of poses)context.drawImage(p.image,p.crop.x,p.crop.y,p.crop.width,p.crop.height,
    (p.x-left)/width*32,(p.y-top)/height*32,p.width/width*32,p.height/height*32);
  const mask=spriteDamageMask(canvas,{x:0,y:0,width:32,height:32});
  const result={offsetX:left+width/2,offsetY:top+height/2+(character.bossVisualOffsetY||0),width,height,mask};
  sizes.set(key,result);return result;
}
/** Fit one ellipse with at least 90% opaque-pixel coverage and the least empty area.
 * Diagnostics expose whether the requested <=5% empty-space target is geometrically possible.
 */
export function fitSpriteOval(runs) {
  const points=[];
  for(const run of runs)for(let i=0;i<Math.round(run.width*32);i++)
    points.push({x:run.x-run.width/2+(i+.5)/32,y:run.y});
  if(!points.length)return null;
  const xs=points.map(p=>p.x),ys=points.map(p=>p.y);
  const left=Math.min(...xs)-1/64,right=Math.max(...xs)+1/64,top=Math.min(...ys)-1/64,bottom=Math.max(...ys)+1/64;
  const width=right-left,height=bottom-top;
  const center={x:(left+right)/2,y:(top+bottom)/2};
  const centroid={x:xs.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)/points.length,y:ys.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)/points.length};
  let best=null;
  for(const c of [center,centroid,{x:center.x,y:centroid.y}])
    for(let a=0;a<=10;a++)for(let b=0;b<=10;b++) {
      const rx=width*(.4+a*.05),ry=height*(.4+b*.05);
      let inside=0;
      for(const p of points)if(((p.x-c.x)/rx)**2+((p.y-c.y)/ry)**2<=1)inside++;
      const coverage=inside/points.length;
      if(coverage<.9)continue;
      const emptyFraction=Math.max(0,1-inside/(1024*Math.PI*rx*ry));
      if(!best||emptyFraction<best.emptyFraction)best={...c,rx,ry,coverage,emptyFraction,meetsTargets:emptyFraction<=.05};
    }
  return best;
}
/** Cache a compact alpha silhouette per animation crop; transparent sprite-sheet padding cannot take hits. */
export function spriteDamageMask(image,crop) {
  let frames=cache.get(image);if(!frames){frames=new Map();cache.set(image,frames);}
  const key=[crop.x,crop.y,crop.width,crop.height].join(':');
  if(frames.has(key))return frames.get(key);
  const canvas=document.createElement('canvas');canvas.width=canvas.height=32;
  const context=canvas.getContext('2d',{willReadFrequently:true});
  context.drawImage(image,crop.x,crop.y,crop.width,crop.height,0,0,32,32);
  const pixels=context.getImageData(0,0,32,32).data,runs=[];
  for(let y=0;y<32;y++)for(let x=0;x<32;) {
    if(pixels[(y*32+x)*4+3]<32){x++;continue;}
    const start=x;while(x<32&&pixels[(y*32+x)*4+3]>=32)x++;
    runs.push({x:(start+x)/64,y:(y+.5)/32,width:(x-start)/32,height:1/32});
  }
  runs.ellipse=fitSpriteOval(runs);
  frames.set(key,runs);return runs;
}
