Try again later.');tx.set(ref,{count:count+1,startedAt:active?data.startedAt:now});});}
exports.usernameLogin=callable(createLoginHandler({
 limit:rateLimit,
 async lookup(name){const mapping=await db.doc('usernames/'+name).get();if(!mapping.exists)return null;try{const user=await auth.getUser(mapping.data().uid);return {uid:user.uid,email:user.email};}catch{return null;}},
 async verifyPassword(email,password){const response=await fetch('https://identitytoolkit.googleapis.com/v1/accounts:signInWithPassword?key='+encodeURIComponent(apiKey.value()),{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({email,password,returnSecureToken:true})});const result=await response.json();if(!response.ok)throw new HttpsError('unauthenticated','Username or password is incorrect.');return result.localId;},
 mintToken:uid=>auth.createCustomToken(uid)
}));
exports.claimUsername=callable(async request=>{const uid=owner(request),name=username(request.data?.username),profile=db.doc('accountProfiles/'+uid),alias=db.doc('usernames/'+name);await db.runTransaction(async tx=>{const prior=await tx.get(profile),target=await tx.get(alias),oldName=prior.data()?.username,old=oldName&&oldName!==name?db.doc('usernames/'+oldName):null,oldDoc=old?await tx.get(old):null;if(target.exists&&target.data().uid!==uid)throw new HttpsError('already-exists','That username is already taken.');if(oldDoc?.exists&&oldDoc.data().uid===uid)tx.delete(old);tx.set(alias,{uid,updatedAt:FieldValue.serverTimestamp()});tx.set(profile,{username:name,updatedAt:FieldValue.serverTimestamp()},{merge:true});});return {username:name};});
exports.getAccountProfile=callable(async request=>{const uid=owner(request),profile=await db.doc('accountProfiles/'+uid).get();return {username:profile.data()?.username||''};});
async function cleanup(uid){await db.runTransaction(async tx=>{const profile=db.doc('accountProfiles/'+uid),snapshot=await tx.get(profile),name=snapshot.data()?.username,alias=name?db.doc('usernames/'+name):null,mapping=alias?await tx.get(alias):null;if(mapping?.exists&&mapping.data().uid===uid)tx.delete(alias);tx.delete(profile);tx.delete(db.doc('accountSaves/'+uid));});}
exports.deleteAccount=callable(async request=>{const uid=recent(request);await auth.deleteUser(uid);await cleanup(uid);return {deleted:true};});

 function finish(index){const b=books[index];if(b.trail.length)fadingTrails.push({area:b.area,trail:b.trail});books.splice(index,1);}
 function cast(player,angle=0){
  const weapon=player.attackSlots?.find(w=>w?.id==='student-handbook');if(!weapon)return false;
  if(owner!==player){reset();owner=player;}while(books.length)finish(books.length-1);
  exRemaining=strictRulesSettings.duration;const count=startingWeaponProjectileCount(player,'student-handbook',studentHandbookLevelStats(weapon.level).count);
  strictRulesSettings.ringScales.forEach((scale,index)=>fire(player,weapon,angle,scale,index*Math.PI/count));return true;
 }
 function update(delta,player,angle=0){
  const weapon=player.attackSlots?.find(w=>w?.id==='student-handbook');if(!weapon){reset();return;}
  if(owner!==player){reset();owner=player;}if(!(delta>0))return;
  let left=delta,index=null;
  while(left>1e-8){
   if(enabled&&exRemaining<=1e-8&&cooldown<=1e-8){fire(player,weapon,angle);cooldown=Math.max(s.minimumInterval,attackTimeFormula(s.interval*(player.tuningParts?stationaryWeaponIntervalScale(player):1),ensureCombatStats(player).hastePercent));}
   const dt=Math.min(left,1/120,enabled&&cooldown>1e-8?cooldown:1/120);left-=dt;time+=dt;cooldown=Math.max(0,cooldown-dt);exRemaining=Math.max(0,exRemaining-dt);
   for(let i=fadingTrails.length-1;i>=0;i--){ageTrail(fadingTrails[i].trail,dt);if(!fadingTrails[i].trail.length)fadingTrails.splice(i,1);}
   if(!books.length)continue;if(!index)index=createEnemySpatialIndex(getAllEnemies(),getEnemyHurtbox);
   const center=getCombatHitbox(player,false);
   for(let i=books.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    const b=books[i],from={x:b.x,y:b.y};b.age+=dt;
    const pose=studentHandbookPose(b.age,b.duration,b.retiringAt,b.retiringScale);
    if((b.retiringAt===null&&b.age>=b.duration-1e-8)||(b.retiringAt!==null&&b.age-b.retiringAt>=s.returnSeconds-1e-8)){finish(i);continue;}
    if(b.retiringAt===null)b.angle=b.phase+b.speed/b.radius*b.age;
    b.x=center.x+Math.cos(b.angle)*b.radius*pose.scale;b.y=center.y+Math.sin(b.angle)*b.radius*pose.scale;
    ageTrail(b.trail,dt);b.trailElapsed+=dt;
    if(b.trailElapsed>=s.trailInterval-1e-8){b.trailElapsed%=s.trailInterval;b.trail.push({x:b.x,y:b.y,angle:Math.sin(b.angle)*.12,scale:pose.scale,age:0});if(b.trail.length>s.trailCount)b.trail.shift();}
    if(b.retiringAt!==null||pose.scale<=0)continue;
    const radius=s.hitRadius*b.area*pose.scale;
    const candidates=index.querySegment(from,b,radius).filter(enemy=>{if(!getEnemy(enemy.id)||time-(b.hits.get(enemy.id)??-Infinity)<s.hitCooldown-1e-8)return false;const body=getEnemyHurtbox(enemy);return segmentHitsBody({...body,rx:body.rx+radius,ry:body.ry+radius},from.x,from.y,b.x,b.y);});
    for(const enemy of candidates){
     if(!getEnemy(enemy.id))continue;b.hits.set(enemy.id,time);
     const hit=rollAttackDamage(player,totalWeaponDamage(player,'student-handbook',s.damage,b.damageBonuses,{projectileCount:b.count,hitCooldownFrames:s.hitCooldown*60}),random,{target:enemy,weaponId:'student-handbook',damageMod:b.damageMultiplier,skillAttack:b.exSkill});
     if(damageEnemy(enemy.id,hit.damage,player,hit.type,{canMiss:true,weaponId:'student-handbook'})===false)continue;
     b.hitsLeft--;const target=getEnemy(enemy.id);
     if(target){const body=getEnemyHurtbox(target),direction=Math.atan2(body.y-center.y,body.x-center.x),distance=s.knockbackSpeed*s.knockbackSeconds*weaponKnockbackMultiplier(player)*b.knockbackMultiplier;
      const motion=beginKnockback(target,Math.cos(direction)*distance,Math.sin(direction)*distance,s.knockbackSeconds);
      if(motion){target.skillKnockback=motion;target.knockbackMovementRemaining=Math.max(target.knockbackMovementRemaining||0,s.knockbackSeconds);}
     }
     if(b.hitsLeft<=0)break;
    }
    if(b.hitsLeft<=0){b.retiringAt=b.age;b.retiringScale=pose.scale;}
   }
  }
 }
 function drawPose(context,camera,b,pose,alpha,shrink=1){
  const scale=b.area*pose.scale*shrink;if(scale<=0)return;
  context.save();context.globalAlpha=alpha;context.translate(pose.x-camera.x,pose.y-camera.y);context.rotate(pose.angle);context.scale(scale,scale);context.drawImage(image,48,12,200,228,-s.width/2,-s.height/2,s.width,s.height);context.restore();
 }
 function drawTrail(context,camera,b){for(const ghost of b.trail){const fade=Math.max(0,1-ghost.age/s.trailDuration);drawPose(context,camera,b,ghost,.25*fade*fade,fade);}}
 function draw(context,camera){
  if(!image?.complete||!image.naturalWidth)return;
  for(const b of fadingTrails)drawTrail(context,camera,b);
  for(const b of books){drawTrail(context,camera,b);const pose=studentHandbookPose(b.age,b.duration,b.retiringAt,b.retiringScale);drawPose(context,camera,b,{x:b.x,y:b.y,angle:Math.sin(b.angle)*.12,scale:pose.scale},pose.alpha);}
 }

}

from pathlib import Path

            Java(TM) Cryptography Extension Policy Files
    for the Java(TM) Platform, Standard Edition Runtime Environment

                               README
------------------------------------------------------------------------

Import and export control rules on cryptographic software vary from
country to country.  The Java Cryptography Extension (JCE) architecture
allows flexible cryptographic key strength to be configured via the
jurisdiction policy files which are referenced by the "crypto.policy"
security property in the <java-home>/conf/security/java.security file.

By default, Java provides two different sets of cryptographic policy
files:

    unlimited:  These policy files contain no restrictions on cryptographic
                strengths or algorithms

    limited:    These policy files contain more restricted cryptographic
                strengths

These files reside in <java-home>/conf/security/policy in the "unlimited"
or "limited" subdirectories respectively.

Each subdirectory contains a complete policy configuration,
and subdirectories can be added/edited/removed to reflect your
import or export control product requirements.

Within a subdirectory, the effective policy is the combined minimum
permissions of the grant statements in the file(s) matching the filename
pattern "default_*.policy".  At least one grant is required.  For example:

    limited   =  Export (all) + Import (limited)  =  Limited
    unlimited =  Export (all) + Import (all)      =  Unlimited

The effective exemption policy is the combined minimum permissions
of the grant statements in the file(s) matching the filename pattern
"exempt_*.policy".  Exemption grants are optional.  For example:

    limited   =  grants exemption permissions, by which the
                 effective policy can be circumvented.
                 e.g.  KeyRecovery/KeyEscrow/KeyWeakening.

Please see the Java Cryptography Architecture (JCA) documentation for
additional information on these files and formats.

YOU ARE ADVISED TO CONSULT YOUR EXPORT/IMPORT CONTROL COUNSEL OR ATTORNEY
TO DETERMINE THE EXACT REQUIREMENTS.

Please note that the JCE for Java SE, including the JCE framework,
cryptographic policy files, and standard JCE providers provided with
the Java SE, have been reviewed and approved for export as mass market
encryption item by the US Bureau of Industry and Security.

```
by patents owned by IBM, AT&T, and Mitsubishi.  Hence arithmetic coding
cannot legally be used without obtaining one or more licenses.  For this
reason, support for arithmetic coding has been removed from the free
JPEG software. (Since arithmetic coding provides only a marginal gain
over the unpatented Huffman mode, it is unlikely that very many
implementations will support it.) So far as we are aware, there are
no patent restrictions on the remaining code.

The IJG distribution formerly included code to read and write GIF files.
To avoid entanglement with the Unisys LZW patent, GIF reading support
has been removed altogether, and the GIF writer has been simplified to
produce "uncompressed GIFs".  This technique does not use the LZW algorithm;
the resulting GIF files are larger than usual, but are readable by all
standard GIF decoders.

We are required to state that "The Graphics Interchange Format(c) is
the Copyright property of CompuServe Incorporated.  GIF(sm) is a
Service Mark property of CompuServe Incorporated."

****************************************************************************
```

--- SNAPSHOT FILE: public/firebase-client.js | sha256=f89488ef04945d220e3f51df00e4b9071a671d0f7764bf05ac294fbef1158ba0 | encoding=utf-8-sig ---
import { firebaseConfig } from './firebase-config.js';

let authPromise;

/** Load Firebase once and share the same Authentication instance across callers. */
export function getFirebaseAuth() {
  const requiredFields = ['apiKey', 'authDomain', 'projectId', 'appId'];

  if (requiredFields.some(field => !firebaseConfig[field]?.trim())) {
    const error = new Error('Firebase web configuration is missing.');
    error.code = 'app/missing-config';
    return Promise.reject(error);
  }

  if (!authPromise) {
    authPromise = initializeAuthentication().catch(error => {
      // Allow another attempt after a temporary SDK download or startup failure.
      authPromise = undefined;
      throw error;
    });
  }

  return authPromise;
}

/** Download the modular SDK and initialize Firebase with the web app settings. */
async function initializeAuthentication() {
  const [appSdk, sdk] = await Promise.all([
    import('https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/13.1.0/firebase-app.js'),
    import('https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/13.1.0/firebase-auth.js')
  ]);

  const app = appSdk.initializeApp(firebaseConfig);
  const auth = sdk.getAuth(app);

  // Keep the user signed in for this browser tab, including page navigation.
  await sdk.setPersistence(auth, sdk.browserSessionPersistence);

  return { auth, sdk };
}

/** Check whether this tab entered through the confirmed guest option. */
export function isGuestSession() {
  try { return sessionStorage.getItem(guestSessionKey) === '1'; }
  catch { return false; }
}

/** Begin guest access without creating a Firebase account or saving upgrades. */
export function startGuestSession() {
  sessionStorage.setItem(guestSessionKey, '1');
}

/** Return to account mode after a successful sign-in or registration. */
export function endGuestSession() {
  try { sessionStorage.removeItem(guestSessionKey); }
  catch { /* Storage may be disabled; an absent guest marker is already account mode. */ }
}

  const manual=document.currentScript.hasAttribute('data-game-loading');
  let completed=0,total=1,loaded=false,finished=false,screen,bar,label;

  function render() {
    const percent=finished?100:Math.min(95,Math.round(completed/Math.max(1,total)*95));

--- SNAPSHOT FILE: public/login-splash.js | sha256=c4a1a3559c32a17b5626d0a9e968d328b3dcbd5627797ba611fb029afdcd69a4 | encoding=utf-8-sig ---
/** Rotate the login art without disturbing the form or its diagonal background fade. */
function startLoginSplash() {
  const container=document.querySelector('.login-splash');
  if(!container)return;
  const images=[...container.querySelectorAll('img')];
  let current=0,timer=null,transitioning=false;

  /** Fade the next decoded image in from the right over the still-visible current artwork. */
  function showNext() {
    if(document.hidden||transitioning)return;
    const next=(current+1)%images.length;
    if(!images[next].complete||!images[next].naturalWidth)return;
    transitioning=true;
    images[next].classList.add('is-entering');
  }

  /** Promote the incoming layer only after its reveal finishes, avoiding a blank frame. */
  container.addEventListener('animationend',event=>{
    if(!event.target.classList.contains('is-entering'))return;
    images[current].classList.remove('is-current');
    current=images.indexOf(event.target);
    images[current].classList.add('is-current');
    images[current].classList.remove('is-entering');
    transitioning=false;
  });

  /** Restart the ten-second interval after returning to the tab; never queue missed changes. */
  function resume() {
    clearInterval(timer);
    if(!document.hidden)timer=setInterval(showNext,10000);
  }
  document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',resume);
  window.addEventListener('pagehide',()=>clearInterval(timer));
  window.addEventListener('pageshow',resume);
  // Decode up front so a large splash cannot flash or stall when first revealed.
  Promise.allSettled(images.map(image=>image.decode())).then(resume);
}

startLoginSplash();

import { getFirebaseAuth } from './firebase-client.js';
import { isAdmin } from './admin-access.js';
import { isGuestSession } from './guest-session.js';

const developmentLink = document.querySelector('#development-link');

/** Wait for Firebase to restore the session before allowing workspace access. */
async function requireSignIn() {
  // Guests can enter the empty workspace without Firebase, and never see admin controls.
  if (isGuestSession()) {
    developmentLink.hidden = true;
    window.location.replace('Game/movement.html');
    return;
  }
  try {
    const { auth, sdk } = await getFirebaseAuth();

    sdk.onAuthStateChanged(auth, user => {
      developmentLink.hidden = isGuestSession() || !isAdmin(user);
      if (!user) {
        window.location.replace('index.html');
      } else window.location.replace('Game/movement.html');
    }, () => {
      developmentLink.hidden = true;
      window.location.replace('index.html');
    });
  } catch {
    // Keep the workspace visually empty; setup and login happen on index.html.
    window.location.replace('index.html');
  }
}

requireSignIn();

import {isAdmin} from './admin-access.js';

import { getFirebaseAuth } from './firebase-client.js';

// Cache the form elements used by the authentication controls.
const form = document.querySelector('#auth-form');
const password = document.querySelector('#password');
const message = document.querySelector('#message');
const submit = form.querySelector('[type="submit"]');
const guestButton = document.querySelector('#continue-as-guest');
const guestDialog = document.querySelector('#guest-confirmation');
let registering = false;
const adminLoginRequested=typeof URLSearchParams==='function'&&new URLSearchParams(window.location.search||'').get('admin')==='1';


/** Switch between login and registration, updating fields and button labels. */
function toggleAuthMode() {
  registering = !registering;
  document.querySelector('#name-field').hidden = !registering;
  document.querySelector('#email').type=registering?'email':'text';
  document.querySelector('label[for="email"]').textContent=registering?'Email address':'Email or username';
  document.querySelector('#name').required = registering;
  document.querySelector('#password-hint').hidden = !registering;
  password.minLength = registering ? 8 : 1;
  password.autocomplete = registering ? 'new-password' : 'current-password';
  document.querySelector('#form-title').textContent = registering
    ? 'Create an account'
    : 'Welcome back, Sensei';
  document.querySelector('#form-description').textContent = registering
    ? 'Create your Sensei profile.'
    : 'Log in to continue.';
  document.querySelector('#submit-label').textContent = registering
    ? 'Create account'
    : 'Log in';
  document.querySelector('#switch-prompt').textContent = registering
    ? 'Already have an account?'
    : "Don't have an account?";
  document.querySelector('#switch-mode').textContent = registering
    ? 'Log in'
    : 'Create an account';
  document.title = registering
    ? 'Schale | Create account'
    : 'Schale | Log in';
  message.textContent = '';
  password.value = '';
}

/** Show or hide the password and update the button's accessible state. */
function togglePasswordVisibility(event) {
  const visible = password.type === 'password';
  password.type = visible ? 'text' : 'password';
  event.currentTarget.textContent = visible ? 'Hide' : 'Show';
  event.currentTarget.setAttribute('aria-label', visible ? 'Hide password' : 'Show password');
  event.currentTarget.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(visible));
}

/** Translate Firebase failures into useful messages without exposing raw errors. */
function getAuthErrorMessage(error) {
  const messages = {
    'auth/email-already-in-use': 'This email already has an account. Please log in.',
    'auth/invalid-email': 'Please enter a valid email address.',
    'auth/invalid-credential': 'Email or password is incorrect. Please try again.',
    'auth/user-not-found': 'Email or password is incorrect. Please try again.',
    'auth/wrong-password': 'Email or password is incorrect. Please try again.',
    'auth/weak-password': 'Choose a stronger password with at least 8 characters.',
    'auth/password-does-not-meet-requirements': 'Your password does not meet the account password policy.',
    'auth/too-many-requests': 'Too many attempts. Please wait and try again.',
    'auth/network-request-failed': 'Unable to connect. Check your internet connection.',
    'auth/user-disabled': 'This account has been disabled.',
    'auth/operation-not-allowed': 'Email/password sign-in must be enabled in Firebase Console.',
    'auth/invalid-api-key': 'Firebase configuration is invalid. Check firebase-config.js.',
    'app/admin-required': 'Development requires your primary developer account. Please sign in with that account.',
    'app/username-unavailable': 'Username sign-in is not available yet. Please use your email address.',
    'app/missing-config': 'Add your Firebase web configuration to firebase-config.js first.'
  };

  return messages[error.code] || 'Authentication is unavailable. Please try again later.';
}

/** Register or sign in through Firebase, then open the empty project workspace. */
async function handleAuthSubmit(event) {
  event.preventDefault();
  message.textContent = '';

  const email = document.querySelector('#email').value.trim();
  const name = document.querySelector('#name').value.trim();
  const switchButton = document.querySelector('#switch-mode');

  if (registering && !name) {
    message.textContent = 'Please enter your Sensei name.';
    return;
  }

  // Prevent mode changes or repeated submissions while authentication is pending.
  submit.disabled = true;
  guestButton.disabled = true;
  switchButton.disabled = true;
  form.setAttribute('aria-busy', 'true');

  try {
    const { auth, sdk } = await getFirebaseAuth();

    if (registering) {
      const credential = await sdk.createUserWithEmailAndPassword(
        auth,
        email,
        password.value
      );

      // Account creation already signs the user in. A profile error must not
      // suggest that registration failed and prompt duplicate registrations.
      try {
        await sdk.updateProfile(credential.user, { displayName: name });
      } catch {
        console.warn('Account created; display name could not be saved.');
      }
    } else {
      await signInWithIdentifier(email,password.value);
    }

    password.value = '';
    if(adminLoginRequested&&!isAdmin(auth.currentUser))throw Object.assign(Error('Primary developer login required'),{code:'app/admin-required'});
    endGuestSession();
    window.location.assign(adminLoginRequested?'Development/index.html':'project.html');
  } catch (error) {
    message.textContent = getAuthErrorMessage(error);
  } finally {
    submit.disabled = false;
    guestButton.disabled = false;
    switchButton.disabled = false;
    form.removeAttribute('aria-busy');
  }
}

// Connect the page controls to their event handlers.
document.querySelector('#switch-mode').addEventListener('click', toggleAuthMode);
document.querySelector('.reveal').addEventListener('click', togglePasswordVisibility);
form.addEventListener('submit', handleAuthSubmit);

/** Ask before entering an unsaved guest session; Cancel and Escape keep the login page. */
guestButton.addEventListener('click', () => {
  guestDialog.returnValue = '';
  guestDialog.showModal();
});
guestDialog.addEventListener('close', () => {
  if (guestDialog.returnValue !== 'continue') return;
  try {
    startGuestSession();
    window.location.assign('project.html');
  } catch {
    message.textContent = 'Guest access needs session storage. Allow it in your browser and try again.';
  }
});

/** Right-click dismisses the guest confirmation just like Cancel. */
guestDialog.addEventListener('pointerdown', event => {
  if (event.button !== 2) return;
  event.preventDefault();
  event.stopPropagation();
  guestDialog.close('cancel');
});
guestDialog.addEventListener('contextmenu', event => event.preventDefault());

if(usernameServiceEnabled){document.querySelector('#email').type='text';document.querySelector('label[for="email"]').textContent='Email or username';}

if(adminLoginRequested){document.querySelector('#form-title').textContent='Developer sign-in';document.querySelector('#form-description').textContent='Sign in with your main developer account to open Development.';document.querySelector('#switch-mode').hidden=true;document.querySelector('#switch-prompt').hidden=true;guestButton.hidden=true;}

export async function signInWithIdentifier(identifier,password){
 const {auth,sdk}=await getFirebaseAuth(),alias=resolveLoginAlias(identifier);if(alias||identifier.includes('@'))return sdk.signInWithEmailAndPassword(auth,alias||identifier,password);
 if(!usernameServiceEnabled)throw Object.assign(Error('Username sign-in is not available yet. Please use your email address.'),{code:'app/username-unavailable'});
 const functions=await import('https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/13.1.0/firebase-functions.js');
 const result=await functions.httpsCallable(functions.getFunctions(auth.app,accountServiceRegion),'usernameLogin')({username:identifier,password});
 return sdk.signInWithCustomToken(auth,result.data.token);
}

import { getFirebaseAuth } from '../firebase-client.js';
import { isAdmin } from '../admin-access.js';
import { isGuestSession } from '../guest-session.js';

/** Reveal development content only after Firebase confirms the admin session. */
export async function requireAdmin() {
  if(document.documentElement?.dataset.runtime==='live')return (await import('./game-access.js')).requireGameAccess();
  const content = document.querySelector('#development-content');
  if (isGuestSession()) {
    content.hidden = true;
    window.location.replace('../project.html');
    return false;
  }

  try {
    const { auth, sdk } = await getFirebaseAuth();

    return await new Promise(resolve => {
      sdk.onAuthStateChanged(auth, user => {
        const allowed = isAdmin(user);
        content.hidden = !allowed;

        if (!allowed) {
          window.location.replace('../index.html?admin=1');
        }

        resolve(allowed);
      }, () => {
        content.hidden = true;
        window.location.replace('../index.html');
        resolve(false);
      });
    });
  } catch {
    content.hidden = true;
    window.location.replace('../index.html');
    return false;
  }
}

/** Match handwritten 1Ã¢â‚¬â€œ6 locally, without downloading or calling either AI model. */
export function recognizeAdminDigit(strokes) {
  const bounds = drawingBounds(strokes);
  if (!bounds) return null;
  const width = bounds.right - bounds.left, height = bounds.bottom - bounds.top;
  if (height > 0 && width / height < .18) return 1;
  const ranked = Object.entries(adminDigitTemplates).map(([digit, template]) =>
    ({ digit: Number(digit), score: drawingAccuracy(strokes, template) })).sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score);
  return ranked[0].score >= .45 && ranked[0].score - ranked[1].score >= .025 ? ranked[0].digit : null;
}

/** Resolve a slot only when it contains a weapon with an implemented EX effect. */
export function adminSkillResult(player, slot) {
  const weapon = player.attackSlots?.[slot];
  const skillId = skillIds[weapon?.id];
  return skillId ? { valid: true, adminTest: true, weapon, skillId,
    label: weapon.skillName || weapon.name || weapon.id, score: 1, accuracy: skillCastSettings.accuracyAverage,
    damageMultiplier: skillCastSettings.damageAverage, components: [] }
    : { valid: false, reason: `Slot ${slot + 1} has no implemented EX skill.` };
}

--- SNAPSHOT FILE: public/Development/aiming.js | sha256=e21246da84dd7286b5d1cad65db16acea91183a0155b23bcf118b11f585049b1 | encoding=utf-8-sig ---
import { normalSpriteSize } from './scene-metrics.js';
/** Convert browser pointer coordinates to internal canvas pixels after CSS scaling. */
export function pointerToCanvas(clientX, clientY, rectangle, width, height) {
  return {
    x: (clientX - rectangle.left) * width / rectangle.width,
    y: (clientY - rectangle.top) * height / rectangle.height
  };
}

/** Load the supplied aiming artwork without changing project image files. */
function loadAimImage(source) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const image = new Image();
    image.onload = () => resolve(image);
    image.onerror = () => reject(new Error(`Could not load ${source}.`));
    image.src = source;
  });
}

/** Manage independent arrow visibility and click-to-toggle cursor aiming. */
export function createAiming(canvas) {
  const toggle = document.querySelector('#toggle-arrow');
  const modeLabel = document.querySelector('#aim-mode');
  const state = { visible: true, cursorAim: false, directionalOverride: false, inside: false, pointer: { x: 0, y: 0 } };
  let arrow;
  let crosshair;

  // EDIT these values to tune the aiming sprites in internal canvas pixels.
  const arrowWidth = 24.36; // Another 30% smaller than 34.8 pixels.
  const arrowHeight = 13.02; // Preserve proportions at the reduced size.
  const crosshairSize = 75.712; // 30% larger than the previous 58.24 pixels.
  const arrowDistanceMultiplier = 0.9; // Extra clearance below the player sprite.
  const ready = Promise.all([
    loadAimImage('../sprites/arrow.png'),
    loadAimImage('../sprites/crosshair.png')
  ]).then(images => { [arrow, crosshair] = images; });

  /** Keep UI and native cursor in sync with the selected aiming mode. */
  function updateControls() {
    toggle.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(state.visible));
    toggle.textContent = state.visible ? 'Arrow: shown' : 'Arrow: hidden';
    modeLabel.textContent = state.cursorAim && !state.directionalOverride ? 'Aim: crosshair' : 'Aim: character facing';
    canvas.style.cursor = state.cursorAim && !state.directionalOverride && state.inside ? 'none' : 'default';
  }

  /** Track the pointer in screen space, so camera scrolling cannot offset aiming. */
  function trackPointer(event) {
    state.pointer = pointerToCanvas(event.clientX, event.clientY,
      canvas.getBoundingClientRect(), canvas.width, canvas.height);
    state.inside = true;
    updateControls();
  }

  toggle.addEventListener('click', () => {
    state.visible = !state.visible;
    updateControls();
  });
  canvas.addEventListener('pointermove', trackPointer);
  canvas.addEventListener('pointerenter', trackPointer);
  canvas.addEventListener('pointerleave', () => {
    state.inside = false;
    updateControls();
  });
  canvas.addEventListener('click', event => {
    if (event.button !== 0) return;
    trackPointer(event);
    state.cursorAim = !state.cursorAim;
    updateControls();
  });

  /** Share the exact arrow angle with attacks, including cursor aiming. */
  function getAngle(character, cameraX, vector, cameraY = 0) {
    const x = character.x - cameraX;
    const y = character.y - cameraY;
    let dx = vector[0];
    let dy = vector[1];
    if (state.cursorAim && !state.directionalOverride) {
      dx = state.pointer.x - x;
      dy = state.pointer.y - y;
      // Preserve facing if the cursor is precisely on the character anchor.
      if (dx === 0 && dy === 0) [dx, dy] = vector;
    }
    return Math.atan2(dy, dx)+(character.sportsDrinkAimOffset||0);
  }

  /** Draw an upward-native arrow rotated toward facing or the custom cursor. */
  function draw(context, character, cameraX, vector, cameraY = 0) {
    if (!arrow || !crosshair) return;
    const x = character.x - cameraX;
    const y = character.y - cameraY;
    const angle = getAngle(character, cameraX, vector, cameraY);
    if (state.visible) {
      const distance = ((character.spriteSize || normalSpriteSize) / 2 + 25) * arrowDistanceMultiplier;
      context.save();
      context.translate(x + Math.cos(angle) * distance, y + Math.sin(angle) * distance);
      context.rotate(angle + Math.PI / 2);
      context.drawImage(arrow, -arrowWidth / 2, -arrowHeight / 2, arrowWidth, arrowHeight);
      context.restore();
    }
    if (state.cursorAim && !state.directionalOverride && state.inside) {
      context.drawImage(crosshair,
        state.pointer.x - crosshairSize / 2, state.pointer.y - crosshairSize / 2,
        crosshairSize, crosshairSize);
    }
  }

  /** Return to facing-based aiming without overriding the visibility preference. */
  function reset() {
    state.cursorAim = false;
    updateControls();
  }

  updateControls();
  return { ready, draw, reset, state, getAngle, trackPointer,
    setPointerInside(inside) { state.inside = inside; updateControls(); },
    setDirectionalOverride(enabled) { state.directionalOverride = Boolean(enabled); updateControls(); }
  };
}

/** Fit the whole sheet once; narrower attack crops must never enlarge individual frames. */
export function lineupSheetScale(template) {
  const layout=template.layout;
  let width=0,height=0;
  for(let frame=0;frame<layout.columnEdges.length-1;frame++) {
    for(let row=0;row<layout.rowEdges[frame].length-1;row++) {
      const crop=layout.frames?.[row]?.[frame];
      width=Math.max(width,crop?.width ?? layout.columnEdges[frame+1]-layout.columnEdges[frame]);
      height=Math.max(height,crop?.height ?? layout.rowEdges[frame][row+1]-layout.rowEdges[frame][row]);
    }
  }
  return Math.min(((template.spriteSize || normalSpriteSize)-spriteDisplayPadding*2)/(template.referenceSize||215),200/width,205/height);
}

        }
        if(direction!==(template.nativeFacing||'left'))context.scale(-1,1);
        context.drawImage(frame.image,-frame.image.naturalWidth*scale/2,-frame.image.naturalHeight*scale,frame.image.naturalWidth*scale,frame.image.naturalHeight*scale);context.restore();continue;
      }
      const sequence=template.walkFrames?.[direction]||template.frameSequence||[1,2,3,4];
      const frame=sequence[Math.floor(elapsed/(template.frameDuration||110))%sequence.length];
      const row=template.rows[direction];
      if(row===undefined)continue;
      const layout=template.layout,x=layout.columnEdges[frame],y=layout.rowEdges[frame][row];
      const crop=layout.frames?.[row]?.[frame]||{x,y,width:layout.columnEdges[frame+1]-x,
        height:layout.rowEdges[frame][row+1]-y,anchorX:layout.anchorX?.[row]?.[frame],footY:layout.rowEdges[frame][row+1]};
      const scale=sheetScale;
      const mirrored=template.mirroredDirections?.includes(direction);
      const bounce=template.movementBounce;
      const hop=bounce?-bounce.height*Math.sin(Math.PI*(elapsed/1000/bounce.periodSeconds+index*.61803398875))**2:0;
      context.save();context.translate(110,185+hop);if(mirrored)context.scale(-1,1);
      context.drawImage(template.image,crop.x,crop.y,crop.width,crop.height,
        crop.anchorX===undefined?-crop.width*scale/2:-(crop.anchorX-crop.x)*scale,
        -(crop.footY-crop.y)*scale,crop.width*scale,crop.height*scale);
      context.restore();
    }
    request=requestAnimationFrame(draw);
  }
  dialog.addEventListener('close',()=>{cancelAnimationFrame(request);dialog.remove();},{once:true});
  dialog.addEventListener('contextmenu',event=>{event.preventDefault();dialog.close();});
  request=requestAnimationFrame(draw);
}

import { weaponSizeMultiplier, weaponKnockbackMultiplier } from './game-config.js';
import {stationaryWeaponIntervalScale} from './tuning-parts.js';
import {startingWeaponAim} from './tuning-parts.js';
import {rgbTuningActive,rainbowTrailGradient} from './rgb-tuning.js';
import { arisWeaponSettings, attackTimeFormula, supernovaSkillSettings, arisBeamVisualSettings } from './game-config.js';
import { statMultiplier, ensureCombatStats, rollAttackDamage, totalWeaponDamage } from './combat-stats.js';
import { getAllEnemies, getEnemy, damageEnemy } from './world-state.js';

import { applySkillControl } from './enemy-control.js';

/** Create Supernova with independent automatic and EX attacks. */
export function createArisWeapon() {
  return { id: 'aris-laser', name: 'Supernova', icon: '../sprites/attacks/Weapon_Icon_Arisu.png',
    level: 1, iconRotation: -45, exSkill: true, defaultUnlocked: false, unlockObjective: 'Defeat the boss in Stage 2' };
}

/** Find the equipped laser, independently of every other automatic weapon. */
export function getArisWeapon(player) {
  return player.attackSlots?.find(weapon => weapon?.id === 'aris-laser');
}

/** Size bonuses add to base width; level7 adds a rear beam to each volley. */
export function arisLevelStats(player) {
  const level = Math.max(1, Math.min(7, getArisWeapon(player)?.level || 1));
  return { level, size: 1 + (level >= 2 ? .3 : 0) + (level >= 6 ? .5 : 0),
    damage: level >= 4 ? 1.5 : 1,
    interval: arisWeaponSettings.attackInterval - (level >= 3 ? .5 : 0) - (level >= 5 ? .5 : 0),
    beams: level >= 7 ? 2 : 1 };
}

/** Roll the supplied27-33base damage range, then weapon levels and player ATK/crit. */
export function rollArisDamage(player, random = Math.random, target, damageMod = 1, skillAttack = false) {
  const s = arisWeaponSettings;
  return rollAttackDamage(player, totalWeaponDamage(player, 'aris-laser', s.damageMultiplier,
    [(arisLevelStats(player).damage - 1) * 100],
    { projectileCount: arisLevelStats(player).beams, hitCooldownFrames: s.hitCooldown * 60 }), random, { target, damageMod, skillAttack });
}

/** Invisible piercing capsule starts at the player, bridging the decorative muzzle gap. */
export function arisBeamHits(enemy, origin, angle, width, length = arisWeaponSettings.beamLength) {
  const body = getEnemyHurtbox(enemy);
  return segmentHitsBody({ ...body, rx: body.rx + width / 2, ry: body.ry + width / 2 },
    origin.x, origin.y, origin.x + Math.cos(angle) * length, origin.y + Math.sin(angle) * length);
}

/** Own an independent automatic laser cycle alongside all other equipped autoattacks. */
export function createArisAttack({getWeapon=getArisWeapon,specialHitCooldown=supernovaSkillSettings.hitCooldown,
  rollSpecialDamage=(player,enemy,multiplier)=>rollArisDamage(player,Math.random,enemy,multiplier,true),onSpecialHit=()=>{}}={}) {
  let autoattackEnabled = true;
  let special = null;
  let owner = null, cooldown = 0, clock = 0, volleys = [];
  let stationaryScale=1;
  const hitTimes = new Map();
  function clear() { special = null; owner = null; cooldown = 0; clock = 0; volleys = []; hitTimes.clear(); }
  const s = arisWeaponSettings;
  const image = new Image();
  image.src = new URL('../sprites/attacks/Weapon_Icon_Arisu.png', import.meta.url).href;
  const ready = image.decode();
  return {
    ready,
    getAuraSources(){return volleys.map(v=>v.origin).filter(Boolean);},
    reset: clear,
    /** Remove automatic volleys only; an active EX continues updating and dealing damage. */
    setAutoattackEnabled(enabled) { autoattackEnabled=Boolean(enabled); if(!autoattackEnabled) volleys=[]; },
    /** Start a continuous, independently aimable EX; shared per-target cooldown prevents frame damage. */
    cast(player, angle, damageMultiplier = 1.5, getAngle = () => angle) {
      if (owner !== player) { clear(); owner = player; }
      volleys = []; // Cancel the current automatic beam before the EX opening.
      const turn=value=>player.tuningParts?startingWeaponAim(player,getWeapon(player)?.id,value):value;
      special = { player, angle:turn(angle), getAngle:()=>turn(getAngle()), damageMultiplier, elapsed: 0, hits: new Map() };
    },
    update(delta, player, aim) {
      if (!getWeapon(player)) { clear(); return; }
      if (owner !== player) { clear(); owner = player; }
      if(player.tuningParts)aim=startingWeaponAim(player,getWeapon(player)?.id,aim);
      const intervalScale=player.tuningParts?stationaryWeaponIntervalScale(player):1;
      cooldown*=intervalScale/stationaryScale;stationaryScale=intervalScale;
      clock += delta;
      if (special) {
        special.elapsed += delta;
        special.angle = special.getAngle();
        if (supernovaBeamPhase(special.elapsed).finished || special.player !== player) special = null;
      }
      for (const [id, time] of hitTimes) if (clock-time > s.hitCooldown+s.beamSeconds) hitTimes.delete(id);
      if (autoattackEnabled && !special) cooldown = Math.max(0, cooldown - delta);
      if (autoattackEnabled && !special && cooldown <= 0) {
        const stats = arisLevelStats(player);
        volleys.push({ elapsed: 0, angles: stats.beams === 2 ? [aim, aim + Math.PI] : [aim],
          width: s.beamWidth * stats.size * weaponSizeMultiplier(player), origin: arisBeamAnchor(player) });
        cooldown = attackTimeFormula(stats.interval*stationaryScale, ensureCombatStats(player).hastePercent);
      }
      const active = [...volleys];
      if (special && supernovaBeamPhase(special.elapsed).damaging) active.push({ elapsed: special.elapsed, angles: [special.angle], width: supernovaSkillSettings.beamWidth,
        origin: arisBeamAnchor(player), special: true });
      for (const volley of active) {
        const start = volley.elapsed;
        volley.elapsed += delta;
        volley.origin = arisBeamAnchor(player);
        if (volley.special || start < s.beamSeconds) for (const enemy of getAllEnemies()) {
          const times = volley.special ? special.hits : hitTimes;
          const lastHit = times.get(enemy.id);
          if (lastHit !== undefined && clock - lastHit < (volley.special ? specialHitCooldown : s.hitCooldown) - 1e-8) continue;
          const angle = volley.angles.find(value => arisBeamHits(enemy, volley.origin, value, volley.width));
          if (angle === undefined) continue;
          times.set(enemy.id, clock); // A missed attack also cannot reroll every frame.
          const hit = volley.special?rollSpecialDamage(player,enemy,special.damageMultiplier):rollArisDamage(player,Math.random,enemy,1);
          const landed = damageEnemy(enemy.id, hit.damage, player, hit.type, { canMiss: true });
          if(volley.special&&landed!==false)onSpecialHit(enemy,hit,player);
          const living = getEnemy(enemy.id);
          if (landed !== false && living) {
            if (volley.special) {
              const control = supernovaKnockback(living, volley.origin, angle, volley.width);
              applySkillControl(living, control.x, control.y, supernovaSkillSettings.knockbackSeconds,
                supernovaSkillSettings.knockbackSeconds,
                { ignoreKnockbackResistance: supernovaSkillSettings.ignoreKnockbackResistance });
            } else {
              const distance = s.knockbackSpeed * s.knockbackSeconds * weaponKnockbackMultiplier(player);
              applySkillControl(living, Math.cos(angle) * distance, Math.sin(angle) * distance,
                s.knockbackSeconds, s.knockbackSeconds, { ignoreKnockbackResistance: s.ignoreKnockbackResistance });
            }
          }
        }
      }
      volleys = volleys.filter(volley => volley.elapsed < s.beamSeconds * arisBeamVisualSettings.durationMultiplier);

      const visible = [...volleys];
      const phase = special ? supernovaBeamPhase(special.elapsed) : null;
      if (special && image.naturalWidth) {
        // This entire pass is drawn before the player: the gun emerges from behind her.
        const pose = supernovaWeaponPose(special.elapsed, special.player, special.angle);
        context.save();
        const anchor = arisBeamAnchor(special.player);
        context.translate(anchor.x-camera.x, anchor.y-camera.y);
        context.rotate(special.angle);
        context.globalAlpha = pose.opacity;
        const height = pose.length * image.naturalHeight/image.naturalWidth;
        context.shadowColor = '#63eaff'; context.shadowBlur = 12*pose.opacity;
        context.drawImage(image, pose.offset-pose.length/2, -height/2, pose.length, height);
        if(special.elapsed>=arisBeamVisualSettings.openingSeconds&&phase.beamAge<0) {
          const charge=Math.min(1,(special.elapsed-arisBeamVisualSettings.openingSeconds)/arisBeamVisualSettings.prelaunchSeconds);
          const muzzle=arisBeamOffset(anchor,special.angle,true)+supernovaSkillSettings.beamStartAdjustment;
          const radius=4+12*charge;
          context.globalCompositeOperation='lighter';context.shadowBlur=0;
          const light=context.createRadialGradient(muzzle,0,0,muzzle,0,radius*2);
          light.addColorStop(0,'rgba(235,255,255,.85)');light.addColorStop(.4,'rgba(90,215,255,.4)');light.addColorStop(1,'rgba(50,160,255,0)');
          context.fillStyle=light;context.beginPath();context.arc(muzzle,0,radius*2,0,Math.PI*2);context.fill();
          context.strokeStyle='rgba(160,240,255,.6)';context.lineWidth=1;
          context.beginPath();context.arc(muzzle,0,24*(1-charge)+3,0,Math.PI*2);context.stroke();
          for(let i=0;i<5;i++) {
            const angle=i*Math.PI*2/5+special.elapsed*2,distance=8+(1-charge)*24;
            context.beginPath();context.arc(muzzle+Math.cos(angle)*distance,Math.sin(angle)*distance,1.2,0,Math.PI*2);context.fill();
          }
        }
        context.restore();
      }
      if(special&&phase.beamAge>=0) {
        const anchor=arisBeamAnchor(special.player),muzzle=arisBeamOffset(anchor,special.angle,true)+supernovaSkillSettings.beamStartAdjustment;
        drawFiringRings(context,anchor.x-camera.x+Math.cos(special.angle)*muzzle,
          anchor.y-camera.y+Math.sin(special.angle)*muzzle,special.angle,phase.beamAge,supernovaSkillSettings.beamWidth*.55,true);
      }
      if (special && phase.beamAge >= 0 && !phase.beamFinished) visible.push({ elapsed: phase.beamAge, angles: [special.angle], origin: arisBeamAnchor(special.player),
        width: supernovaSkillSettings.beamWidth, special: true });
      for (const volley of visible) {
        const activeDuration = volley.special ? supernovaSkillSettings.duration : s.beamSeconds;
        const visualDuration = activeDuration * arisBeamVisualSettings.durationMultiplier;
        const collapse = Math.max(.06, visualDuration-activeDuration);
        const pulse = 1 + arisBeamVisualSettings.pulseDepth *
          Math.sin(volley.elapsed*Math.PI*2*arisBeamVisualSettings.pulsesPerSecond) ** 8;
        const thickness = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, volley.elapsed/.025,
          (visualDuration-volley.elapsed)/collapse)) * pulse;
        for (const angle of volley.angles) {
          context.save();
          context.translate(volley.origin.x - camera.x, volley.origin.y - camera.y);
          context.rotate(angle);
          // Shift only the EX light cone toward the gun; the weapon emergence stays anchored.
          const offset = arisBeamOffset(volley.origin,angle,volley.special) +
            (volley.special ? supernovaSkillSettings.beamStartAdjustment : 0);
          const cone = arisBeamVisualSettings.coneLength;
          // Additive bloom spreads blue/cyan light around the beam without changing its hit area.
          const visual = arisBeamVisualSettings;
          const layers = [
            [visual.bloomSpread, `rgba(36,151,255,${visual.bloomOpacity})`, visual.bloomBlur, 'lighter'],
            [2.1, `rgba(112,243,255,${visual.bloomOpacity})`, visual.bloomBlur*.5, 'lighter'],
            [2.2, '#219bff88', visual.outerBlur, 'source-over'],
            [1.3, '#51e6ffdd', visual.innerBlur, 'source-over'],
            [.55, '#f1ffff', 1.5, 'source-over']
          ];
          for (const [scale, color, blur, blend] of layers) {
            context.globalCompositeOperation = blend;
            const half = volley.width * scale * thickness / 2;
            context.filter = `blur(${blur}px)`;
            const rainbow=owner?.tuningParts&&rgbTuningActive(owner)&&scale>.6;
            context.fillStyle = rainbow?rainbowTrailGradient(context,offset,-volley.width,offset+600,volley.width):color;
            context.globalAlpha=rainbow?(scale>2?.35:.75):1;
            // Curved shoulders and a rounded nose soften the former triangular opening.
            context.beginPath(); context.moveTo(offset, 0);
            context.bezierCurveTo(offset, -half*.35, offset+cone*.45, -half, offset+cone, -half);
            context.lineTo(s.beamLength, -half); context.lineTo(s.beamLength, half);
            context.lineTo(offset+cone, half);
            context.bezierCurveTo(offset+cone*.45, half, offset, half*.35, offset, 0);
            context.closePath(); context.fill();
          }
          context.restore();
        }
      }
    }
  };

/** Sweep toward the closest beam edge, plus a small forward shove.
 * Include projected body radius so even large enemies clear the beam at zero resistance.
 * Shared knockback still respects resistance, collisions and absolute immunity.
 */
export function supernovaKnockback(enemy, origin, angle, width) {
  const body = getCombatHitbox(enemy, true);
  const forwardX = Math.cos(angle), forwardY = Math.sin(angle);
  const sideX = -forwardY, sideY = forwardX;
  const offset = (body.x-origin.x)*sideX + (body.y-origin.y)*sideY;
  const sign = offset < 0 ? -1 : 1;
  const radius = Math.hypot(body.rx*sideX, body.ry*sideY);
  const distance = Math.max(0, width/2 + radius + supernovaSkillSettings.knockbackClearance - Math.abs(offset));
  return {
    x: sideX*sign*distance + forwardX*supernovaSkillSettings.forwardKnockback,
    y: sideY*sign*distance + forwardY*supernovaSkillSettings.forwardKnockback
  };
}


/** Pure presentation timing; only the active3seconds authorize EX damage. */
export function supernovaBeamPhase(elapsed) {
  const openingDuration = arisBeamVisualSettings.openingSeconds + arisBeamVisualSettings.prelaunchSeconds;
  const beamAge = elapsed-openingDuration;
  return { openingDuration, beamAge,
    damaging: beamAge >= 0 && beamAge < supernovaSkillSettings.duration,
    beamFinished: beamAge >= supernovaSkillSettings.duration * arisBeamVisualSettings.durationMultiplier,
    finished: beamAge >= supernovaSkillSettings.duration * arisBeamVisualSettings.durationMultiplier +
      arisBeamVisualSettings.weaponReturnSeconds };
}


/** Fade and slide out from the player's center, hold through firing/tail, then return. */
export function supernovaWeaponPose(elapsed, player = {label:'Plana',x:0,y:0}, angle = 0) {
  const visual = arisBeamVisualSettings;
  const phase = supernovaBeamPhase(elapsed);
  const smooth = value => { const t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, value)); return t*t*(3-2*t); };
  const emerge = smooth(elapsed/visual.openingSeconds);
  const returnStart = phase.openingDuration + supernovaSkillSettings.duration*visual.durationMultiplier;
  const returning = smooth((elapsed-returnStart)/visual.weaponReturnSeconds);
  const progress = emerge*(1-returning);
  return {opacity:progress, offset:(arisBeamOffset(arisBeamAnchor(player),angle,true)-visual.weaponLength/2)*progress,
    length:visual.weaponLength};
}


/** Use the real player collider center, including its vertical sprite offset. */
export function arisBeamAnchor(player) { return getCombatHitbox(player, false); }

/** Automatic beam starts 10px beyond the collider; EX adds its independent muzzle gap. */
export function arisBeamOffset(anchor, angle, special = false) {
  const rx = Math.max(anchor.rx || 0, 0.000001), ry = Math.max(anchor.ry || 0, 0.000001);
  return 1/Math.hypot(Math.cos(angle)/rx,Math.sin(angle)/ry) + supernovaSkillSettings.hitboxGap + (special ? supernovaSkillSettings.extraMuzzleGap : 0);
}

--- SNAPSHOT FILE: public/Development/bad-cooking.js | sha256=09842af6f8945907164d89faaae89dd6cbb749f6229b801b7b52e1e54b89bcba | encoding=utf-8-sig ---
import { weaponSizeMultiplier, weaponKnockbackMultiplier } from './game-config.js';
import { badCookingSettings, badCookingLevelStats } from './game-config.js';
import { totalWeaponDamage, rollAttackDamage } from './combat-stats.js';
import { getAllEnemies, getEnemy, damageEnemy } from './world-state.js';
import { getCombatHitbox, getEnemyHurtbox } from './combat-hitboxes.js';
import { createEnemySpatialIndex } from './enemy-spatial-index.js';
import { applySkillControl } from './enemy-control.js';

/** Persistent miasma: renewal replaces the old field and never overlaps another copy. */
export function createBadCookingAttack({random=Math.random}={}){
  let owner=null,active=false,enabled=true,elapsed=0,cycle=0,time=0,hits=new Map(),mist=null,exRemaining=0,exTime=0,exHits=new Map(),auraSources=[];
  function reset(){owner=null;active=false;elapsed=0;cycle=0;time=0;hits.clear();exRemaining=0;exTime=0;exHits.clear();auraSources=[];}
  function cast(player,duration=10){if(!player.attackSlots?.some(w=>w?.id==='bad-cooking'))return false;if(owner!==player){reset();owner=player;}exRemaining=duration;exTime=0;exHits.clear();return true;}
  function updateAuras(delta,player,sources=[]){
    if(!(delta>0))return;
    const weapon=player.attackSlots?.find(w=>w?.id==='bad-cooking');if(owner!==player||!weapon){exRemaining=0;auraSources=[];return;}
    if(exRemaining<=0){auraSources=[];return;}
    const step=Math.min(delta,exRemaining);exRemaining=Math.max(0,exRemaining-delta);exTime+=step;
    auraSources=sources.filter(p=>Number.isFinite(p?.x)&&Number.isFinite(p?.y));
    const stats=badCookingLevelStats(weapon.level),radius=stats.radius*weaponSizeMultiplier(player),enemies=getAllEnemies(),index=createEnemySpatialIndex(enemies,getEnemyHurtbox),live=new Set(enemies.map(e=>e.id));
    for(const id of exHits.keys())if(!live.has(id))exHits.delete(id);
    for(const source of auraSources)for(const enemy of index.querySegment(source,source,radius)){
      if(enemy.hp<=0||exTime-(exHits.get(enemy.id)??-Infinity)<stats.hitCooldown-1e-8)continue;
      const b=getEnemyHurtbox(enemy),dx=source.x-b.x,dy=source.y-b.y,d=Math.hypot(dx,dy),extent=d?1/Math.hypot(dx/d/b.rx,dy/d/b.ry):0;if(d>radius+extent)continue;
      exHits.set(enemy.id,exTime);const hit=rollAttackDamage(player,totalWeaponDamage(player,'bad-cooking',badCookingSettings.damage,stats.damageBonuses,{projectileCount:1,hitCooldownFrames:stats.hitCooldown*60}),random,{target:enemy,weaponId:'bad-cooking',skillAttack:true});
      damageEnemy(enemy.id,hit.damage,player,hit.type,{canMiss:true,weaponId:'bad-cooking',skillAttack:true});
    }
    if(exRemaining<=0)auraSources=[];
  }
  function update(delta,player){
    const weapon=player.attackSlots?.find(w=>w?.id==='bad-cooking');
    if(!weapon){reset();return;}if(owner!==player){reset();owner=player;}
    if(delta<=0)return;if(!enabled){active=false;return;}
    active=true;elapsed=(elapsed+delta)%badCookingSettings.interval;cycle+=delta;
    const stats=badCookingLevelStats(weapon.level),radius=stats.radius*weaponSizeMultiplier(player);
    const body=getCombatHitbox(player,false);
    let left=delta;
    while(left>1e-8){const step=Math.min(left,1/60);left-=step;time+=step;
      const enemies=getAllEnemies(),liveIds=new Set(enemies.map(e=>e.id));
      for(const id of hits.keys())if(!liveIds.has(id))hits.delete(id);
      for(const enemy of enemies){
        if(time-(hits.get(enemy.id)??-Infinity)<stats.hitCooldown-1e-8)continue;
        const target=getEnemyHurtbox(enemy),dx=body.x-target.x,dy=body.y-target.y;
        // Closest point on the sprite hurtbox, rather than contact hitbox.
        const distance=Math.hypot(dx,dy),extent=distance?1/Math.hypot(dx/distance/target.rx,dy/distance/target.ry):0;
        if(distance>radius+extent)continue;
        hits.set(enemy.id,time);
        const hit=rollAttackDamage(player,totalWeaponDamage(player,'bad-cooking',badCookingSettings.damage,stats.damageBonuses,
          {projectileCount:1,hitCooldownFrames:stats.hitCooldown*60}),random,{target:enemy,weaponId:'bad-cooking'});
        const landed=damageEnemy(enemy.id,hit.damage,player,hit.type,{canMiss:true}),living=getEnemy(enemy.id);
        if(stats.knockback&&landed!==false&&living){const angle=Math.atan2(-dy,-dx),duration=badCookingSettings.knockbackSeconds;
          applySkillControl(living,Math.cos(angle)*badCookingSettings.knockbackSpeed*duration*weaponKnockbackMultiplier(player),Math.sin(angle)*badCookingSettings.knockbackSpeed*duration*weaponKnockbackMultiplier(player),duration,duration);}
      }
    }
  }
  function draw(context,camera){
    if((!active&&exRemaining<=0)||!owner)return;
    if(!mist){mist=document.createElement('canvas');mist.width=mist.height=256;const c=mist.getContext('2d'),g=c.createRadialGradient(128,128,0,128,128,128);
      g.addColorStop(0,'rgba(192,143,231,.13)');g.addColorStop(.88,'rgba(192,143,231,.13)');g.addColorStop(.98,'rgba(192,143,231,.1)');g.addColorStop(1,'rgba(192,143,231,0)');c.fillStyle=g;c.fillRect(0,0,256,256);}
    const body=getCombatHitbox(owner,false),weapon=owner.attackSlots.find(w=>w?.id==='bad-cooking');
    const radius=badCookingLevelStats(weapon?.level).radius*weaponSizeMultiplier(owner),x=body.x-camera.x,y=body.y-camera.y;
    const fields=[...(active?[body]:[]),...(exRemaining>0?auraSources:[])];
    for(let field=0;field<fields.length;field++){const x=fields[field].x-camera.x,y=fields[field].y-camera.y;if(context.canvas&&(x+radius<0||y+radius<0||x-radius>context.canvas.width||y-radius>context.canvas.height))continue;
    context.save();context.globalAlpha=field===0&&active?Math.min(1,cycle/.3):Math.min(1,exRemaining/.25);
    context.drawImage(mist,x-radius,y-radius,radius*2,radius*2);
    context.beginPath();context.arc(x,y,radius,0,Math.PI*2);
    context.lineWidth=1.25;context.strokeStyle='rgba(187,124,227,.38)';context.stroke();
    // Fixed particle seeds: softly fade in, rise vertically, then fade out and repeat.
    // Only their phase changes; no orbiting, expanding cloud blobs or per-frame allocations.
    const particles=field===0&&active?32:8;for(let i=0;i<particles;i++){
      const phase=((cycle+exTime)/(1.5+(i%5)*.15)+i*.61803398875)%1;
      const angle=i*2.399963,r=radius*Math.sqrt((i+.5)/particles)*.76;
      const px=Math.cos(angle)*r,py=Math.sin(angle)*r;
      const rise=Math.min(radius*.36,52),size=4+i%3;
      context.fillStyle=`rgba(192,103,238,${.85*Math.sin(Math.PI*phase)})`;
      context.fillRect(x+px-size/2,y+py-rise*phase-size/2,size,size);
    }
    context.restore();}
  }
  return {ready:Promise.resolve(),cast,updateAuras,get exRemaining(){return exRemaining;},get auraCount(){return auraSources.length;},update,draw,reset,setAutoattackEnabled(value){enabled=Boolean(value);if(!enabled)active=false;},get active(){return active;}};
}

import {playerSettings,wakamoBayonetSettings,wakamoBayonetLevelStats,weaponSizeMultiplier} from './game-config.js';
import {totalWeaponDamage,rollAttackDamage,statMultiplier} from './combat-stats.js';
import {getAllEnemies,getEnemy,damageEnemy} from './world-state.js';

export function chargeBladeAngle(aim,age){return aim+Math.sin(age*Math.PI/.12-Math.PI/2)*wakamoBayonetSettings.arc/2;}
export function createBayonetCharge({random=Math.random}={}){
 let owner=null,state=null,ghosts=[],sprite=null;
 const ready=typeof Image==='undefined'?Promise.resolve():new Promise(resolve=>{sprite=new Image();sprite.onload=resolve;sprite.onerror=()=>{sprite=null;resolve();};sprite.src=new URL('../sprites/attacks/wakamo-bayonet.png',import.meta.url).href;});

 function setMovementInput(player,direction){
  if(!state||owner!==player)return;
  const [x,y]=direction||[0,0],length=Math.hypot(x,y);
  const braking=length>0&&(x*Math.cos(state.angle)+y*Math.sin(state.angle))/length<=-.5;
  if(braking&&!state.braking){state.brakeHeld=0;state.brakeStartScale=state.speedScale;}
  if(!braking)state.brakeHeld=0;
  state.braking=braking;
 }
 function update(delta,player,move){
  if(owner&&owner!==player){reset();return false;}
  for(const ghost of ghosts)ghost.age+=delta;ghosts=ghosts.filter(g=>g.age<.35);
  if(!state)return false;
  const weapon=player.attackSlots?.find(w=>w?.id==='wakamo-bayonet');if(!weapon){reset();return false;}
  let left=Math.max(0,delta),index=null;
  while(state&&left>1e-8){const windup=state.windup>1e-8,dt=Math.min(left,1/120,windup?state.windup:state.remaining);left-=dt;
   const before=getCombatHitbox(player,false);
   const previousScale=state.speedScale;
   if(!windup){
    if(state.braking){state.brakeHeld=Math.min(2,state.brakeHeld+dt);state.speedScale=state.brakeStartScale*(1-state.brakeHeld/2);}
    else state.speedScale=Math.min(1,state.speedScale+dt);
   }
   const speed=windup?80:(previousScale+state.speedScale)/2*3*playerSettings.movementBase*(player.movementSpeedMultiplier||1)*statMultiplier(player,'spdPercent');
   const blocked=move(state.angle+(windup?Math.PI:0),speed,dt,state.angle);
   if(windup){state.windup=Math.max(0,state.windup-dt);continue;}
   const after=getCombatHitbox(player,false),stats=wakamoBayonetLevelStats(weapon.level),reach=wakamoBayonetSettings.range*stats.size*weaponSizeMultiplier(player);
   const previousAngle=chargeBladeAngle(state.angle,state.bladeAge);state.bladeAge+=dt;const nextAngle=chargeBladeAngle(state.angle,state.bladeAge);
   state.remaining-=dt;state.ghostTime+=dt;
   if(state.ghostTime>=.035){state.ghostTime%=.035;if(player.lastPose)ghosts.push({x:player.x,y:player.y,pose:player.lastPose,image:player.image,age:0});}
   for(const enemy of (index??=createEnemySpatialIndex(getAllEnemies(),getEnemyHurtbox)).querySegment(before,after,reach+20)){
    if(!(enemy.hp>0)||state.hits.has(enemy.id))continue;
    const body=getEnemyHurtbox(enemy);
    if(!bayonetHits(body,before,previousAngle,nextAngle,reach)&&!bayonetHits(body,after,previousAngle,nextAngle,reach))continue;
    const base=totalWeaponDamage(player,'wakamo-bayonet',wakamoBayonetSettings.damage,stats.damageBonuses,{projectileCount:stats.count,hitCooldownFrames:wakamoBayonetSettings.hitCooldown*60});
    const hit=rollAttackDamage(player,base,random,{target:enemy,weaponId:'wakamo-bayonet',damageMod:10,skillAttack:true});

    if(damageEnemy(enemy.id,hit.damage,player,hit.type,{canMiss:true,weaponId:'wakamo-bayonet',skillAttack:true})===false)continue;

     enemy.stunRemaining=Math.max(enemy.stunRemaining||0,5);
     const side=(body.x-after.x)*-Math.sin(state.angle)+(body.y-after.y)*Math.cos(state.angle)>=0?1:-1;
     enemy.skillKnockback=beginKnockback(enemy,-Math.sin(state.angle)*side*90,Math.cos(state.angle)*side*90,.25);
    }
   }
   if(blocked||state.remaining<=1e-8||state.brakeHeld>=2-1e-8){delete player.bayonetChargeActive;state=null;}
  }
  return true;
 }

import {applyPoison} from './poison-status.js';

/** Arcing throws settle on the ground; the 630-frame fuse counts from launch. */
export function createBeanBagBombAttack({random=Math.random}={}){
 const s=beanBagBombSettings;let owner=null,enabled=true,cooldown=0,bombs=[],explosions=[],shockwaves=[],shots=0;
 let sprite=null;
 const imageReady=typeof Image==='undefined'?Promise.resolve():new Promise(resolve=>{sprite=new Image();sprite.onload=resolve;sprite.onerror=()=>{sprite=null;resolve();};sprite.src=new URL('../sprites/attacks/Bean Bag.png',import.meta.url).href;});
 function reset(){owner=null;cooldown=0;bombs=[];explosions=[];shockwaves=[];shots=0;}
 function launch(player,weapon,viewport){
  const body=getCombatHitbox(player,false),stats=beanBagBombLevelStats(weapon.level),view=viewport||{x:body.x-640,y:body.y-360,width:1280,height:720};
  const reach=Math.min(500,Math.max(view.width,view.height)*.45),targets=getAllEnemies().filter(enemy=>{const t=getEnemyHurtbox(enemy);return Math.hypot(t.x-body.x,t.y-body.y)<=reach;});
  const count=startingWeaponProjectileCount(player,'bean-bag-bomb',stats.count);
  for(let i=0;i<count;i++){
   const target=targets.length?getEnemyHurtbox(targets[Math.min(targets.length-1,Math.floor(random()*targets.length))]):null;
   const angle=target?Math.atan2(target.y-body.y,target.x-body.x):random()*Math.PI*2;
   const distance=target?Math.hypot(target.x-body.x,target.y-body.y):reach*(.2+.65*random());
   const spread=count>1?(i-(count-1)/2)*.2:0,a=angle+spread;
   bombs.push({x:body.x,y:body.y,fromX:body.x,fromY:body.y,toX:body.x+Math.cos(a)*distance,toY:body.y+Math.sin(a)*distance,
    age:0,flight:Math.max(.15,distance/s.speed),radius:stats.radius*weaponSizeMultiplier(player),damageBonuses:stats.damageBonuses,count});shots++;
  }
 }
 function cast(player,angle=0,viewport=null){const weapon=player.attackSlots?.find(w=>w?.id==='bean-bag-bomb');if(!weapon)return false;if(owner!==player){reset();owner=player;}const body=getCombatHitbox(player,false),stats=beanBagBombLevelStats(weapon.level),distance=Math.min(400,Math.max(180,(viewport?.width||1000)*.3));bombs.push({exSkill:true,x:body.x,y:body.y,fromX:body.x,fromY:body.y,toX:body.x+Math.cos(angle)*distance,toY:body.y+Math.sin(angle)*distance,age:0,flight:Math.max(.3,distance/s.speed),radius:stats.radius*weaponSizeMultiplier(player)*3,damageBonuses:stats.damageBonuses,count:1});shots++;return true;}
 function nuclearHit(enemy,bomb,player,multiplier){const base=totalWeaponDamage(player,'bean-bag-bomb',s.damage,bomb.damageBonuses,{projectileCount:1,hitCooldownFrames:s.hitCooldown*60}),hit=rollAttackDamage(player,base,random,{target:enemy,weaponId:'bean-bag-bomb',damageMod:multiplier,skillAttack:true});if(damageEnemy(enemy.id,hit.damage,player,hit.type,{canMiss:true,weaponId:'bean-bag-bomb',skillAttack:true})!==false)applyPoison(enemy,player,damageRules.baseScale*base,10);}
 function explode(bomb,player){
  explosions.push({x:bomb.x,y:bomb.y,radius:bomb.radius,age:0});
  if(bomb.exSkill)shockwaves.push({...bomb,age:0,maxRadius:bomb.radius*3,hits:new Set()});
  for(const enemy of getAllEnemies()){
   const t=getEnemyHurtbox(enemy),dx=t.x-bomb.x,dy=t.y-bomb.y,distance=Math.hypot(dx,dy),extent=distance?1/Math.hypot(dx/distance/t.rx,dy/distance/t.ry):0;
   if(distance>bomb.radius+extent)continue;
   if(bomb.exSkill){nuclearHit(enemy,bomb,player,5);continue;}
   const hit=rollAttackDamage(player,totalWeaponDamage(player,'bean-bag-bomb',s.damage,bomb.damageBonuses,{projectileCount:bomb.count,hitCooldownFrames:s.hitCooldown*60}),random,{target:enemy,weaponId:'bean-bag-bomb'});
   damageEnemy(enemy.id,hit.damage,player,hit.type,{canMiss:true});
  }
 }
 function update(delta,player,viewport=null){
  const weapon=player.attackSlots?.find(w=>w?.id==='bean-bag-bomb');if(!weapon){reset();return;}
  if(owner!==player){reset();owner=player;}if(!(delta>0))return;
  let left=delta;while(left>1e-8){
   if(enabled&&cooldown<=1e-8){launch(player,weapon,viewport);cooldown=attackTimeFormula(beanBagBombLevelStats(weapon.level).interval*(player.tuningParts?stationaryWeaponIntervalScale(player):1),ensureCombatStats(player).hastePercent);}
   const step=Math.min(left,1/60,enabled&&cooldown>1e-8?cooldown:1/60);left-=step;cooldown=Math.max(0,cooldown-step);
   for(let i=explosions.length-1;i>=0;i--){explosions[i].age+=step;if(explosions[i].age>=artilleryExplosionDuration)explosions.splice(i,1);}
   for(let i=shockwaves.length-1;i>=0;i--){const wave=shockwaves[i];wave.age+=step;const radius=wave.maxRadius*Math.min(1,wave.age/1.2);for(const enemy of getAllEnemies()){if(!(enemy.hp>0)||wave.hits.has(enemy.id))continue;const body=getEnemyHurtbox(enemy),distance=Math.hypot(body.x-wave.x,body.y-wave.y);if(distance>radius+Math.max(body.rx,body.ry))continue;wave.hits.add(enemy.id);nuclearHit(enemy,wave,player,2);}if(wave.age>=1.2-1e-8)shockwaves.splice(i,1);}

    if(b.age>=(b.exSkill?b.flight:s.duration)-1e-8){explode(b,player);bombs.splice(i,1);}
   }
  }
 }

   context.save();context.fillStyle='rgba(15,30,50,.2)';context.beginPath();context.ellipse(x,y+6,10,4,0,0,Math.PI*2);context.fill();
   context.translate(x,y-arc);if(b.exSkill)context.scale(2,2);context.rotate(flight<1?b.age*6:Math.sin(b.age*12)*urgency*.08);
   if(sprite?.complete&&sprite.naturalWidth)context.drawImage(sprite,72,20,171,202,-12,-17,24,28);
   else {context.fillStyle='#b28a56';context.beginPath();context.ellipse(0,0,11,13,0,0,Math.PI*2);context.fill();}
   context.strokeStyle='#ffc569';context.lineWidth=1.5;context.beginPath();context.moveTo(0,-12);context.quadraticCurveTo(8,-20,3,-24);context.stroke();
   context.fillStyle=`rgba(255,${Math.round(200-100*urgency)},65,${.6+.4*Math.sin(b.age*(12+urgency*14))**2})`;context.beginPath();context.arc(3,-24,2+urgency*2,0,Math.PI*2);context.fill();context.restore();
  }
  for(const effect of explosions)drawArtilleryExplosion(context,camera,effect,effect.age);
  for(const wave of shockwaves){const p=Math.min(1,wave.age/1.2),radius=wave.maxRadius*p;context.save();context.translate(wave.x-camera.x,wave.y-camera.y);context.globalAlpha=p<.8 ? .95 : .95*(1-p)/.2;
   const glow=context.createRadialGradient(0,0,Math.max(0,radius-70),0,0,radius+18);glow.addColorStop(0,'rgba(123,255,153,0)');glow.addColorStop(.55,'rgba(134,255,161,.3)');glow.addColorStop(.8,'rgba(224,255,205,.85)');glow.addColorStop(1,'rgba(125,242,156,0)');context.fillStyle=glow;context.beginPath();context.arc(0,0,radius+18,0,Math.PI*2);context.fill();
   context.strokeStyle='rgba(126,255,167,.48)';context.lineWidth=14;context.beginPath();context.arc(0,0,radius,0,Math.PI*2);context.stroke();
   context.strokeStyle='#f3ffe2';context.lineWidth=4.5;context.beginPath();context.arc(0,0,radius,0,Math.PI*2);context.stroke();
   context.strokeStyle='rgba(190,255,203,.75)';context.lineWidth=2;context.beginPath();context.arc(0,0,Math.max(0,radius-14),0,Math.PI*2);context.stroke();context.restore();}

 }

import { font21Metrics } from './font21-metrics.js';
import { font2Metrics } from './font2-metrics.js';
import { thinFontMetrics } from './font-thin-metrics.js';
import { fontMetrics } from './font-metrics.js';
const highlightedGlyphs=new Map();

/** Important EX values/effects use yellow ink, without changing the wording or wrapping. */
export function statHighlightRanges(text) {
  return [...text.matchAll(/\d+(?:\.\d+)?\s*(?:%|×|x\b)?|\b(?:seconds?|critical chance|noncritical|stunning|knocking enemies aside|unlimited piercing|stored[- ]charge|ATK)\b/gi)]
    .map(match=>({start:match.index,end:match.index+match[0].length}));
}

/** Tint bright glyph ink once and preserve the original dark outline and transparency. */
function yellowGlyph(image,glyph,variant,character) {
  const key=`${variant}:${character}`;if(highlightedGlyphs.has(key))return highlightedGlyphs.get(key);
  const tile=document.createElement('canvas');tile.width=glyph.width;tile.height=glyph.height;
  const context=tile.getContext('2d',{willReadFrequently:true});
  context.drawImage(image,glyph.x,glyph.y,glyph.width,glyph.height,0,0,glyph.width,glyph.height);
  const pixels=context.getImageData(0,0,tile.width,tile.height);
  for(let i=0;i<pixels.data.length;i+=4)if(pixels.data[i]>160&&pixels.data[i+1]>160&&pixels.data[i+2]>160) {
    pixels.data[i]=255;pixels.data[i+1]=225;pixels.data[i+2]=90;
  }
  context.putImageData(pixels,0,0);highlightedGlyphs.set(key,tile);return tile;
}

/** Return tight glyph bounds so only the dark outlines meet between letters. */
export function glyphRectangle(character) {
  return fontMetrics[character] || fontMetrics['?'];
}

/** Render crisp HUD text from the supplied font sheet, refreshing only on changes. */
export function createBitmapText(canvas, { scale = 2, outlineOverlap = 1, spaceWidth = 3, fitWidth = null, variant = 'regular', maxWidth = null, wrap = true, highlightStats = false } = {}) {
  canvas.setAttribute('data-bitmap-text','');
  const image = new Image();
  let loaded = false;
  let text = '';
  const sourceScale = variant === 'font21' ? .25 : 1;
  const lineHeight = variant === 'font21' ? 24 : 20;
  const glyphFor = character => variant === 'font21' ? font21Metrics[character] || font21Metrics['?'] : variant === 'font2' ? font2Metrics[character] || font2Metrics['?'] : variant === 'thin' ? thinFontMetrics[character] || thinFontMetrics['?'] : glyphRectangle(character);

  function render() {
    // EDIT scale/outlineOverlap via options: 2x glyphs, one source outline pixel overlap.
    const lines = [''];
    const measure = value => [...value].reduce((sum, c) => sum + (c === ' ' ? spaceWidth : glyphFor(c).width * sourceScale - outlineOverlap), outlineOverlap) * scale;
    for (const word of text.split(' ')) {
      const index = lines.length - 1;
      const next = lines[index] ? `${lines[index]} ${word}` : word;
      if (wrap && maxWidth && lines[index] && measure(next) > maxWidth) lines.push(word);
      else lines[index] = next;
    }
    canvas.width = Math.max(1, ...lines.map(measure));
    canvas.height = lineHeight * scale * lines.length;
    canvas.style.width = fitWidth || `${canvas.width}px`;
    canvas.style.height = fitWidth ? 'auto' : `${canvas.height}px`;
    canvas.setAttribute('aria-label', text);
    if (!loaded) return;
    const context = canvas.getContext('2d');
    context.imageSmoothingEnabled = false;
    lines.forEach((line, row) => {
      let x = 0,index=0;const highlights=highlightStats?statHighlightRanges(line):[];
      for (const character of line) {
        if (character !== ' ') {
          const glyph = glyphFor(character);
          const highlighted=highlights.some(range=>index>=range.start&&index<range.end);
          const source=highlighted?yellowGlyph(image,glyph,variant,character):image;
          context.drawImage(source, highlighted?0:glyph.x, highlighted?0:glyph.y, glyph.width, glyph.height,
            x * scale, (row * lineHeight + glyph.offsetY * sourceScale) * scale, glyph.width * sourceScale * scale, glyph.height * sourceScale * scale);
        }
        x += character === ' ' ? spaceWidth : glyphFor(character).width * sourceScale - outlineOverlap;
        index+=character.length;
      }
    });
  }

  image.onload = () => { loaded = true; render(); };
  image.src = new URL(variant === 'font21' ? '../sprites/font2.1.png' : variant === 'font2' ? '../sprites/font2.png' : variant === 'thin' ? '../sprites/font-thin.png' : '../sprites/font.png', import.meta.url).href;
  return {
    setMaxWidth(value) { maxWidth = value; render(); },
    setScale(value) { scale = Math.max(.1, Number(value)||1); render(); },
    setText(value) {
      if (text === value) return;
      text = value;
      render();
    }
  };
}
