import {weakenedAttackMultiplier} from './weak-tuning.js';
import {eraseTuningProjectiles} from './neutralization-tuning.js';
import { drawArtilleryExplosion, artilleryExplosionDuration } from './artillery-explosion.js';
import { drawLuminousPlasma } from './luminous-nova.js?plasma-orange=2';
import { arisuBodyCenterOffsetY, neruBodyCenterOffsetY } from './game-config.js';
import { bossBehaviorSettings as settings, contactSettings, spriteDisplayPadding, normalSpriteSize } from './game-config.js';
import { damagePlayer } from './player-stats.js';
import { getCombatHitbox } from './combat-hitboxes.js';

/** Solve horizontal shell interception, including windup, travel time and player velocity. */
export function irohaCannonIntercept(npc,player,delta,motion={x:0,y:0}) {
  const s=settings.iroha,body=getCombatHitbox(player,false);
  const vx=delta>0?(motion.x||0)/delta:0,vy=delta>0?(motion.y||0)/delta:0;
  const barrelY=npc.y+s.cannonOffsetY,clearance=s.cannonWarningWidth/2+body.ry;
  const earliest=s.cannonWindupSeconds+s.cannonFireDelay;
  const options=[];
  for(const side of [-1,1]) {
    const muzzle=npc.x+side*(npc.spriteSize||200)*.35;
    const relativeSpeed=side*s.cannonSpeed-vx;
    if(Math.abs(relativeSpeed)>1e-8) {
      const impactTime=(body.x-muzzle+side*s.cannonSpeed*earliest)/relativeSpeed;
      if(impactTime>=earliest&&impactTime-earliest<=settings.projectileLifetime&&Math.abs(body.y+vy*impactTime-barrelY)<=clearance)
        options.push({angle:side<0?Math.PI:0,fireAt:earliest,impactTime});
    }
    if(Math.abs(vy)>1e-8) {
      const impactTime=(barrelY-body.y)/vy;
      const flight=(body.x+vx*impactTime-muzzle)/(side*s.cannonSpeed);
      const fireAt=impactTime-flight;
      if(flight>=0&&flight<=settings.projectileLifetime&&fireAt>=earliest&&fireAt<=earliest+s.cannonMaxInterceptWait)
        options.push({angle:side<0?Math.PI:0,fireAt,impactTime});
    }
  }
  return options.sort((a,b)=>a.fireAt-b.fireAt||a.impactTime-b.impactTime)[0]||null;
}

/** Position-based pool, recalculated once when Iroha starts an attack. */
export function irohaAttackChances(npc,player) {
  const dx=Math.abs(player.x-npc.x),dy=Math.abs(player.y-npc.y);
  // Symmetric sigmoid over each quadrant: rapid change through 30?60deg, 50/50 at 45deg.
  const position=Math.atan2(dy,dx)/(Math.PI/2),power=settings.iroha.attackAngleExponent;
  const horizontal=(1-position)**power,vertical=position**power;
  const cannon=dx===0&&dy===0?.5:horizontal/(horizontal+vertical);
  return {cannon,artillery:1-cannon};
}
export function irohaAttackChoice(npc,player,delta,motion={x:0,y:0},random=Math.random) {
  const pool=irohaAttackChances(npc,player,delta,motion);
  return random()<pool.cannon?'cannon':'artillery';
}

/** Cardinal movement produces +; diagonal movement produces X. */
export function irohaArtilleryPoints(npc,player,motion={x:0,y:0},viewport={width:1280,height:720}) {
  const dx=Math.abs(motion.x||0),dy=Math.abs(motion.y||0);
  const diagonal=Math.max(dx,dy)>1e-6&&Math.min(dx,dy)/Math.max(dx,dy)>.4;
  const s=settings.iroha;
  // Keep a compact cluster of equal circles, with neighboring edges slightly overlapping.
  // Fit the + footprint using the configured coverage of the shorter visible dimension; X is its 45deg rotation.
  const radius=Math.min(viewport.width,viewport.height)*s.artilleryCoverage/(2*(1+s.artilleryCircleSpacing));
  const spacing=radius*s.artilleryCircleSpacing,angle=diagonal?Math.PI/4:0;
  return [{x:player.x,y:player.y,radius},...Array.from({length:4},(_,i)=>({
    x:player.x+Math.cos(angle+i*Math.PI/2)*spacing,
    y:player.y+Math.sin(angle+i*Math.PI/2)*spacing,radius}))];
}

/** Continuous same-direction movement, measured once per simulation tick, not per boss. */
export function createSteadyMovementTracker() {
  let owner=null,seconds=0,heading=null,vx=0,vy=0;
  return {update(delta,player,motion={x:0,y:0}) {
    if(delta<=0)return;
    if(owner!==player){owner=player;seconds=0;heading=null;}
    const length=Math.hypot(motion.x||0,motion.y||0);
    if(length<.01){seconds=0;heading=null;vx=vy=0;return;}
    const direction={x:motion.x/length,y:motion.y/length};
    if(!heading||direction.x*heading.x+direction.y*heading.y<.995){seconds=0;heading=direction;}
    seconds+=delta;vx=motion.x/delta;vy=motion.y/delta;
  },get seconds(){return seconds;},get velocity(){return {x:vx,y:vy};}};
}

/** Boss action state, projectiles and warned area attacks; Shiroko keeps ordinary chase AI. */
export function createBossBehaviors({random=Math.random}={}) {
  const bullets=[],zones=[],warnings=new Map(),landingShadows=new Map(),movement=createSteadyMovementTracker();
  let shakeRemaining=0,shakeElapsed=0;
  function hit(player,amount,attacker,projectile=false) {
    if(player.contactIFrames>0)return false;
    if(damagePlayer(player,attacker?.weakRemaining>0?Math.floor(amount*weakenedAttackMultiplier(attacker)):amount,{projectile})){player.contactIFrames=contactSettings.iFrameDuration;if(attacker)attacker.secondsSincePlayerHit=0;return true;}
    return false;
  }
  function fire(npc,angle,speed,radius=5,options={}) {
    if(bullets.length>=settings.projectileLimit)return;
    bullets.push({owner:npc.id,ownerType:npc.type,x:npc.x,y:npc.y,previousX:npc.x,previousY:npc.y,
      vx:Math.cos(angle)*speed,vy:Math.sin(angle)*speed,radius,age:0,damage:npc.contactDamage||1,...options});
  }
  function zone(npc,x,y,delay,radius) { zones.push({owner:npc.id,x,y,remaining:delay,radius,damage:npc.contactDamage||1}); }
  function begin(npc,name,extra={}) { npc.bossAction={name,elapsed:0,...extra};npc.gifElapsed=0;npc.moving=false; }
  function finish(npc) {landingShadows.delete(npc.id);npc.bossAction=null;npc.bossSquash=1;npc.bossVisualOffsetY=0;npc.attack=null;}
  function startIroha(npc,name,player,delta,motion,extra={}) {
    const s=settings.iroha;
    const intercept=name==='cannon'?(irohaCannonIntercept(npc,player,delta,motion)||{
      angle:player.x<npc.x?Math.PI:player.x>npc.x?0:npc.facing==='right'?0:Math.PI,
      fireAt:s.cannonWindupSeconds+s.cannonFireDelay
    }):null;
    if(intercept)npc.facing=Math.cos(intercept.angle)<0?'left':'right';
    begin(npc,name,{...intercept,...extra});
    npc.attack={name,facing:npc.facing||'left',elapsed:0,walkElapsed:npc.elapsed||0};
  }
  /** Return true while this controller owns movement; otherwise use ordinary chasing. */
  function updateNpc(npc,player,delta,viewport,playerMotion={x:0,y:0},chaseDuringAction=()=>{}) {
    const s=settings[npc.type];
    if(!s||!npc.ai||delta<=0)return false;
    npc.bossCooldown=(npc.bossCooldown??s.interval)-delta;
    if(!npc.bossAction&&npc.bossCooldown<=0) {
      npc.bossCooldown=s.interval;npc.bossMoveIndex=(npc.bossMoveIndex||0)+1;
      if(npc.type==='arisu')begin(npc,'chargeUp',{clip:'charge',angle:Math.atan2(player.y-npc.y,player.x-npc.x)});
      if(npc.type==='iroha') {
        const name=irohaAttackChoice(npc,player,delta,playerMotion,random);
        const before=name==='cannon'&&random()>=1-s.artilleryBeforeCannonChance;
        startIroha(npc,before?'artillery':name,player,delta,playerMotion,before?{nextAction:'cannon'}:{});
      }
      if(npc.type==='neru')begin(npc,npc.bossMoveIndex%2?'shoot':'compress',npc.bossMoveIndex%2?{clip:'shoot',nextBullet:0,pattern:npc.bossMoveIndex%4===3?'stream':'radial',streamIndex:0}:{});
    }
    const action=npc.bossAction;if(!action)return false;
    action.elapsed+=delta;npc.moving=false;
    if(npc.type==='iroha')chaseDuringAction(npc);
    if(action.name==='chargeUp') {
      const center={x:npc.x+(npc.spriteHurtbox?.offsetX||0),y:npc.y+arisuBodyCenterOffsetY(npc)};
      if(!action.aimLocked) {
        action.angle=Math.atan2(player.y-center.y,player.x-center.x);
        action.targetX=player.x;action.targetY=player.y;
        if(action.elapsed>=s.trackingSeconds-1e-8)action.aimLocked=true;
      }
      npc.facing=Math.cos(action.angle)<0?'left':'right';
      warnings.set(npc.id,{x:center.x,y:center.y,angle:action.angle,progress:Math.min(1,action.elapsed/s.chargeUpSeconds),length:Math.hypot(viewport.width,viewport.height)+npc.spriteSize,width:s.warningWidth});
    }
    if(action.name==='chargeUp'&&action.elapsed>=s.chargeUpSeconds-1e-8) {
      const angle=action.angle;warnings.delete(npc.id);
      // Measure along the warned ray from the same visible body center used for aiming.
      // Dividing by a nearly horizontal/vertical component can create enormous dash ranges.
      const dx=Math.cos(angle),dy=Math.sin(angle);
      const originX=npc.x+(npc.spriteHurtbox?.offsetX||0);
      const originY=npc.y+arisuBodyCenterOffsetY(npc);
      const targetDistance=Math.max(0,(player.x-originX)*dx+(player.y-originY)*dy);
      // Preserve the full dash launch speed at every distance; braking remains timed.
      const launchSpeed=s.chargeSpeed;
      const brakeAt=targetDistance;
      begin(npc,'charge',{angle,travelled:0,targetDistance,brakeAt,launchSpeed,speed:launchSpeed,brakingElapsed:0});
    } else if(action.name==='charge') {
      // Keep the direction locked, but pass the player's current position along that ray.
      // Otherwise a fleeing player can move beyond the old warning-time braking point.
      if(action.brakingElapsed===0) {
        const centerX=npc.x+(npc.spriteHurtbox?.offsetX||0);
        const centerY=npc.y+arisuBodyCenterOffsetY(npc);
        const remaining=(player.x-centerX)*Math.cos(action.angle)+(player.y-centerY)*Math.sin(action.angle);
        action.brakeAt=action.travelled+Math.max(0,remaining);
      }
      // Once braking begins, retain its bounded travel and timed return to chase.
      const before=Math.min(delta,Math.max(0,action.brakeAt-action.travelled)/action.launchSpeed);
      const after=delta-before;
      let travel=before*action.launchSpeed;
      if(after>0) {
        // Front-load braking while retaining a continuous 1.5s ease to zero.
        // Analytic integration bounds post-target travel to the configured distance.
        const duration=s.decelerationSeconds;
        const power=Math.max(1,action.launchSpeed*duration/s.brakingDistance-1);
        const previous=Math.min(duration,action.brakingElapsed);
        const next=Math.min(duration,previous+after);
        travel+=action.launchSpeed*duration/(power+1)*
          ((1-previous/duration)**(power+1)-(1-next/duration)**(power+1));
        action.brakingElapsed=next;
        action.speed=action.launchSpeed*(1-next/duration)**power;
      }
      const distance=travel;action.travelled+=distance;
      const x=npc.x,y=npc.y;npc.x+=Math.cos(action.angle)*distance;npc.y+=Math.sin(action.angle)*distance;
      npc.facing=Math.cos(action.angle)<0?'left':'right';npc.moving=true;
      const body=getCombatHitbox(player,false),dx=npc.x-x,dy=npc.y-y;
      const t=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,((body.x-x)*dx+(body.y-y)*dy)/(dx*dx+dy*dy||1)));
      if(Math.hypot(body.x-x-dx*t,body.y-y-dy*t)<body.rx+s.chargeRadius)hit(player,s.chargeDamage,npc);
      if(action.brakingElapsed>=s.decelerationSeconds-1e-8) {
        finish(npc);npc.bossCooldown=s.interval;npc.moving=false;
        npc.gifElapsed=0;npc.contactReaction=null;
        return false; // Resume ordinary chase in this same NPC update, with the normal animation.
      }
    } else if(action.name==='recover') {
      if(npc.type==='neru'&&action.squashFrom!=null){
        const t=Math.min(1,action.elapsed/s.recoverySeconds);npc.bossSquash=action.squashFrom+(1-action.squashFrom)*(1-(1-t)**3);
      }
      if(action.elapsed>=s.recoverySeconds){finish(npc);if(npc.type==='neru'){npc.bossCooldown=s.interval;return false;}}
    } else if(npc.type==='iroha') {
      const cannon=action.name==='cannon',windup=cannon?s.cannonWindupSeconds:.4;
      const fireAt=cannon?(action.fireAt??windup+s.cannonFireDelay):windup;
      if(npc.attack) {
        // The supplied cannon sheet first flashes at frame 2; release the shell on that pose.
        const frameSeconds=(npc.attacks?.cannon?.frameDuration||110)/1000;
        const animationStart=cannon?fireAt-s.cannonFireFrame*frameSeconds:0;
        npc.attack.elapsed=Math.max(0,action.elapsed-animationStart)*1000+1e-6;
      }
      if(cannon&&!action.fired) {
        const x=npc.x+Math.cos(action.angle)*(npc.spriteSize||200)*.35;
        const y=npc.y+s.cannonOffsetY;
        warnings.set(npc.id,{x,y,angle:action.angle,progress:Math.min(1,action.elapsed/fireAt),
          length:viewport.width+(npc.spriteSize||200),width:s.cannonWarningWidth,back:(npc.spriteSize||200)*.55});
      }
      if(!action.fired&&action.elapsed>=fireAt-1e-8) {
        action.fired=true;warnings.delete(npc.id);
        if(cannon)fire(npc,action.angle,s.cannonSpeed,s.cannonWarningWidth/2,{
          x:npc.x+Math.cos(action.angle)*(npc.spriteSize||200)*.35,y:npc.y+s.cannonOffsetY,cannon:true,angle:action.angle,speed:s.cannonSpeed,color:'orange'});
        else {
          let target=player;
          if(movement.seconds>=s.artilleryLeadAfter-1e-8&&random()<s.artilleryLeadChance) {
            const velocity=movement.velocity,length=Math.hypot(velocity.x,velocity.y);
            const seconds=Math.min(s.artilleryLeadSeconds,length?s.artilleryMaxLead/length:0);
            target={x:player.x+velocity.x*seconds,y:player.y+velocity.y*seconds};
          }
          for(const [index,point] of irohaArtilleryPoints(npc,target,playerMotion,viewport).entries())zones.push({owner:npc.id,...point,
          radius:point.radius,damage:npc.contactDamage||1,artillery:true,age:0,impactOffset:index*s.artilleryStaggerSeconds,
          side:npc.x<=point.x?-1:1,detonated:false});
        }
      }
      if(action.elapsed>=(cannon?fireAt+s.cannonSeconds-s.cannonWindupSeconds-s.cannonFireDelay:s.artillerySeconds)) {
        if(action.nextAction==='cannon')startIroha(npc,'cannon',player,delta,playerMotion);
        else if(cannon&&random()>=1-s.artilleryAfterCannonChance)startIroha(npc,'artillery',player,delta,playerMotion);
        else {finish(npc);npc.bossCooldown=s.interval;}
      }
    } else if(action.name==='shoot') {
      while(action.nextBullet<=Math.min(action.elapsed,s.shootSeconds)) {
        if(action.pattern==='stream') {
          const target=getCombatHitbox(player);
          const originY=npc.y+neruBodyCenterOffsetY(npc);
          const angle=Math.atan2(target.y-originY,target.x-npc.x);
          const lane=(action.streamIndex++%2===0?-1:1)*s.streamLaneOffset;
          fire(npc,angle,s.streamBulletSpeed,s.bulletRadius,{plasma:true,piercing:true,angle,speed:s.streamBulletSpeed,color:'orange',
            x:npc.x-Math.sin(angle)*lane,y:originY+Math.cos(angle)*lane});
        } else {
          for(let i=0;i<s.bulletCount;i++){const angle=i/s.bulletCount*Math.PI*2+action.nextBullet*1.3;fire(npc,angle,s.bulletSpeed,s.bulletRadius,{plasma:true,angle,speed:s.bulletSpeed,color:'orange',piercing:true});}
        }
        action.nextBullet+=action.pattern==='stream'?s.streamBulletInterval:s.bulletInterval;
      }
      if(action.elapsed>=s.shootSeconds)finish(npc);
    } else if(action.name==='compress') {
      const squish=Math.min(1,action.elapsed/s.compressSeconds);
      npc.bossSquash=1-.45*squish*squish*(3-2*squish);
      if(action.elapsed>=s.compressSeconds-1e-8) {
        begin(npc,'leap',{fromX:npc.x,fromY:npc.y,targetX:npc.x,targetY:npc.y+(npc.spriteSize||300)/2-spriteDisplayPadding,aimLocked:false});

      }

        npc.bossVisualOffsetY=-height*ease;

      const touching=Math.hypot(body.x-b.previousX-dx*t,body.y-b.previousY-dy*t)<body.rx+b.radius;

      }
      if(touching&&delta>0&&!b.cannon&&!b.piercing||b.age>settings.projectileLifetime||!live.has(b.owner))bullets.splice(i,1);
    }

      if(!live.has(z.owner)){zones.splice(i,1);continue;}

    }

  /** Draw attack cues and bullets in world space, with no hitstop or gameplay pauses. */
  function draw(context,camera) {
    context.save();context.lineWidth=2;
    for(const shadow of landingShadows.values()) {
      if(shadow.opacity<=0)continue;
      const x=shadow.x-camera.x,y=shadow.y-camera.y;
      context.fillStyle=`rgba(15,12,28,${.35*(shadow.opacity??1)})`;
      const grow=shadow.growth??1,scale=.35+.65*grow*grow*(3-2*grow);
      context.beginPath();context.ellipse(x,y,shadow.radius*scale,shadow.radius*.45*scale,0,0,Math.PI*2);context.fill();

    }

      context.save();context.translate(w.x-camera.x,w.y-camera.y);context.rotate(w.angle);
      const half=w.width/2,back=w.back||0;
      context.fillStyle='rgba(255,45,70,.16)';context.fillRect(-back,-half,w.length+back,w.width);
      context.strokeStyle='rgba(255,85,100,.65)';context.strokeRect(-back,-half,w.length+back,w.width);
      // Twin inner lines converge on the dash axis as the windup expires.
      const closing=half*(1-w.progress);
      context.strokeStyle='rgba(255,160,165,.85)';context.beginPath();
      context.moveTo(-back,-closing);context.lineTo(w.length,-closing);
      context.moveTo(-back,closing);context.lineTo(w.length,closing);context.stroke();
      context.restore();
    }
    for(const z of zones){
      const localAge=z.artillery?z.age-(z.impactOffset||0):0;
      if(z.artillery&&localAge<0)continue;
      const impact=settings.iroha.artilleryDelay+settings.iroha.artilleryFallSeconds;
      // Each ring starts with its shell's stagger and remains until that shell lands.
      if(!z.artillery||localAge<impact) {
        context.strokeStyle='#ff5264';context.fillStyle='rgba(255,60,90,.12)';context.beginPath();
        context.arc(z.x-camera.x,z.y-camera.y,z.radius,0,Math.PI*2);context.fill();context.stroke();
        if(z.artillery){
          const progress=Math.min(1,localAge/impact);
          context.strokeStyle='rgba(255,180,185,.9)';context.lineWidth=3;context.beginPath();
          context.arc(z.x-camera.x,z.y-camera.y,Math.max(1,z.radius*(1-progress)),0,Math.PI*2);context.stroke();context.lineWidth=2;
        }
      }
      if(z.artillery&&localAge>=settings.iroha.artilleryDelay) {
        const elapsed=localAge-settings.iroha.artilleryDelay;
        if(elapsed<settings.iroha.artilleryFallSeconds) {
          const t=elapsed/settings.iroha.artilleryFallSeconds;
          const x=z.x+z.side*260*(1-t),y=z.y-500*(1-t);
          drawLuminousPlasma(context,camera,{x,y,angle:Math.atan2(500,-z.side*260),
            speed:Math.hypot(260,500)/settings.iroha.artilleryFallSeconds,age:elapsed,color:'orange'},
            settings.iroha.cannonWarningWidth/3.6*settings.iroha.artilleryShellScale,Infinity);
        } else drawArtilleryExplosion(context,camera,z,elapsed-settings.iroha.artilleryFallSeconds);
      }
    }
    for(const b of bullets){
      if(b.plasma){drawLuminousPlasma(context,camera,b,settings.neru.bulletDiameter,settings.projectileLifetime);continue;}
      if(b.cannon){drawLuminousPlasma(context,camera,{...b,color:'orange'},settings.iroha.cannonWarningWidth/3.6,settings.projectileLifetime);continue;}
      context.fillStyle='#61deff';context.strokeStyle='#e5fcff';context.beginPath();context.arc(b.x-camera.x,b.y-camera.y,b.radius,0,Math.PI*2);context.fill();context.stroke();}

    context.restore();
  }
  return {eraseProjectiles:args=>eraseTuningProjectiles({...args,projectiles:bullets}),updateNpc,updateEffects,draw,get screenShake(){
    if(shakeRemaining<=0)return {x:0,y:0};
    const strength=settings.neru.impactShakeStrength*shakeRemaining/settings.neru.impactShakeSeconds;
    return {x:Math.sin(shakeElapsed*91+1)*strength,y:Math.cos(shakeElapsed*113)*strength};
  },get projectileCount(){return bullets.length;},get zoneCount(){return zones.length;}};
}

import { bossCatchupSettings } from './game-config.js';
export { bossCatchupSettings } from './game-config.js';
import { isBossEnemy, enemyViewportDistance } from './world-state.js';
import { statMultiplier } from './combat-stats.js';



/** Boost distant chasing bosses above player speed until their sprite re-enters view. */
export function updateBossCatchup(enemy, player, camera, width, height, baseSpeed = 180) {
  if (!isBossEnemy(enemy) && !enemy.campaignGuardian) return;
  const distance = enemyViewportDistance(enemy, camera, width, height);
  if (distance > bossCatchupSettings.distance) enemy.catchingUp = true;
  if (distance === 0) enemy.catchingUp = false;
  const playerSpeed = baseSpeed * (player.movementSpeedMultiplier || 1) * statMultiplier(player, 'spdPercent');
  const enemySpeed = baseSpeed * (enemy.movementSpeedMultiplier || 1) * statMultiplier(enemy, 'spdPercent');
  enemy.catchupSpeed = enemy.catchingUp && enemy.ai && enemy.behavior === 'chase'
    ? Math.max(enemySpeed * bossCatchupSettings.baseMultiplier,
      playerSpeed * bossCatchupSettings.playerMultiplier + bossCatchupSettings.extraSpeed) : 0;
}

import { bossChanceFormula, bossPityThresholds, enemyTypeStats, eventTriggerSettings } from './game-config.js';
import { bossSpawnSettings } from './game-config.js';
export { bossSpawnSettings } from './game-config.js';
import { bossSpriteSize } from './scene-metrics.js';
import { getAllEnemies, isBossEnemy, onEnemySpawn, onEnemyDefeat } from './world-state.js';
import { offscreenSpawnPoint } from './playtest-spawner.js';



/** Endless kill totals are separate from the boss-charge counter. */
export function bossWaveLimit(endlessKills) {
  return endlessKills >= bossSpawnSettings.thirdBossUnlockKills
    ? bossSpawnSettings.unlockedWaveSize : bossSpawnSettings.waveSize;
}

/** Pick distinct bosses only; missing future roster entries never become duplicates. */
export function selectBossWave(stage, endless, endlessKills, roster, random = Math.random) {
  const available = [...new Set(roster)];
  if (!endless) {
    const preferred = bossTypeForStage(stage, random);
    return available.includes(preferred) ? [preferred] : available.slice(0, 1);
  }
  for (let i = available.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
    const j = Math.floor(random() * (i + 1));
    [available[i], available[j]] = [available[j], available[i]];
  }
  return available.slice(0, bossWaveLimit(endlessKills));
}

/** Stage 1 always uses Shiroko; unassigned stages retain the current test roster. */
export function bossTypeForStage(stage, random = Math.random) {
  return stage.id === 'first' ? 'shiroko' : random() < 0.5 ? 'iroha' : 'shiroko';
}

/** Chance per eligible kill; switch to the shorter pity curve at 5 minutes after Stage 4. */
export function bossChance(kills, endlessSeconds = null) {
  return bossChanceFormula(kills, endlessSeconds);
}

/** Keep progression separate from total run kills and freeze it while bosses live. */
export function createBossCharge(random = Math.random, getEndlessSeconds = () => null) {
  let kills = 0, pending = false;
  return {
    recordDefeat(bossWasAlive) {
      if (bossWasAlive || pending) return;
      kills++;
      const chance = bossChance(kills, getEndlessSeconds());
      if (chance > 0 && (chance >= 1 || random() < chance)) pending = true;
    },
    // Reaching 5 endless minutes can make the existing kill count immediately guaranteed.
    refresh(bossAlive = false) {
      if (!bossAlive && kills >= bossPityThresholds(getEndlessSeconds()).guaranteedKills) pending = true;
    },
    get thresholds() { return bossPityThresholds(getEndlessSeconds()); },
    reset() { kills = 0; pending = false; },
    get kills() { return kills; },
    get pending() { return pending; },
    get chance() { return bossChance(kills, getEndlessSeconds()); }
  };
}

/** Spawn an offscreen chasing boss after a successful kill roll, retrying blocked spots. */
export function createBossSpawner({ canvas, camera, getStage, spawnBoss, slotsRemaining, onSpawn, isEndless,
  getSurvivalSeconds = () => 0, automaticEnabled = () => true, getBossTypes = () => ['shiroko', 'iroha'], getEndlessSeconds = () => null, canSpawnWave = () => true }) {
  const charge = createBossCharge(Math.random, getEndlessSeconds);
  const status = document.querySelector('#boss-spawn-status');
  const details = document.querySelector('#boss-spawn-details');
  let retry = 0;
  let endlessKills = 0;
  let waveQueue = [];
  let firstBossSpawned = false;
  const timedFirstStage = () => !isEndless() && getStage().id === 'first';

  function updateStatus() {
    const alive = getAllEnemies().filter(isBossEnemy).length;
    const state = alive ? `Frozen: ${alive} boss alive.` : !eventTriggerSettings.enabled && !waveQueue.length ? 'Legacy automatic event triggers disabled.' : timedFirstStage() && !waveQueue.length ? 'Shiroko scheduled at 05:00.' : alive ? `Frozen: ${alive} boss alive.` : waveQueue.length || charge.pending ? 'Boss wave ready.'
      : `${(charge.chance * 100).toFixed(2)}% chance per kill.`;
    const text = `Boss charge: ${charge.kills}/${charge.thresholds.guaranteedKills}\n${state}\n${isEndless() ? `Endless kills: ${endlessKills}` : 'Stages 1–4'}`;
    if (status.textContent !== text) status.textContent = text;
    if (details) details.textContent = `Boss wave: ${isEndless() ? Math.min(bossWaveLimit(endlessKills), new Set(getBossTypes()).size) : 1}. Unlocked slots: ${isEndless() ? bossWaveLimit(endlessKills) : 1}. Pity starts: ${charge.thresholds.pityStart} kills. Unique boss types: ${new Set(getBossTypes()).size}. Waiting to place: ${waveQueue.length}.`;
  }
  const stopSpawn = onEnemySpawn(enemy => {
    if (isBossEnemy(enemy)) {
      if (timedFirstStage() && enemy.type === 'shiroko') firstBossSpawned = true;
      charge.reset();
      waveQueue = waveQueue.filter(type => type !== enemy.type);
      updateStatus();
    }
  });
  const stopDefeat = onEnemyDefeat(({ bossesAliveBefore }) => {
    if (isEndless()) endlessKills++;
    if (eventTriggerSettings.enabled && !timedFirstStage()) charge.recordDefeat(bossesAliveBefore > 0 || waveQueue.length > 0);
    updateStatus();
  });

  /** Keep guaranteed spawns pending until a valid offscreen spot and slot exist. */
  function update(delta) {
    if (eventTriggerSettings.enabled && !timedFirstStage()) charge.refresh(getAllEnemies().some(isBossEnemy) || waveQueue.length > 0);
    updateStatus();
    retry = Math.max(0, retry - delta);
    if (retry > 0 || slotsRemaining() <= 0) return;
    if (!waveQueue.length) {
      if (!eventTriggerSettings.enabled) return;
      if (!canSpawnWave()) return;
      if (getAllEnemies().some(isBossEnemy)) return;
      if (timedFirstStage()) {
        if (firstBossSpawned || !automaticEnabled() || getSurvivalSeconds() < enemyTypeStats.shiroko.spawnAtSeconds) return;
      } else if (!charge.pending) return;
      waveQueue = selectBossWave(getStage(), isEndless(), endlessKills, getBossTypes());
    }
    if (!waveQueue.length) return;
    retry = bossSpawnSettings.retryInterval;
    const stage = { ...getStage(), spawnMargin: 150, spawnRadius: bossSpriteSize / 2 };
    let spawned = false;
    for (const type of [...waveQueue]) {
      if (slotsRemaining() <= 0) break;
      if (getAllEnemies().some(enemy => isBossEnemy(enemy) && enemy.type === type)) {
        waveQueue = waveQueue.filter(entry => entry !== type);
        continue;
      }
      for (let attempt = 0; attempt < bossSpawnSettings.placementAttempts; attempt++) {
        const point = offscreenSpawnPoint(stage, camera, canvas.width, canvas.height);
        if (point && spawnBoss(type, point.x, point.y)) {
          waveQueue = waveQueue.filter(entry => entry !== type);
          charge.reset();
          spawned = true;
          break;
        }
      }
    }
    if (spawned) onSpawn();
    updateStatus();
  }
  updateStatus();
  return { update,
    requestWave() {
      if (getAllEnemies().some(isBossEnemy) || waveQueue.length) return false;
      waveQueue = selectBossWave(getStage(), isEndless(), endlessKills, getBossTypes());
      charge.reset();
      retry = 0;
      return waveQueue.length > 0;
    },
    get hasPendingWave() { return waveQueue.length > 0; },
    get endlessKills() { return endlessKills; }, dispose() { stopSpawn(); stopDefeat(); } };
}

/** Endless arrivals use these exact base values, without reapplying Mega HP/ATK bonuses. */
export const endlessEnemySettings = {
  startSeconds: 23 * 60, midoriStartSeconds: 30 * 60,
  mega: { hp: 5000, atk: 15, spd: 1, exp: 25 },
  midori: { hp: 9000, atk: 5, spd: 1.5, exp: 25 },
  enemies: [...mobs, 'pedrozilla', ...arius, ...highlanders, ...sweepers]
};

/** Return an ordinary arrival profile; Midori joins the evenly mixed pool at 30:00. */
export function pickEndlessEnemy(seconds, random = Math.random) {
  const settings = endlessEnemySettings;
  if (seconds < settings.startSeconds) return null;
  const pool = seconds >= settings.midoriStartSeconds ? [...settings.enemies, 'midori'] : settings.enemies;
  const type = pool[Math.min(pool.length - 1, Math.floor(random() * pool.length))];
  const mega = type !== 'midori';
  return {type, mega:false, scheduled:false,
    row:{id:`endless-${type}`, stage:'endless', kind:'regular', enemies:[type],
      ...(mega ? settings.mega : settings.midori), mega, endless:true, start:settings.startSeconds}};
}

--- SNAPSHOT FILE: public/Development/campaign-schedule.js | sha256=ce9599f37dda8342082543ca3dc8cda63bb8e9d85d9bac48f9a4d155637aa6ed | encoding=utf-8-sig ---
import { playerSettings, eliteSizeMultiplier, normalSpriteSize } from './game-config.js';
import { campaignSettings, campaignEnemyRows } from './campaign-config.js';

/** Own the internal chart clock; survival time and gameplay continue during clock freezes. */
export function createCampaignSchedule() {
 let stage='first',seconds=campaignSettings.stageStarts.first;
 let spawned=new Set(),defeated=new Set();
 const rows=()=>campaignEnemyRows.filter(row=>row.stage===stage);
 const required=()=>rows().filter(row=>row.kind==='boss'||row.gate);
 const cleared=()=>required().length>0 && required().every(row=>defeated.has(row.id));
 const fighting=()=>rows().some(row=>(row.kind==='boss'||row.gate)&&spawned.has(row.id)&&!defeated.has(row.id));
 const frozen=()=>rows().some(row=>row.freeze&&seconds>=row.start)&&!cleared();
 return {
  get seconds(){return seconds;},get stage(){return stage;},get frozen(){return frozen();},
  get fightingBoss(){return fighting();},get cleared(){return cleared();},
  get readyToAdvance(){return cleared();},
  seek(value){
   if(!Number.isFinite(value)||value<0)return false;
   seconds=Math.floor(value);
   spawned=new Set(rows().filter(row=>row.kind!=='regular'&&row.start<seconds).map(row=>row.id));
   defeated=new Set(spawned);
   return true;
  },
  setStage(id){if(id===stage)return;stage=id;seconds=campaignSettings.stageStarts[id]??0;spawned=new Set();defeated=new Set();},
  update(delta,spawnEncounter){
   if(!frozen()) {
    const next=seconds+Math.max(0,delta);
    const gate=rows().filter(row=>row.freeze&&!defeated.has(row.id)&&row.start>=seconds).sort((a,b)=>a.start-b.start)[0];
    seconds=gate?Math.min(next,gate.start):next;
   }
   for(const row of rows()) if(row.kind!=='regular'&&seconds>=row.start&&!spawned.has(row.id)) {
    if(spawnEncounter(row))spawned.add(row.id);
   }
  },
  profileFor(type){return rows().filter(row=>row.enemies.includes(type)&&row.start<=seconds).at(-1) || rows().find(row=>row.enemies.includes(type)) || null;},
  recordDefeat(enemy){if(enemy.campaignRowId)defeated.add(enemy.campaignRowId);},
  /** Ordinary selection keeps running while the internal chart clock is frozen. */
  pickSpawn(random=Math.random){
   let pool=rows().filter(row=>row.kind==='regular'&&seconds>=row.start&&seconds<row.end);
   if(stage==='fourth'&&seconds>=campaignSettings.endlessRandomFrom) {
    const latest=new Map();
    for(const row of campaignEnemyRows.filter(r=>r.kind==='regular')) for(const type of row.enemies)latest.set(type,{...row,enemies:[type]});
    pool=[...latest.values()];
   }
   if(!pool.length) pool=rows().filter(row=>row.kind==='regular'&&seconds>=row.start).slice(-1);
   if(!pool.length)return null;
   let row=pool[Math.min(pool.length-1,Math.floor(random()*pool.length))];
   const type=row.enemies[Math.min(row.enemies.length-1,Math.floor(random()*row.enemies.length))];
   let enemy=type,mega=Boolean(row.mega);
   if(fighting()&&random()<campaignSettings.megaChanceDuringBoss){
    const dedicated=rows().find(r=>r.kind==='mini'&&r.baseEnemy===type);
    if(dedicated){row=dedicated;enemy=dedicated.enemies[0];}else mega=true;
   }
   return {row,type:enemy,mega,scheduled:false};
  }
 };
}


/** Exact chart stats override legacy stage/type multipliers; only random Mega rolls add bonuses. */
export function campaignEnemyOverrides(entry, template, baseMovementSpeed = playerSettings.movementBase) {
 const row=entry.row;
 const boosted=Boolean(entry.mega && !row.mega);
 return {label:boosted?`Mega ${template.label || 'Enemy'}`:template.label, hp:row.hp*(boosted?10:1),maxHp:row.hp*(boosted?10:1),
  contactDamage:row.atk*(boosted?2:1),contactDamageMultiplier:1,
  movementSpeedMultiplier:row.spd*playerSettings.speed/baseMovementSpeed,
  expReward:row.exp,perTypeStats:true,
  miniBoss:row.kind==='mini'||Boolean(row.mega)||boosted,boss:row.kind==='boss',
  elite:row.kind==='mini'||Boolean(row.mega)||boosted,
  spriteSize:(template.spriteSize||normalSpriteSize)*((boosted||row.endless&&row.mega)&&!template.miniBoss?(template.megaSizeMultiplier ?? eliteSizeMultiplier):1),
  campaignRowId:entry.scheduled?row.id:null,campaignGuardian:Boolean(row.gate),campaignOverride:true};
}

import { getEnemyHurtbox } from './combat-hitboxes.js';

const buffKey='phrenapates';
function skillFor(player,id=buffKey){return player?.label==='Plana'?player.characterSkills?.find(s=>s?.id===id):null;}
function syncBuff(player,skill,state){
 const amount=[2,3,4][Math.min(2,Math.max(0,(skill.level||1)-1))];
 player.combatBuffs??={};player.combatBuffs[buffKey]={critPercent:Math.min(10,state.stacks)*amount};
}
/** Card-based weapons opt in explicitly; names are never guessed or treated as tags. */
export function phrenapatesHealingWeapon(player,weaponId){
 if(weaponId==='plana-umbrella'||weaponId==='swipe')return true;
 const weapon=player.attackSlots?.find(w=>w?.id===weaponId);
 return Boolean(weapon&&(weapon.usesCards===true||weapon.weaponTags?.includes('card')));
}
export function applyPhrenapatesDefeat({source,weaponId},random=Math.random){
 const skill=skillFor(source);if(!skill||source.hp<=0)return false;
 const state=source.phrenapatesState??={stacks:0,remaining:0};
 state.stacks=Math.min(10,(state.remaining>0?state.stacks:0)+1);state.remaining=4;syncBuff(source,skill,state);
 if(phrenapatesHealingWeapon(source,weaponId)&&random()<.1)healPlayer(source,3);
 return true;
}
function syncCelestiaBuff(player,skill,state){
 const amount=[4,6,8][Math.min(2,Math.max(0,(skill.level||1)-1))];
 player.combatBuffs??={};player.combatBuffs.celestia={atkPercent:Math.min(5,state.stacks)*amount,stacks:state.stacks};
}
/** Copy the accepted critical hit once, without a new damage/crit roll or skill triggers. */
export function applyCelestiaCritical(event,random=Math.random){
 const {source,enemy,requestedDamage,hitType,triggersSkills}=event,skill=skillFor(source,'celestia');
 if(!skill||source.hp<=0||triggersSkills===false||!(event.isCritical??['critical','orangecritical','supercritical'].includes(hitType))||!(requestedDamage>0))return false;
 let state=source.celestiaState;
 if(state?.remaining>0)state.remaining=4; // Every real crit refreshes an existing buff, even a failed proc.
 if(random()>=.25)return false;
 state=source.celestiaState??={stacks:0,remaining:0};state.stacks=Math.min(5,(state.remaining>0?state.stacks:0)+1);state.remaining=4;
 syncCelestiaBuff(source,skill,state);
 const origin=getEnemyHurtbox(enemy),display=characterCriticalMultiplier(source)>=2?'orangecritical':'critical';
 for(const target of getAllEnemies()){
  if(!(target.hp>0))continue;
  const body=getEnemyHurtbox(target),dx=body.x-origin.x,dy=body.y-origin.y,distance=Math.hypot(dx,dy);
  const extent=distance?1/Math.hypot(dx/distance/body.rx,dy/distance/body.ry):0;
  if(distance>75+extent)continue;
  damageEnemy(target.id,requestedDamage,source,display,{weaponId:'celestia',isCritical:false,triggersSkills:false});
 }
 return true;
}
/** Only confirmed kills/accepted real criticals can feed character skills. */
export function createCharacterSkillEffects({random=Math.random}={}){
 const stopDefeat=onEnemyDefeat(event=>applyPhrenapatesDefeat(event,random));
 const stopDamage=onEnemyDamage(event=>applyCelestiaCritical(event,random));
 return {dispose(){stopDefeat();stopDamage();}};
}
export function updateCharacterSkills(player,delta){
 for(const [id,key,sync]of [['phrenapates','phrenapatesState',syncBuff],['celestia','celestiaState',syncCelestiaBuff]]){
  const skill=skillFor(player,id),state=player[key];if(!state)continue;
  if(!skill||player.hp<=0){delete player[key];if(player.combatBuffs)delete player.combatBuffs[id];continue;}
  state.remaining=Math.max(0,state.remaining-Math.max(0,delta));
  if(state.remaining<=1e-8){state.remaining=0;state.stacks=0;if(player.combatBuffs)delete player.combatBuffs[id];}
  else sync(player,skill,state);
 }
}

export function createCharacterSkillAdmin({root,getPlayer}){
 if(!root)return;
 for(const [create,describe]of [[createPhrenapatesSkill,phrenapatesDescription],[createCelestiaSkill,celestiaDescription],[createSwipeSkill,swipeDescription]]){
  const candidate=create(),button=document.createElement('button'),status=document.createElement('p');
  button.type='button';button.textContent=`Learn / level ${candidate.name}`;status.setAttribute('role','status');button.title=describe(1);
  button.addEventListener('click',()=>{const player=getPlayer();if(player.label!=='Plana'){status.textContent=`${candidate.name} belongs to Plana.`;return;}
   const skill=player.characterSkills?.find(s=>s?.id===candidate.id);

   updateCharacterSkills(player,0);const current=skillFor(player,candidate.id);status.textContent=`${candidate.name} ${current.level>=3?'MAX':`LV ${current.level}`} learned.`;
  });root.append(button,status);
 }
}

import { applyResolvedPlayerDamage } from './player-stats.js';
/** Shared debt pool; removing/upgrading the item never forgives damage already deferred. */
export function updateChiseDamage(player,delta){
 if(!(delta>0)||!Number.isFinite(delta)||!chiseDelayConfigured()||!(player.chisePendingDamage>0))return;
 player.chiseTickElapsed=(player.chiseTickElapsed||0)+delta;
 while(player.chiseTickElapsed>=chisePlushieSettings.tickSeconds-1e-8&&player.chisePendingDamage>0){
  player.chiseTickElapsed-=chisePlushieSettings.tickSeconds;
  const rule=chisePlushieSettings.damagePerTick;
  const requested=typeof rule==='function'?rule(player.chisePendingDamage,player):Number(rule);
  if(!Number.isFinite(requested)||requested<=0)break;
  const damage=Math.min(player.chisePendingDamage,requested);
  player.chisePendingDamage=Math.max(0,player.chisePendingDamage-damage);
  applyResolvedPlayerDamage(player,damage);
 }
 if(!(player.chisePendingDamage>0))player.chiseTickElapsed=0;
}

import {tryWeakTuningHit} from './weak-tuning.js';
import {tryNeutralizationHit} from './neutralization-tuning.js';

import {tryRepairTuningHit} from './repair-tuning.js';

import {applyFrozen} from './frozen-status.js';
import {damageEnemy} from './world-state.js';
/** Starting-weapon on-hit effect; its own cold damage cannot trigger another proc. */
export function tryColdTuningHit({player,enemy,rollDamage,random=Math.random,weaponId='plana-umbrella'}){
  const main=player.mainWeaponId??(player.label==='Plana'?'plana-umbrella':null);
  if(main!==weaponId||!player.tuningParts||enemy.hp<=0||enemy.frozenRemaining>0)return false;
  const percent=tuningPerk(player.tuningParts,'coldDamagePercent');
  if(!percent||(enemy.secondsSincePlayerHit||0)<coldTuningSettings.safeSeconds||random()>=coldTuningSettings.procChance)return false;
  if(!applyFrozen(enemy,coldTuningSettings.freezeSeconds))return false;
  const hit=rollDamage(enemy,percent/100);
  const hpBefore=enemy.hp;
  const landed=damageEnemy(enemy.id,hit.damage,player,hit.type,{coldTuning:true});
  if(landed&&tuningPerk(player.tuningParts,'weakChance')>0)tryWeakTuningHit({player,enemy});
  if(landed&&tuningPerk(player.tuningParts,'stunChance')>0)tryNeutralizationHit({player,enemy});
  if(landed&&tuningPerk(player.tuningParts,'targetPercent')>0)shareTargetTuningDamage({player,enemy,damage:Math.min(hpBefore,hit.damage),hitType:hit.type});
  if(landed&&tuningPerk(player.tuningParts,'repairMaxHpPercent')>0)tryRepairTuningHit({player});
  if(landed&&tuningPerk(player.tuningParts,'creditChancePercent')>0)tryLuxeryTuningHit({player,enemy,damage:hit.damage});
  return true;
}

import { combatBalance } from './game-config.js';
import { normalSpriteSize, spriteDisplayPadding } from './scene-metrics.js';

// EDIT half-width, half-height and center offset as fractions of display size.
// Ellipses exclude transparent corners while covering more of the visible body.
export const combatHitboxes = {
  plana: { rx: 0.27, ry: 0.38, y: 0.03, playerOffsetY: 6, playerRadiusScale: 0.72 }, // Pixels downward for the controlled player.
  arona: { rx: 0.25, ry: 0.39, y: 0.03 },
  // Small foot-level ellipse: tune rx/ry for size; feet keeps it at the sprite baseline.
  midori: { rx: 0.13, ry: 0.075, radiusSize: normalSpriteSize, feet: true },
  yuuka: { rx: 0.25, ry: 0.42, y: 0.02 },
  mob: { rx: 0.28, ry: 0.28, y: 0.04, eliteOffsetY: 6, normalOffsetY: 6 }, // Circular Mob collider; elite variants scale the same profile.
  iroha: { rx: 0.44, ry: 0.29, y: 0.06 },
  shiroko: { rx: 0.30, ry: 0.30, y: 0.05 } // Center on the visible body below the halo.
};

/** Return a stable body ellipse, scaling automatically for elite/boss sizes. */
export function getCombatHitbox(character, enemy = Boolean(character.id)) {
  const name = (character.type || character.label || 'mob').toLowerCase();
  const key = Object.keys(combatHitboxes).find(type => name.includes(type)) || 'mob';
  const profile = character.combatHitbox || combatHitboxes[key];
  const size = character.spriteSize || normalSpriteSize;
  const hitboxScale = enemy ? combatBalance.enemyHitboxScale : 1;
  const radiusSize = profile.radiusSize || size;
  const rx = radiusSize * profile.rx * hitboxScale * (enemy ? 1 : profile.playerRadiusScale || 1);
  // Compress player height to the existing half-width, producing a centered circle.
  const ry = enemy ? radiusSize * profile.ry * hitboxScale : rx;
  // Foot-anchored profiles retain their small dimensions when the artwork grows.
  const offsetY = !enemy ? (profile.playerOffsetY || 0) : profile.feet ? size / 2 - spriteDisplayPadding - ry : size * profile.y;
  const eliteOffsetY = enemy ? (character.elite ? profile.eliteOffsetY || 0 : profile.normalOffsetY || 0) : 0;
  return { x: character.x, y: character.y + offsetY + eliteOffsetY, rx, ry };
}

/** Damage-receiving sprite bounds are separate from the small contact-damage ellipse. */
function unflattenedEnemyHurtbox(character) {
  const size=character.spriteSize||normalSpriteSize;
  const bounds=character.spriteHurtbox||{offsetX:0,offsetY:0,width:size-spriteDisplayPadding*2,height:size-spriteDisplayPadding*2};
  const oval=bounds.mask?.ellipse;
  if(oval)return {x:character.x+bounds.offsetX+(oval.x-.5)*bounds.width*(bounds.mirrored?-1:1),
    y:character.y+bounds.offsetY+(oval.y-.5)*bounds.height,
    rx:oval.rx*bounds.width,ry:oval.ry*bounds.height,shape:'ellipse',
    coverage:oval.coverage,emptyFraction:oval.emptyFraction,meetsTargets:oval.meetsTargets};
  return {x:character.x+bounds.offsetX,y:character.y+bounds.offsetY,
    rx:Math.max(1,bounds.width/2),ry:Math.max(1,bounds.height/2),shape:'rectangle',
    mask:bounds.mask,mirrored:bounds.mirrored,maskWidth:bounds.width,maskHeight:bounds.height};
}

/** Flattening changes only the received-damage silhouette, never the contact-damage hitbox. */
export function getEnemyHurtbox(character){
 const body=unflattenedEnemyHurtbox(character);if(!(character.flattenedRemaining>0))return body;
 const foot=character.y+(character.spriteSize||normalSpriteSize)/2-spriteDisplayPadding+(character.bossVisualOffsetY||0);
 return {...body,x:character.x+(body.x-character.x)*1.12,y:foot+(body.y-foot)*.2,rx:body.rx*1.12,ry:body.ry*.2,
   maskWidth:body.maskWidth?body.maskWidth*1.12:undefined,maskHeight:body.maskHeight?body.maskHeight*.2:undefined};
}

/** Test a segment against sprite rectangles or the existing contact ellipses. */
export function segmentHitsBody(body, x1, y1, x2, y2) {
  if(body.shape==='rectangle') {
    let near=0,far=1;
    for(const [start,end,center,radius] of [[x1,x2,body.x,body.rx],[y1,y2,body.y,body.ry]]) {
      const delta=end-start;
      if(Math.abs(delta)<1e-10){if(start<center-radius||start>center+radius)return false;continue;}
      let a=(center-radius-start)/delta,b=(center+radius-start)/delta;
      if(a>b)[a,b]=[b,a];near=Math.max(near,a);far=Math.min(far,b);
      if(near>far)return false;
    }
    if(!body.mask)return true;
    // The broad crop rectangle overlaps; now require actual opaque sprite pixels.
    const padX=Math.max(0,body.rx-body.maskWidth/2),padY=Math.max(0,body.ry-body.maskHeight/2);
    return body.mask.some(run=>segmentHitsBody({shape:'rectangle',
      x:body.x+(run.x-.5)*body.maskWidth*(body.mirrored?-1:1),
      y:body.y+(run.y-.5)*body.maskHeight,
      rx:run.width*body.maskWidth/2+padX,ry:run.height*body.maskHeight/2+padY},x1,y1,x2,y2));
  }
  const x = (x1 - body.x) / body.rx, y = (y1 - body.y) / body.ry;
  const dx = (x2 - x1) / body.rx, dy = (y2 - y1) / body.ry;
  const length = dx * dx + dy * dy;
  const t = length ? Math.max(0, Math.min(1, -(x * dx + y * dy) / length)) : 0;
  return (x + dx * t) ** 2 + (y + dy * t) ** 2 <= 1;
}

import { sportsDrinkCritBonus, itemCritPenalty, itemDamageBonus, overclockingStats, itemSkillDamageMultiplier } from './item-catalog.js';
import { tuningPerk, startingWeaponProjectileCount, emptyWeaponSlotCount, weaponTuningDamageBonus, stationaryTuningActive } from './tuning-parts.js';
import { percentBonusFormula, attackDamageFormula, weaponDamageFormula, growthSettings, totalATKFormula, attackStatSettings, totalCritModFormula, bonusDamageTakenFormula, damageBonusFormula, damageReductionFormula, haloDamageFormula, damageModifiersFormula } from './game-config.js';
import { defaultCombatStats, combatBalance } from './game-config.js';
export { defaultCombatStats } from './game-config.js';
// Percent bonuses: zero keeps base values. CRIT is a direct chance percentage.


/** Initialize independent per-character combat stats without resetting upgrades. */
export function ensureCombatStats(character) {
  character.combatStats ??= {};
  character.combatStats.damageBonusMultipliers ??= [];
  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(defaultCombatStats)) character.combatStats[key] ??= key==='critPercent'?(character.baseCritPercent??value):value;
  return character.combatStats;
}

/** Convert a bonus percentage to a multiplier (25% means 1.25 times base). */
export function statMultiplier(character, key) {
  const value = Number(ensureCombatStats(character)[key]);
  if (key === 'atkPercent') return totalCharacterATK(character) / 100;
  return percentBonusFormula(value+(key==='spdPercent'?(character.baseSPD??100)-100:0)+(key==='spdPercent'&&character.tuningParts?tuningPerk(character.tuningParts,'characterSpeedPercent'):0));
}

/** Roll per-hit critical chance; target debuffs add percentage points before clamping. */
export function rollAttackDamage(character, totalWeaponDamage, random = Math.random,
  { damageMod = 1, forceCritical = false, targetCritBonus = 0, criticalMultiplier, weaponCritDamagePercent = 0, target, weaponId, skillAttack = false } = {}) {
  const stats = ensureCombatStats(character);
  const buffs=Object.values(character.combatBuffs||{}).filter(Boolean);
  const bonusCrit=buffs.reduce((sum,buff)=>sum+(Number(buff.critPercent)||0),0);
  const critical = forceCritical || random() < Math.max(0, Math.min(100, stats.critPercent + bonusCrit + targetCritBonus + sportsDrinkCritBonus(character) - itemCritPenalty(character) + startingWeaponTuning(character,weaponId,'critChancePercent'))) / 100;
  const combinedModifier = damageModifiersFormula({
    criticalMultiplier: critical ? characterCriticalMultiplier(character, criticalMultiplier, weaponCritDamagePercent + startingWeaponTuning(character,weaponId,'critDamagePercent')) : 1,
    bonusDamageTaken: bonusDamageTakenFormula([].concat(target?.bonusDamageTakenPercent??[],target?.weakRemaining>0?target.weakDefensePercent:0)),
    DB: damageBonusFormula([...stats.damageBonusMultipliers,itemDamageBonus(character),...buffs.map(buff=>buff.damageBonusMultiplier).filter(Number.isFinite)]),
    DR: damageReductionFormula(target?.damageReductionPercent ?? []),
    halo: characterHaloMultiplier(character, target),
    attackModifier: damageMod*(skillAttack?itemSkillDamageMultiplier(character):1) // Attack-specific effects, including EX drawing accuracy.
  });
  return { damage: attackDamageFormula(totalWeaponDamage, totalCharacterATK(character), combinedModifier, random),
    critical, type: critical ? (characterCriticalMultiplier(character)>=2?'orangecritical':'critical') : 'normal' };
}

/** Parts affect only the explicitly identified character starting weapon. */
export function startingWeaponTuning(character,weaponId,key) {
  const main=character.mainWeaponId??(character.label==='Plana'?'plana-umbrella':null);
  return main&&weaponId===main&&character.tuningParts?tuningPerk(character.tuningParts,key):0;
}

/** Build weapon damage with independent level bonuses and optional purchased Growth.
 * mainWeaponId can explicitly identify a character main weapon; Plana defaults to her umbrella.
 */
export function totalWeaponDamage(character, weaponId, base, bonusesPercent = [], options = {}) {
  const mainWeaponId = character.mainWeaponId ?? (character.label === 'Plana' ? 'plana-umbrella' : null);
  const weapon=character.attackSlots?.find(item=>item?.id===weaponId);
  const soloBonus=character.tuningParts&&options.soloTuningEligible!==false&&weapon?.soloTuningEligible!==false?startingWeaponTuning(character,weaponId,'soloDamagePerEmptyPercent')*emptyWeaponSlotCount(character):0;
  return weaponDamageFormula(base, [...bonusesPercent,startingWeaponTuning(character,weaponId,'damagePercent'),-startingWeaponTuning(character,weaponId,'weaponDamagePenaltyPercent'),soloBonus,character.tuningParts&&stationaryTuningActive(character)?startingWeaponTuning(character,weaponId,'stationaryDamagePercent'):0,character.tuningParts?weaponTuningDamageBonus(character,weaponId):0], {
    ...options, projectileCount:character.tuningParts?startingWeaponProjectileCount(character,weaponId,options.projectileCount??weapon?.attackCount??1):(options.projectileCount??weapon?.attackCount??1), enhancementRank:weapon?.enhancementRank ?? 0, growthEligible: weaponId === mainWeaponId,
    growthRank: options.growthEligible===false?0:(character.growthRank ?? growthSettings.defaultRank), playerLevel: character.level ?? 1
  });
}


/** Add the accumulated item/skill ATK bonus to the character's independent base ATK. */
export function totalCharacterATK(character) {
  return totalATKFormula(character.baseATK ?? attackStatSettings.baseATK,
    [Number(ensureCombatStats(character).atkPercent),overclockingStats(character).atk,...Object.values(character.combatBuffs||{}).map(buff=>Number(buff?.atkPercent)||0)]);
}


/** Add character and weapon critical damage bonuses; overrides replace only the base.
 * criticalMultiplier is an optional weapon base override (e.g. Umbrella LV7=3).
 * critDamagePercent contains accumulated bonuses, separate from critical chance.
 */
export function characterCriticalMultiplier(character, criticalMultiplier, weaponBonus = 0) {
  const base = criticalMultiplier !== undefined ? (criticalMultiplier - 1) * 100 :
    (character.baseCritMod ?? (combatBalance.criticalMultiplier - 1) * 100);
  const bonus = ensureCombatStats(character).critDamagePercent;
  return Math.max(0, 1 + totalCritModFormula(base, [bonus, weaponBonus]) / 100);
}


/** Measure character-to-target world distance at the hit, never from projectile origin. */
export function characterHaloMultiplier(character, target) {
  if (!target || ![character.x, character.y, target.x, target.y].every(Number.isFinite)) return 1;
  return haloDamageFormula(Math.hypot(target.x - character.x, target.y - character.y), character.haloLevel ?? 0);
}

/** Crop/rotate the actual inventory icon, matching the HUD rather than stretching a sheet. */
function inventoryIcon(target) {

  canvas.className='crafter-inventory-icon';canvas.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');

--- SNAPSHOT FILE: public/Development/crafter-rules.js | sha256=02938632d38a4fc9ec34a5c0a5f42498584143ccdfcdee5b773acb2382dc6e71 | encoding=utf-8-sig ---
import { createMalkuthHat } from './item-catalog.js';
import { crafterSettings, crafterEnhancementCost, crafterEnhancementChance, umbrellaUpgradeSettings, arisWeaponSettings } from './game-config.js';
import { getLootTotals, spendCredits, spendSecretTechNotes } from './exp-drops.js';
import { recordWeaponMax } from './weapon-max-order.js';

/** List only equipped targets, keeping upgrades capped and offering only defined awakening paths. */
export function crafterChoices(player) {
  const choices=[],loot=getLootTotals();
  for(const [kind,slots] of [['weapon',player.attackSlots||[]],['item',player.equipmentSlots||[]]]) {
    slots.forEach((target,index)=>{
      if(!target)return;
      const max=target.id==='plana-umbrella'?umbrellaUpgradeSettings.maxLevel:
        target.id==='aris-laser'?arisWeaponSettings.maxLevel:target.maxLevel;
      if(!Number.isFinite(max))return;
      const prefix=`${kind}:${index}`,name=target.name||target.id||'Item',level=target.level||1;
      if(!target.isSynergy&&level<max)choices.push({id:`${prefix}:level`,target,kind,name,label:`Upgrade to LV ${level+1}`,cost:0,disabled:false});
      else if(kind==='weapon') {
        const rank=(target.enhancementRank||0)+1,cost=crafterEnhancementCost(rank);
        const chance=crafterEnhancementChance(rank,player.enhancementRateBonusPercent||0);
        choices.push({id:`${prefix}:enhance`,target,kind,name,label:`Enhance +${rank} — ${cost} Credits — ${Math.round(chance*100)}% success`,cost,chance,rank,disabled:loot.credits<cost});
      }
      if(kind==='item'&&target.id==='malkuth-hat'&&level>=max&&!target.awakened)
        choices.push({id:`${prefix}:awaken`,target,kind,name,label:'Awaken - 1 Secret Tech Note',disabled:loot.secretTechNotes<1});
      const main=player.mainWeaponId??(player.label==='Plana'?'plana-umbrella':null);
      if(kind==='weapon'&&target.id==='plana-umbrella'&&main===target.id&&level>=max&&!target.awakened) {
        choices.push({id:`${prefix}:awaken`,target,kind,name,label:`Awaken — ${umbrellaUpgradeSettings.awakeningNoteCost} Secret Tech Note`,disabled:loot.secretTechNotes<umbrellaUpgradeSettings.awakeningNoteCost});
      }
    });
  }
  return choices;
}

/** A valid attempt consumes one Crafter even when a paid enhancement fails. */
export function applyCrafterChoice(player,id,random=Math.random) {
  const choice=crafterChoices(player).find(c=>c.id===id);
  if(!choice||choice.disabled)return {consumed:false,success:false,message:'That upgrade is unavailable.'};
  const action=id.split(':').at(-1),target=choice.target;
  if(action==='level') {target.level=(target.level||1)+1;if(choice.kind==='weapon')recordWeaponMax(player,target);return {consumed:true,success:true,message:`${choice.name} upgraded to LV ${target.level}.`};}
  if(action==='awaken') {
    if(!spendSecretTechNotes(choice.kind==='item'?1:umbrellaUpgradeSettings.awakeningNoteCost))return {consumed:false,success:false};
    if(choice.kind==='item')Object.assign(target,createMalkuthHat(true));
    target.awakened=true;return {consumed:true,success:true,message:`${choice.name} awakened!`};
  }
  if(!spendCredits(choice.cost))return {consumed:false,success:false};
  const success=random()<choice.chance;
  if(success)target.enhancementRank=choice.rank;
  return {consumed:true,success,message:success?`${choice.name} enhanced to +${choice.rank}!`:`Enhancement failed. ${choice.cost} Credits and the Crafter were consumed.`};
}

import { createPickupReentryGuard } from './pickup-reentry.js';

/** Shared draw/contact rectangle, including the icon's scale and upward ground offset. */
export function crafterSpriteBounds(drop) {
  const scale=crafterSettings.iconScale;
  return {left:drop.x-18*scale,right:drop.x+18*scale,top:drop.y-46*scale,bottom:drop.y+scale};
}

/** Inclusive swept segment/rectangle test, so fast movement cannot skip a Crafter. */
function segmentTouchesRectangle(from,to,box) {
  let enter=0,exit=1;
  for(const [start,end,min,max] of [[from.x,to.x,box.left,box.right],[from.y,to.y,box.top,box.bottom]]) {
    const delta=end-start;
    if(Math.abs(delta)<1e-10){if(start<min||start>max)return false;continue;}
    const a=(min-start)/delta,b=(max-start)/delta;
    enter=Math.max(enter,Math.min(a,b));exit=Math.min(exit,Math.max(a,b));
    if(enter>exit)return false;
  }
  return true;
}

/** Sweep the real player ellipse against the visible icon, with rounded-corner accuracy. */
export function crafterTouchesPlayer(drop,player,previous=player,padding=0) {
  const body=getCombatHitbox(player,false),from=getCombatHitbox({...player,x:previous.x,y:previous.y},false);
  const sprite=crafterSpriteBounds(drop);
  const box={left:sprite.left-padding,right:sprite.right+padding,top:sprite.top-padding,bottom:sprite.bottom+padding};
  // The Minkowski sum of a rectangle and ellipse is two bars plus four elliptical corners.
  if(segmentTouchesRectangle(from,body,{...box,left:box.left-body.rx,right:box.right+body.rx})||
    segmentTouchesRectangle(from,body,{...box,top:box.top-body.ry,bottom:box.bottom+body.ry}))return true;
  return [box.left,box.right].some(x=>[box.top,box.bottom].some(y=>
    segmentHitsBody({x,y,rx:body.rx,ry:body.ry},from.x,from.y,body.x,body.y)));
}

/** Steady white ground glow and soft cyan-white pillar; purely visual, with no flashing. */
export function drawCrafterGlow(context,x,y,golden=false,pillarHeight=crafterSettings.glow.pillarHeight) {
  const glow={...crafterSettings.glow,pillarHeight};
  context.save();context.globalCompositeOperation='lighter';context.globalAlpha=glow.opacity;
  if(golden)context.filter='sepia(1) saturate(4)';
  // Stretch a radial falloff into a narrow pillar, extending below and above the icon.
  context.save();context.translate(x,y-glow.pillarHeight*.45);
  context.scale(glow.pillarWidth/(glow.pillarHeight+24),1);
  const pillar=context.createRadialGradient(0,0,0,0,0,glow.pillarHeight*.6);
  pillar.addColorStop(0,'rgba(235,255,255,.6)');pillar.addColorStop(.35,'rgba(135,245,255,.32)');pillar.addColorStop(1,'rgba(100,235,255,0)');
  context.fillStyle=pillar;context.fillRect(-glow.pillarHeight,-glow.pillarHeight,glow.pillarHeight*2,glow.pillarHeight*2);context.restore();
  const core=context.createLinearGradient(0,y-glow.pillarHeight,0,y+8);
  core.addColorStop(0,'rgba(255,255,255,0)');core.addColorStop(.3,'rgba(235,255,255,.12)');core.addColorStop(.85,'rgba(255,255,255,.45)');core.addColorStop(1,'rgba(255,255,255,0)');
  context.fillStyle=core;context.fillRect(x-3,y-glow.pillarHeight,6,glow.pillarHeight+8);
  // Flatten the base into a luminous pool of light on the ground.
  context.globalAlpha=Math.min(1,glow.opacity*1.2);
  context.translate(x,y+2);context.scale(1,.32);
  const base=context.createRadialGradient(0,0,0,0,0,glow.baseRadius);
  base.addColorStop(0,'rgba(255,255,255,.95)');base.addColorStop(.3,'rgba(255,255,255,.65)');base.addColorStop(.65,'rgba(150,245,255,.3)');base.addColorStop(1,'rgba(120,235,255,0)');
  context.fillStyle=base;context.fillRect(-glow.baseRadius,-glow.baseRadius,glow.baseRadius*2,glow.baseRadius*2);
  context.restore();
}

/** Run-scoped, non-magnetic Crafter drops and the paused, cancellable upgrade menu. */
export function createCrafterSystem({getPlayer,canvas,onOpen=()=>{},onChange=()=>{},onResult=()=>{},golden=false,getMinuteTimer=()=>0}) {
  const drops=new Map();let nextId=0,active=null;const reentry=createPickupReentryGuard();

export const damageFlashDuration = 240; // EDIT total pulse length in milliseconds.
const riseDuration = 45; // Fast gradual rise, followed by a longer fade out.
const whiteSprites = new WeakMap();

/** Return a smooth white-tint intensity, never a full-screen or rectangular flash. */
export function getDamageFlashOpacity(character) {
  const elapsed = character.damageFlashElapsed;
  if (elapsed === undefined || elapsed < 0 || elapsed >= damageFlashDuration) return 0;
  const progress = elapsed < riseDuration
    ? elapsed / riseDuration
    : 1 - (elapsed - riseDuration) / (damageFlashDuration - riseDuration);
  const smooth = progress * progress * (3 - 2 * progress);
  return smooth * 0.85;
}

/** Advance visual feedback independently of whether movement AI is paused. */
export function advanceDamageFlash(character, delta) {
  if (character.damageFlashElapsed === undefined) return;
  character.damageFlashElapsed += delta * 1000;
  if (character.damageFlashElapsed >= damageFlashDuration) {
    delete character.damageFlashElapsed;
  }
}

/** Cache a white silhouette retaining the original image's transparent pixels. */
export function getWhiteSprite(image) {
  if (!whiteSprites.has(image)) {
    const surface = document.createElement('canvas');
    surface.width = image.naturalWidth;
    surface.height = image.naturalHeight;
    const context = surface.getContext('2d');
    context.drawImage(image, 0, 0);
    context.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-in';
    context.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    context.fillRect(0, 0, surface.width, surface.height);
    whiteSprites.set(image, surface);
  }
  return whiteSprites.get(image);
}

const slowedSprites=new WeakMap();
/** Slow overlays tint opaque sprite pixels only; cached per sheet or decoded GIF frame. */
export function getSlowedSprite(image){
 if(!slowedSprites.has(image)){
  const surface=document.createElement('canvas');surface.width=image.naturalWidth;surface.height=image.naturalHeight;
  const context=surface.getContext('2d');context.drawImage(image,0,0);context.globalCompositeOperation='source-in';context.fillStyle='#173c86';context.fillRect(0,0,surface.width,surface.height);slowedSprites.set(image,surface);
 }
 return slowedSprites.get(image);
}
export function getSlowTintOpacity(character){
 if(character.death||character.hp===0||character.isPlayerVisual)return 0;
 return (character.ridingWaveSlowRemaining>0||(character.splashSlowRemaining>0&&character.splashSlowPercent>0)||(character.slowdownRemaining>0&&character.slowdownPercent>0)) ? .48 : 0;
}

import { damageNumberSettings } from './game-config.js';
export { damageNumberSettings } from './game-config.js';
import { fontMetrics } from './font-metrics.js';

const numbers = [];
const textCache = new Map();
let font;

/** Load one shared bitmap font for all damage numbers. */
export function loadDamageNumberGraphics() {
  font = new Image();
  font.src = '../sprites/font.png';
  return font.decode();
}

/** Format normal, yellow/orange critical, and red supercritical visuals. */
export function damageNumberStyle(amount, player = false, hitType = 'normal') {
  if (hitType === 'miss') return { text: 'MISS', color: '#ffffff', italic: true };
  const text = String(Math.round(amount * 100) / 100);
  if (hitType === 'shield') return { text, color: '#62cfff', italic: false };
  if (player) return { text, color: '#ff5265', italic: false };
  if (hitType === 'supercritical') return { text: `${text}!!!`, color: '#ff5265', italic: true, scale: 1.1 };
  if (hitType === 'orangecritical') return { text: `${text}!`, color: '#ffad48', italic: true, scale: 1.1 };
  if (hitType === 'critical') return { text: `${text}!`, color: '#ffe15a', italic: true, scale: 1.1 };
  return { text, color: '#ffffff', italic: false };
}

/** Queue a damage popup; supercritical styling does not define its trigger. */
export function showDamageNumber(target, amount, player = false, hitType = 'normal', group = null) {
  if ((!(amount > 0) && hitType !== 'miss') || !Number.isFinite(amount) || !Number.isFinite(target.x) || !Number.isFinite(target.y)) return;
  // Only the synergy accumulates rapid hits, independently for each enemy and damage source.
  if(group&&hitType!=='miss') {
    const existing=numbers.findLast(number=>number.target===target&&number.group===group&&!number.closed);
    if(existing&&existing.hitType===hitType&&existing.sinceHit<=.3) {
      existing.amount+=amount;existing.sinceHit=0;existing.elapsed=0;
      Object.assign(existing,{scale:1},damageNumberStyle(existing.amount,player,existing.hitType));
      existing.x=target.x;existing.y=target.y-(target.spriteSize||112)*.4;return;
    }
    // A changed hit type ends this run permanently; its popup continues its existing fade.
    if(existing)existing.closed=true;
  }
  if (numbers.length >= damageNumberSettings.maxCount) numbers.shift();
  numbers.push({ ...damageNumberStyle(amount, player, hitType), elapsed: 0,
    x: target.x, y: target.y - (target.spriteSize || 112) * 0.4,
    target,group,amount,hitType,closed:false,sinceHit:0,drift: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 24 });
}

/** Calculate the upward bounce, downward fall, and gradual end fade. */
export function damageNumberPose(number) {
  const t = number.elapsed;
  const progress = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, t / damageNumberSettings.duration));
  const fade = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (t - damageNumberSettings.fadeStart) /
    (damageNumberSettings.duration - damageNumberSettings.fadeStart)));
  return { x: number.x + number.drift * t,
    y: number.y - 4 * damageNumberSettings.jumpHeight * progress * (1 - progress),
    opacity: 1 - fade * fade };
}

/** Expire popups even when their targets die or leave the viewport. */
export function updateDamageNumbers(delta) {
  for (let i = numbers.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    numbers[i].elapsed += delta;
    numbers[i].sinceHit += delta;
    if (numbers[i].elapsed >= damageNumberSettings.duration) numbers.splice(i, 1);
  }
}

/** Cache compact tinted bitmap numbers, preserving the font's dark outline. */
function numberGraphic(text, color) {
  const key = `${text}:${color}`;
  if (textCache.has(key)) return textCache.get(key);
  const glyphs = [...text].map(letter => fontMetrics[letter] || fontMetrics['?']);
  const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
  canvas.width = glyphs.reduce((sum, glyph) => sum + glyph.width - 1, 1);
  canvas.height = 20;
  const context = canvas.getContext('2d');
  let x = 0;
  for (const glyph of glyphs) {
    context.drawImage(font, glyph.x, glyph.y, glyph.width, glyph.height,
      x, glyph.offsetY, glyph.width, glyph.height);
    x += glyph.width - 1;
  }
  if (color !== '#ffffff') {
    const mask = document.createElement('canvas');
    mask.width = canvas.width;
    mask.height = canvas.height;
    mask.getContext('2d').drawImage(canvas, 0, 0);
    context.globalCompositeOperation = 'multiply';
    context.fillStyle = color;
    context.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    context.globalCompositeOperation = 'destination-in';
    context.drawImage(mask, 0, 0);
  }
  if (textCache.size >= 128) textCache.delete(textCache.keys().next().value);
  textCache.set(key, canvas);
  return canvas;
}

/** Draw world-anchored numbers above actors, leaving the HUD unaffected. */
export function drawDamageNumbers(context, camera, width, height) {
  if (!font?.naturalWidth) return;
  context.save();
  context.imageSmoothingEnabled = false;
  for (const number of numbers) {
    const pose = damageNumberPose(number);
    const x = pose.x - camera.x, y = pose.y - camera.y;
    if (x < -100 || y < -50 || x > width + 100 || y > height + 50) continue;
    const graphic = numberGraphic(number.text, number.color);
    context.save();
    context.translate(x, y);
    context.scale(number.scale ?? 1, number.scale ?? 1);
    if (number.italic) context.transform(1, 0, -0.18, 1, 0, 0);
    context.globalAlpha = pose.opacity;
    context.drawImage(graphic, -graphic.width * 0.625, 0, graphic.width * 1.25, 25);
    context.restore();
  }
  context.restore();
}

/** Own a worker and route recognition results without blocking animation or uploading sketches. */
export function createDrawingRecognizer() {
  let worker, nextId = 0;
  const pending = new Map();
  function getWorker() {
    if (!worker) {
      worker = new Worker(new URL('./drawing-recognizer.worker.js', import.meta.url), { type: 'module' });
      worker.addEventListener('message', ({ data }) => {
        const job = pending.get(data.id);
        if (!job) return;
        pending.delete(data.id); clearTimeout(job.timeout);
        if (data.error) job.reject(new Error(data.error)); else job.resolve(data.predictions || []);
      });
      worker.addEventListener('error', () => {
        for (const job of pending.values()) { clearTimeout(job.timeout); job.reject(new Error('Drawing recognition could not start. Check your connection and retry.')); }
        pending.clear(); worker.terminate(); worker = null;
      });
    }
    return worker;
  }
  function request(type, image) {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const id = ++nextId;
      try { const target = getWorker(); const timeout = setTimeout(() => { pending.delete(id); reject(new Error('Drawing recognition timed out. Please retry.')); }, 120000); pending.set(id, { resolve, reject, timeout }); target.postMessage({ id, type, image }); }
      catch (error) { const job = pending.get(id); if (job) clearTimeout(job.timeout); pending.delete(id); reject(error); }
    });
  }
  return {
    warmup: () => request('warmup'),
    recognize: image => request('classify', image),
    recognizeSymbol: image => request('symbol', image),
    dispose() {
      worker?.terminate(); worker = null;
      for (const job of pending.values()) { clearTimeout(job.timeout); job.reject(new Error('Recognition closed.')); }
      pending.clear();
    }
  };
}

import { skillCastSettings } from './game-config.js';

let classifier, clipClassifier, RawImage;
/** Load the quantized QuickDraw classifier once, off the gameplay/UI thread. */
async function loadClassifier() {
  if (!classifier) {
    classifier = (async () => {
      const transformers = await import('https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@huggingface/transformers@3.8.1');
      const { pipeline, env } = transformers;
      RawImage = transformers.RawImage;
      env.allowLocalModels = false;
      env.backends.onnx.wasm.numThreads = 1;
      return pipeline('image-classification', skillCastSettings.model, { device: 'wasm', dtype: 'q8' });
    })().catch(error => { classifier = null; throw error; });
  }
  return classifier;
}

/** Load CLIP lazily in the same worker; cache weights between casts. */
async function loadClipClassifier() {
  if (!clipClassifier) {
    clipClassifier = (async () => {
      const { pipeline, env } = await import('https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@huggingface/transformers@3.8.1');
      env.allowLocalModels = false;
      env.backends.onnx.wasm.numThreads = 1;
      return pipeline('zero-shot-image-classification', skillCastSettings.clipModel,
        { device: 'wasm', dtype: 'q8' });
    })().catch(error => { clipClassifier = null; throw error; });
  }
  return clipClassifier;
}

// Explicit alternatives prevent a single candidate from always receiving a perfect score.
const symbolLabels = [
  'a hand drawn circle enclosing an arrow above an X cross',
  'a hand drawn empty circle',
  'a hand drawn circle with only an arrow inside',
  'a hand drawn circle with only an X inside',
  'a hand drawn circle with an X above an arrow',
  'random scribbles and unrelated shapes'
];

/** Receive normalized black-on-white PNGs and return ranked QuickDraw predictions. */
self.addEventListener('message', async ({ data }) => {
  try {
    if (data.type === 'symbol') {
      const pipe = await loadClipClassifier();
      const predictions = await pipe(data.image, symbolLabels);
      self.postMessage({ id: data.id, predictions });
      return;
    }
    const pipe = await loadClassifier();
    if (data.type === 'warmup') { self.postMessage({ id: data.id, ready: true }); return; }
    // QuickDraw expects one channel; RGBA canvas PNGs must be explicitly converted.
    const image = (await RawImage.read(data.image)).grayscale();
    // QuickDraw bitmap training uses light strokes on a dark background.
    for (let i = 0; i < image.data.length; i++) image.data[i] = 255 - image.data[i];
    const predictions = await pipe(image, { top_k: 3 });
    self.postMessage({ id: data.id, predictions });
  } catch (error) {
    self.postMessage({ id: data.id, error: error.message || 'Drawing recognition failed.' });
  }
});

import { endlessEliteSettings, eliteChance, eliteChanceFormula } from './game-config.js';

/** Own one repeatable endless elite buildup, followed by a forced boss wave. */
export function createEndlessBuildup(onBossReady) {
  let seconds = 0;
  let ready = false;
  return {
    get phase() {
      if (ready) return 'ready';
      if (seconds < endlessEliteSettings.rampStartSeconds) return 'normal';
      if (seconds < endlessEliteSettings.rampEndSeconds) return 'ramp';
      return 'elites';
    },
    get seconds() { return seconds; },
    // Admin shortcut starts the constant elite phase immediately.
    startElites() { seconds = endlessEliteSettings.rampEndSeconds; ready = false; },
    get eliteChance() { return ready ? eliteChance : eliteChanceFormula(seconds); },
    spawnRate(normalRate) {
      if (ready || seconds < endlessEliteSettings.rampStartSeconds) return normalRate;
      const progress = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (seconds - endlessEliteSettings.rampStartSeconds) /
        Math.max(1, endlessEliteSettings.rampEndSeconds - endlessEliteSettings.rampStartSeconds)));
      return Math.round(normalRate + (endlessEliteSettings.maxSpawnRate - normalRate) * progress);
    },
    update(delta, { endless, bossAlive, spawning }) {
      if (!endless || bossAlive) { seconds = 0; ready = false; return; }
      if (!spawning || ready || !Number.isFinite(delta)) return;
      seconds += Math.max(0, delta);
      if (seconds >= endlessEliteSettings.rampEndSeconds + endlessEliteSettings.constantEliteSeconds) {
        ready = true; // Restore ordinary arrivals before killing elites or requesting the boss.
        onBossReady();
      }
    }
  };
}

import { createEndlessBuildup } from './endless-buildup.js';
import { endlessEventSettings, eliteChance, midoriSettings } from './game-config.js';

export const endlessEventRegistry = {
  eliteSurge: { name: 'Elite Surge', create: onComplete => createEndlessBuildup(onComplete) },
  midori: { name: 'Midori Invasion' }
};

/** Manage elite surges and their boss-or-Midori outcome; admin triggers bypass campaign timing. */
export function createEndlessEvents(onBossReady, random = Math.random, onMidoriStart = () => {}, onEventEnd = () => {}) {
  let event = null, definition = null, bossWasAlive = false;
  let midoriRemaining = 0, manual = false;
  let eventKey = null, eventSequence = 0;
  function endCurrent() {
    if (eventKey) onEventEnd(eventKey);
    eventKey = null;
  }

  /** Begin a Midori-only stream in place of requesting the boss wave. */
  function startMidori() {
    endCurrent();
    eventKey = `midori-${++eventSequence}`;
    midoriRemaining = midoriSettings.eventSeconds;
    definition = endlessEventRegistry.midori;
    onMidoriStart();
  }
  /** Resolve an elite army before choosing its replacement encounter. */
  function finishElites() {
    endCurrent();
    if (random() < endlessEventSettings.midoriAfterEliteChance) startMidori();
    else onBossReady();
  }
  function chooseEvent() {
    endCurrent();
    midoriRemaining = 0;
    const ids = endlessEventSettings.enabledEvents.filter(id => endlessEventRegistry[id]?.create);
    const id = ids[Math.floor(random() * ids.length)];
    definition = endlessEventRegistry[id] || null;
    event = definition ? definition.create(finishElites) : null;
    eventKey = definition ? `eliteSurge-${++eventSequence}` : null;
  }
  chooseEvent();
  return {
    get name() { return definition?.name || 'None'; },
    get phase() { return midoriRemaining > 0 ? 'midori' : event?.phase || 'normal'; },
    get seconds() { return midoriRemaining > 0 ? midoriSettings.eventSeconds - midoriRemaining : event?.seconds || 0; },
    get active() { return manual || midoriRemaining > 0; },
    get eliteChance() { return midoriRemaining > 0 ? 0 : event?.eliteChance ?? eliteChance; },
    get spawnEventKey() { return midoriRemaining > 0 || ['ramp', 'elites'].includes(event?.phase) ? eventKey : null; },
    get spawnType() { return midoriRemaining > 0 ? 'midori' : null; },
    get allowsBossWave() { return midoriRemaining <= 0 && (!event || event.phase === 'ready'); },
    spawnRate(normalRate) { return midoriRemaining > 0 ? normalRate : event ? event.spawnRate(normalRate) : normalRate; },
    /** Start either event immediately for testing without enabling endless progression. */
    trigger(id) {
      if (!['midori', 'eliteSurge'].includes(id)) return false;
      manual = true;
      if (id === 'midori') startMidori();
      else if (id === 'eliteSurge') {
        endCurrent();
        eventKey = `eliteSurge-${++eventSequence}`;
        midoriRemaining = 0;
        definition = endlessEventRegistry.eliteSurge;
        event = definition.create(finishElites);
        event.startElites();
      } else { manual = false; return false; }
      return true;
    },
    stop() { manual = false; chooseEvent(); },
    end() { manual = false; chooseEvent(); },
    update(delta, state) {
      if (bossWasAlive && !state.bossAlive) { manual = false; chooseEvent(); }
      bossWasAlive = state.bossAlive;
      if (midoriRemaining > 0) {
        if (state.bossAlive) { manual = false; chooseEvent(); return; }
        if (state.spawning && Number.isFinite(delta)) midoriRemaining -= Math.max(0, delta);
        if (midoriRemaining <= 0) { manual = false; chooseEvent(); }
        return;
      }
      event?.update(delta, { ...state, endless: state.endless || manual });
    }
  };
}

import { beginKnockback, advanceKnockback } from './knockback.js';

/** Stun independently of displacement, respecting knockback resistance and absolute immunity. */
export function applySkillControl(enemy, dx, dy, stunSeconds, travelSeconds, options = {}) {
  enemy.stunRemaining = Math.max(enemy.stunRemaining || 0, stunSeconds);
  enemy.skillKnockback = beginKnockback(enemy, dx, dy, travelSeconds, options);
  enemy.contactReaction = null; enemy.attack = null; enemy.moving = false;
}

/** Resolve stun before AI/contact so a stunned enemy cannot move or damage the player. */
export function updateEnemyControl(enemy, delta, move) {
  if(enemy.frozenRemaining>0){
    enemy.frozenRemaining=Math.max(0,enemy.frozenRemaining-delta);
    if(enemy.frozenRemaining<1e-6)enemy.frozenRemaining=0;
    enemy.moving=false;return true; // Freeze also holds knockback and attack timers.
  }
  const stunned = enemy.stunRemaining > 0;
  if(stunned)enemy.stunVisualElapsed=(enemy.stunVisualElapsed||0)+delta;
  else delete enemy.stunVisualElapsed;
  if (!stunned && !enemy.skillKnockback) return false;
  enemy.stunRemaining = Math.max(0, (enemy.stunRemaining || 0) - delta);
  if (enemy.stunRemaining < 1e-6) enemy.stunRemaining = 0;
  const knockback = enemy.skillKnockback;
  if (knockback) {
    if (!advanceKnockback(enemy, knockback, delta, move)) delete enemy.skillKnockback;
  }
  if (stunned) enemy.moving = false;
  return stunned;
}
