import { deathSettings, gachaSettings } from './game-config.js';
export { deathSettings, gachaSettings } from './game-config.js';
// Visual remnants are separate from living NPCs: no AI, collisions, or rewards.
const deaths = new Map();
const gachaEffects = new Map();
let gachaIcon;



/** Load the supplied gacha artwork before the preview begins. */
export function loadEnemyDeathGraphics() {
  gachaIcon = new Image();
  gachaIcon.src = '../sprites/icons/Gacha_Ticket.png';
  return gachaIcon.decode();
}

/** Calculate a fast eased rise, brief stop, then expansion and disappearance. */
export function gachaPose(effect) {
  const rise = Math.min(1, effect.elapsed / gachaSettings.rise);
  const pop = Math.max(0, Math.min(1,
    (effect.elapsed - gachaSettings.rise - gachaSettings.hold) / gachaSettings.pop));
  return { x: effect.x, y: effect.y - effect.height * (1 - (1 - rise) ** 3),
    scale: 0.75 + 0.25 * rise + 0.65 * pop,
    opacity: 1 - pop, behind: rise < 0.55 };
}

/** Freeze the defeated pose and launch it away from the source of the hit. */
export function beginEnemyDeath(enemy, source, { knockback = true } = {}) {
  const dx = source ? enemy.x - source.x : enemy.contactReaction?.nx ?? 1;
  const dy = source ? enemy.y - source.y : enemy.contactReaction?.ny ?? 0;
  const length = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
  const death = { elapsed: 0, originX: enemy.x, originY: enemy.y,
    nx: length ? dx / length : 1, ny: length ? dy / length : 0, opacity: 1, knockback };
  deaths.set(enemy.id, { ...enemy, death, transition: null, moving: false });
  gachaEffects.set(enemy.id, { x: enemy.x, y: enemy.y, elapsed: 0,
    height: (enemy.spriteSize || 112) / 2 + 28 });
}

/** Advance every remnant, including offscreen ones, and remove after the fade. */
export function updateEnemyDeaths(delta) {
  for (const [id, effect] of gachaEffects) {
    effect.elapsed += delta;
    if (effect.elapsed >= gachaSettings.rise + gachaSettings.hold + gachaSettings.pop) gachaEffects.delete(id);
  }
  for (const [id, enemy] of deaths) {
    const death = enemy.death;
    death.elapsed += delta;
    const progress = Math.min(1, death.elapsed / deathSettings.duration);
    const distance = death.knockback === false ? 0 : deathSettings.distance * (1 - (1 - progress) ** 3);
    enemy.x = death.originX + death.nx * distance;
    enemy.y = death.originY + death.ny * distance;
    const fade = Math.max(0, Math.min(1,
      (death.elapsed - deathSettings.fadeStart) / (deathSettings.duration - deathSettings.fadeStart)));
    death.opacity = 1 - fade * fade;
    if (progress === 1) deaths.delete(id);
  }
}

/** Render the rising icon behind bodies first, then above them as it pops. */
export function drawGachaDeaths(context, camera, width, height, behind) {
  if (!gachaIcon?.naturalWidth) return;
  for (const effect of gachaEffects.values()) {
    const pose = gachaPose(effect);
    const x = pose.x - camera.x, y = pose.y - camera.y;
    if (pose.behind !== behind || x < -100 || x > width + 100 || y < -100 || y > height + 100) continue;
    const w = gachaSettings.width * pose.scale;
    const h = w * gachaIcon.naturalHeight / gachaIcon.naturalWidth;
    context.save();
    context.globalAlpha = pose.opacity;
    context.drawImage(gachaIcon, x - w / 2, y - h / 2, w, h);
    context.restore();
  }
}

/** Return visual-only remnants for the same camera culling as normal enemies. */
export function getEnemyDeaths() {
  return [...deaths.values()];
}

/** Visual hop only: collision and world positions stay grounded while Pedrozilla skips. */
export function enemyBounceOffset(character) {
  const bounce=character.movementBounce;
  if (!bounce || !character.moving || character.death) return 0;
  const seconds=character.eventMotionAge ?? (character.elapsed || 0)/1000;
  const period=bounce.periodSeconds*(character.bouncePeriodScale ?? 1);
  const phase=((seconds/period+(character.bouncePhase ?? 0))%1+1)%1;
  return -bounce.height*Math.sin(Math.PI*phase)**2;
}

--- SNAPSHOT FILE: public/Development/enemy-spatial-index.js | sha256=9f8bb912630cea22cc737e463222980d821a8c337069f167efdd6b80d0d098c3 | encoding=utf-8-sig ---
/** Conservative broadphase only; callers retain their existing exact collision tests. */
export function createEnemySpatialIndex(enemies, getBounds, cellSize=128) {
  const cells=new Map();
  enemies.forEach((enemy,order)=>{
    const b=getBounds(enemy),entry={enemy,order};
    for(let y=Math.floor((b.y-b.ry)/cellSize);y<=Math.floor((b.y+b.ry)/cellSize);y++)
      for(let x=Math.floor((b.x-b.rx)/cellSize);x<=Math.floor((b.x+b.rx)/cellSize);x++) {
        const key=x+','+y;
        let bucket=cells.get(key);if(!bucket)cells.set(key,bucket=[]);
        bucket.push(entry);
      }
  });
  return {querySegment(from,to,padding=0) {
    const found=new Set();
    for(let y=Math.floor((Math.min(from.y,to.y)-padding)/cellSize);y<=Math.floor((Math.max(from.y,to.y)+padding)/cellSize);y++)
      for(let x=Math.floor((Math.min(from.x,to.x)-padding)/cellSize);x<=Math.floor((Math.max(from.x,to.x)+padding)/cellSize);x++)
        for(const entry of cells.get(x+','+y)||[])found.add(entry);
    // Preserve Map insertion order: piercing limits and random damage rolls depend on it.
    return [...found].sort((a,b)=>a.order-b.order).map(entry=>entry.enemy);
  }};
}

import { basicMobHpFormula, eliteChanceFormula } from './game-config.js';

/** Roll basic-enemy elites; bosses and playable-character test NPCs are excluded. */
export function enemyVariant(type, template, mode = 'random', random = Math.random, survivalSeconds = 0, endlessSeconds = null, eliteProbability = eliteChanceFormula(endlessSeconds)) {
  const elite = template.miniBoss === true || type === 'midori' || (type === 'mob' || template.standard) && (mode === 'elite' || (mode === 'random' && random() < eliteProbability));
  const baseHp = (['mob', 'midori'].includes(type) || template.standard) ? basicMobHpFormula(survivalSeconds)
    : type === 'shiroko' ? shirokoBossStats.hp : combatBalance.otherEnemyHp;
  const megaType = type === 'megaMob' || (type === 'mob' && elite) ? 'megaMob' :
    type === 'megaSweeper' || (['whiteSweeper','heavySweeper'].includes(type) && elite) ? 'megaSweeper' : null;
  const dedicatedMega = Boolean(megaType);
  const profile = enemyTypeStats[megaType || type];
  const scaled = profile ? enemyStatsScalingFormula(profile, campaignScalingTimeFormula(endlessSeconds)) : null;
  const maxHp = (scaled?.hp ?? baseHp) * (elite && !dedicatedMega ? combatBalance.eliteHpMultiplier : 1);
  return {
    elite,
    miniBoss: template.miniBoss === true || (elite && type !== 'midori'),
    label: dedicatedMega ? (megaType === 'megaSweeper' ? 'Mega Sweeper' : 'Mega Mob') : elite && type !== 'midori' ? `Mega ${template.label}` : template.label,
    spriteSize: (template.spriteSize || normalSpriteSize) * (elite && type !== 'midori' && !template.miniBoss ? (template.megaSizeMultiplier ?? eliteSizeMultiplier) : 1),
    hp: maxHp,
    maxHp,
    contactDamage: type === 'shiroko' ? shirokoBossStats.contactDamage : template.contactDamage,
    contactDamageMultiplier: elite && !dedicatedMega ? 2 : 1,
    ...(profile ? { hp: Math.round(maxHp), maxHp: Math.round(maxHp), perTypeStats: true,
      contactDamage: scaled.atk, expReward: profile.expValue,
      movementSpeedMultiplier: scaled.spd * playerSettings.speed / playerSettings.movementBase } : {})
  };
}

/** Pick from the configured standard enemy pool while keeping Mob most common. */
export function chooseStandardEnemy(random = Math.random, elapsedSeconds = 0, stageId = null) {
  const weights = stageId && enemyStagePools[stageId] ? Object.fromEntries(enemyStagePools[stageId].map(type=>[type,1])) : standardEnemyWeights;
  const entries = Object.entries(weights).filter(([type, weight]) => {
    const profile = enemyTypeStats[type];
    return weight > 0 && (!profile || (elapsedSeconds >= profile.spawnStartSeconds && elapsedSeconds < profile.spawnEndSeconds));
  });
  let roll = random() * entries.reduce((sum, [, weight]) => sum + weight, 0);
  for (const [type, weight] of entries) { roll -= weight; if (roll < 0) return type; }
  return entries.at(-1)?.[0] ?? null;
}

/** Find walkable ground near the intended landing, even if an enemy died inside an obstacle. */
export function safeDropLanding(x, y) {
  if (isLandingClear(x, y, lootLandingRadius)) return { x, y };
  for (let radius = 24; radius <= 2048; radius += 24) {
    const samples = Math.min(64, Math.ceil(radius / 12) * 8);
    for (let index = 0; index < samples; index++) {
      const angle = index / samples * Math.PI * 2;
      const px = x + Math.cos(angle) * radius, py = y + Math.sin(angle) * radius;
      if (isLandingClear(px, py, lootLandingRadius)) return { x: px, y: py };
    }
  }
  return null;
}

/** Redirect a scatter to safe ground; retain unplaceable loot for a later retry. */
export function constrainDropLanding(drop) {
  const flight = drop.scatter;
  const landing = safeDropLanding(flight.x + flight.dx, flight.y + flight.dy);
  drop.pendingLanding = !landing;
  if (landing) {
    flight.dx = landing.x - flight.x;
    flight.dy = landing.y - flight.y;
  }
}

/** Launch loot toward a random nearby landing spot with a small airborne hop. */
export function launchDrop(drop, random = Math.random) {
  const angle = random() * Math.PI * 2;
  const distance = dropScatter.minDistance + random() * (dropScatter.maxDistance - dropScatter.minDistance);
  drop.scatter = { elapsed: 0, x: drop.x, y: drop.y,
    dx: Math.cos(angle) * distance, dy: Math.sin(angle) * distance,
    rotation: drop.rotation, spin: (random() - 0.5) * Math.PI };
  constrainDropLanding(drop);
  return drop;
}

/** Animate the outward toss before enabling pickup attraction or collection. */
export function updateDropScatter(drop, delta) {
  if (!drop.scatter) return false;
  if (drop.pendingLanding) {
    drop.landingRetry = (drop.landingRetry || 0) - delta;
    if (drop.landingRetry <= 0) { constrainDropLanding(drop); drop.landingRetry = 0.5; }
    if (drop.pendingLanding) return true;
  }
  const flight = drop.scatter;
  flight.elapsed += Math.max(0, delta);
  const t = Math.min(1, flight.elapsed / dropScatter.duration);
  const progress = 1 - (1 - t) ** 2;
  drop.x = flight.x + flight.dx * progress;
  drop.y = flight.y + flight.dy * progress;
  drop.lift = 4 * dropScatter.hopHeight * t * (1 - t);
  drop.rotation = flight.rotation + flight.spin * progress;
  if (t === 1) { delete drop.scatter; drop.lift = 0; }
  return true;
}

let lootSaveChanged=()=>{};
export function configureLootPersistence({initial,onChange=()=>{}}={}){if(initial){lootTotals.credits=Math.max(0,Math.trunc(initial.credits||0));lootTotals.secretTechNotes=Math.max(0,Math.trunc(initial.secretTechNotes||0));}lootSaveChanged=onChange;}
function persistLoot(){lootSaveChanged({...lootTotals});}
/** Read a snapshot of collected session inventory, including spendable awakening notes. */
export function getLootTotals() {
  return { ...lootTotals };
}

/** Award File Credits once when its opening completes. */
export function gainCredits(amount) {
  if(!Number.isFinite(amount)||amount<0)return false;
  lootTotals.credits+=Math.floor(amount);persistLoot();return true;
}

/** Spend run Credits atomically; rejected purchases never modify the balance. */
export function spendCredits(amount) {
  if(!Number.isInteger(amount)||amount<0||lootTotals.credits<amount)return false;
  lootTotals.credits-=amount;persistLoot();return true;
}

/** Spend collected notes atomically; failed awakenings never consume currency. */
export function spendSecretTechNotes(amount) {
  if (!Number.isInteger(amount) || amount <= 0 || lootTotals.secretTechNotes < amount) return false;
  lootTotals.secretTechNotes -= amount;persistLoot();
  return true;
}

/** Inspect all ground loot, including credits and Secret Tech Notes. */
export function getGroundLoot() {
  return [...drops.values()];
}

/** Discard uncollected loot on a map change; collected inventory remains intact. */
export function clearGroundLoot() {
  drops.clear();
}

/** Spawn a specific ground pickup for repeatable admin testing. */
export function spawnTestDrop(kind, value, x, y) {
  if (!['exp', 'credits', 'secretTechNotes'].includes(kind)) return;
  if (!Number.isFinite(value) || value < 1) return;
  const drop = { id: ++nextId, kind, value: Math.floor(value),
    tier: reportTier(value), x, y, rotation: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2 };
  drops.set(drop.id, drop);
  launchDrop(drop);
  return drop;
}

/** Apply one pickup's reward without coupling inventory to the controlled avatar. */
function collectDrop(drop, player) {
  drops.delete(drop.id);
  if (drop.kind === 'exp') addPlayerExp(player, drop.value);
  else {lootTotals[drop.kind] += drop.value;persistLoot();}
}

/** Cast Net collects only reports and Credits, leaving notes and other pickups intact. */
export function collectSupportLoot(player){for(const drop of [...drops.values()])if(drop.kind==='exp'||drop.kind==='credits')collectDrop(drop,player);}

/** Burst Yuuka credits throughout a disk, with angular coverage in every direction. */
export function dropYuukaCredits(enemy, defeated = false, random = Math.random) {
  const count = defeated ? yuukaSettings.deathCredits : yuukaSettings.hitCredits;
  const radius = bossExpRewards.maxDistance * yuukaSettings.burstRadiusMultiplier;
  const angleOffset = random() * Math.PI * 2;
  const rewards = [];
  for (let index = 0; index < count; index++) {
    const drop = { id: ++nextId, kind: 'credits', value: 1, x: enemy.x,
      y: enemy.y + (enemy.spriteSize || normalSpriteSize) / 2 - spriteDisplayPadding,
      rotation: random() * Math.PI * 2 };
    drops.set(drop.id, drop);
    launchDrop(drop, random);
    if (defeated) {
      const angle = angleOffset + (index + random()) / count * Math.PI * 2;
      // Square root distributes credits by area, throughout the whole radius.
      const distance = Math.sqrt(random()) * radius;
      drop.scatter.dx = Math.cos(angle) * distance;
      drop.scatter.dy = Math.sin(angle) * distance;
      constrainDropLanding(drop);
    }
    rewards.push(drop);
  }
  return rewards;
}

/** Roll independent bonus drops, allowing both rewards on the same defeat. */
export function dropEnemyLoot(enemy, random = Math.random) {
  if (['yuuka','sensei'].includes(enemy.type)) return dropYuukaCredits(enemy, true, random);
  const credits = random() < (enemy.elite ? eliteLoot.creditChance : creditDropChance);
  const note = random() < (enemy.elite ? eliteLoot.noteChance : secretNoteDropChance);
  for (const [kind, awarded] of [['credits', credits], ['secretTechNotes', note]]) {
    if (!awarded) continue;
    const drop = {
      id: ++nextId, kind, value: kind === 'credits' && enemy.elite ? eliteLoot.creditAmount : 1,
      x: enemy.x,
      y: enemy.y + (enemy.spriteSize || normalSpriteSize) / 2 - spriteDisplayPadding,
      rotation: random() * Math.PI * 2
    };
    drops.set(drop.id, drop);
    launchDrop(drop, random);
  }
}

/** Select artwork by EXP value; the highest supplied file is named Report 3. */
export function reportTier(value) {
  return value > reportSettings.thirdMax ? 3 : value >= reportSettings.thirdMin ? 2 : value >= reportSettings.secondMin ? 1 : 0;
}

/** Roll a report's EXP value: elites get Report 1 (80%) or Report 2 (20%). */
export function rollEnemyExp(random = Math.random, elite = false) {
  if (elite) {
    return random() < reportSettings.eliteSecondChance
      ? reportSettings.secondMin + Math.floor(random() * (reportSettings.secondMax - reportSettings.secondMin + 1))
      : reportSettings.thirdMin + Math.floor(random() * (reportSettings.thirdMax - reportSettings.thirdMin + 1));
  }
  const uncommon = random() >= reportSettings.commonChance;
  return uncommon ? reportSettings.secondMin + Math.floor(random() * (reportSettings.secondMax - reportSettings.secondMin + 1))
    : reportSettings.firstMin + Math.floor(random() * (reportSettings.firstMax - reportSettings.firstMin + 1));
}

/** Expose ground records for inspection without deleting off-screen reports. */
export function getExpDrops() {
  return [...drops.values()].filter(drop => drop.kind === 'exp');
}



/** Scale elite rewards down, cap their combined EXP, and preserve positive report pickups. */
export function rollEliteReports(random = Math.random, override, player = getActivePlayer()) {
  const values = Array.from({ length: eliteExpRewards.count }, () =>
    Math.max(reportSettings.secondMin, Math.floor(override ?? rollEnemyExp(random, true))));
  let deficit = eliteExpRewards.minimumTotal - values.reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0);
  const indices = values.map((_, index) => index).sort((a, b) => values[b] - values[a]);
  for (const index of indices) {
    if (deficit <= 0) break;
    const extra = Math.min(deficit, Math.max(0, reportSettings.thirdMax - values[index]));
    values[index] += extra;
    deficit -= extra;
  }
  const rolledTotal = values.reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0);
  const total = eliteExpTotalFormula(rolledTotal, player?.level || 1);
  const count = Math.min(values.length, total);
  if (!count) return [];
  // Give every report one point, then share the remainder by its original roll weight.
  const weights = values.slice(0, count);
  const weightTotal = weights.reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0);
  const rewards = weights.map(weight => 1 + Math.floor((total - count) * weight / weightTotal));
  let remaining = total - rewards.reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0);
  for (let index = 0; remaining > 0; index = (index + 1) % count, remaining--) rewards[index]++;
  return rewards;
}

// Boss reward settings live in game-config.js.


/** Split a level-scaled boss reward into positive reports without losing EXP. */
export function rollBossReports(player, random = Math.random, fixedTotal) {
  if (Number.isFinite(fixedTotal) && fixedTotal > 0) {
    const total = Math.round(fixedTotal);
    const count = Math.min(total, Math.max(bossExpRewards.minimumReports, Math.ceil(total/reportSettings.thirdMax)));
    return Array.from({length:count}, (_,i)=>Math.floor(total/count)+(i<total%count?1:0));
  }
  const requirement = experienceForLevel(player?.level || 1);
  const minimum = Math.max(bossExpRewards.minimumReports,
    Math.ceil(requirement * bossExpRewards.minLevels));
  const maximum = Math.max(minimum, Math.floor(requirement * bossExpRewards.maxLevels));
  const total = minimum + Math.floor(random() * (maximum - minimum + 1));
  const count = Math.max(bossExpRewards.minimumReports, Math.ceil(total / reportSettings.thirdMax));
  const base = Math.floor(total / count), remainder = total % count;
  return Array.from({ length: count }, (_, index) => base + (index < remainder ? 1 : 0));
}

/** Divide player level by (2 + report tier), add 3, then round halves upward. */
export function standardMobExp(player, tier = 0) {
  return mobExpFormula(player?.level || 1, tier);
}

/** Drop a full-circle boss burst, five elite reports, or one ordinary report. */
export function dropEnemyExp(enemy, random = Math.random) {
  const reports = [];
  if(!enemyExpDropsEnabled)return reports;
  if (['yuuka','sensei'].includes(enemy.type)) return reports;
  const boss = enemy.boss === true || (enemy.boss !== false && ['iroha', 'shiroko'].includes(enemy.type));
  // Roll artwork first so its tier bonus does not depend on the resulting EXP.
  const standardMob = (enemy.type === 'mob' || enemy.standard) && !boss && !enemy.elite && enemy.expReward == null;
  const mobTier = standardMob ? (random() < reportSettings.commonChance ? 0 : 1) : undefined;
  const values = boss ? rollBossReports(getActivePlayer(), random, enemy.expReward) : (enemy.elite && !enemy.miniBoss) || enemy.type === 'yuuka' ? rollEliteReports(random, enemy.expReward)
    : [Math.floor(enemy.expReward ?? ((enemy.type === 'mob' || enemy.standard)
      ? standardMobExp(getActivePlayer(), mobTier) : rollEnemyExp(random)))];
  const burstAngle = boss ? random() * Math.PI * 2 : 0;
  for (const [index, value] of values.entries()) {
    const drop = dropExpReport(enemy, random, value, mobTier);
    if (!drop) continue;
    if (boss) {
      // One report per angular sector guarantees coverage in every direction.
      const angle = burstAngle + (index + random() * 0.5) / values.length * Math.PI * 2;
      const distance = bossExpRewards.minDistance + random() *
        (bossExpRewards.maxDistance - bossExpRewards.minDistance);
      drop.scatter.dx = Math.cos(angle) * distance;
      drop.scatter.dy = Math.sin(angle) * distance;
      constrainDropLanding(drop);
    }
    reports.push(drop);
  }
  return reports;
}

/** Create one scattered report; explicit admin EXP overrides remain supported. */
function dropExpReport(enemy, random, value, tier = reportTier(value)) {
  if (!Number.isFinite(value) || value <= 0) return;
  const drop = {
    id: ++nextId, kind: 'exp', value, tier, x: enemy.x,
    y: enemy.y + (enemy.spriteSize || normalSpriteSize) / 2 - spriteDisplayPadding,
    rotation: random() * Math.PI * 2
  };
  drops.set(drop.id, drop);
  launchDrop(drop, random);
  return drop;
}

/** Load report graphics once and provide collection/rendering for the preview. */
export function createExpPickups(getPlayer, options = {}) {
  isLandingClear = options.isLandingClear || (() => true);
  getActivePlayer = getPlayer; // Resolve the controlled avatar at the moment a boss dies.
  const lootStatus = document.querySelector('#player-loot-status');
  const tools = document.querySelector('#loot-tools');
  if (tools) {
    tools.querySelectorAll('[data-loot-action]').forEach(button => {
      button.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const player = getPlayer();
        const action = button.dataset.lootAction;
        if (action === 'clear') drops.clear();
        else if (action === 'collect') {
          for (const drop of drops.values()) collectDrop(drop, player);
        } else if (action === 'reset') {
          lootTotals.credits = 0;
          lootTotals.secretTechNotes = 0;persistLoot();
        } else {
          const amount = Number(tools.querySelector('[name="loot-value"]').value);
          spawnTestDrop(action, Math.min(1000000, amount), player.x + 80,
            player.y + (player.spriteSize || normalSpriteSize) / 2 - spriteDisplayPadding);
        }
      });
    });
  }
  const icons = Array.from({ length: 4 }, (_, tier) => {
    const image = new Image();
    image.src = `../sprites/icons/Exp_Report_${tier}.png`;
    return image;
  });
  const ready = Promise.all(icons.map(image => image.decode()));
  const creditIcon = new Image();
  creditIcon.src = '../sprites/icons/credits.png';
  const creditReady = creditIcon.decode();
  const noteIcon = new Image();
  noteIcon.src = '../sprites/icons/Ultimate_Skill_Book.png';
  const noteReady = noteIcon.decode();

  /** Sweep direct pickups, then accelerate attracted loot toward the active avatar. */
  function update(player, previous, delta = 0) {
    const footOffset = (player.spriteSize || normalSpriteSize) / 2 - spriteDisplayPadding;
    const start = { x: previous.x, y: previous.y + footOffset };
    const end = { x: player.x, y: player.y + footOffset };
    const dx = end.x - start.x, dy = end.y - start.y;
    const lengthSquared = dx * dx + dy * dy;
    for (const drop of drops.values()) {
      // Let the toss finish so contact kills cannot instantly swallow the drops.
      if (updateDropScatter(drop, delta)) continue;
      const fraction = lengthSquared ? Math.max(0, Math.min(1,
        ((drop.x - start.x) * dx + (drop.y - start.y) * dy) / lengthSquared)) : 0;
      const sweptDistance = Math.hypot(drop.x - start.x - dx * fraction, drop.y - start.y - dy * fraction);
      if (drop.pickupTarget !== player) {
        drop.attracted = false;
        drop.walkOverPickup = false;
        drop.pickupSpeed = 0;
        drop.pickupTarget = player;
      }
      // Walking over loot begins the same center-bound flight as a magnet pickup.
      // Arona can finish these pickups without gaining any attraction radius.
      if (sweptDistance <= pickupRadius) drop.walkOverPickup = true;
      const range = pickupRangeFormula(ensureCombatStats(player).pickupPercent+racerPassBonuses(player).pickup, player.pickupRange ?? 40);
      if (!range && !drop.walkOverPickup) {
        // Swapping to an avatar without attraction stops pending magnets immediately.
        drop.attracted = false;
        drop.pickupSpeed = 0;
        continue;
      }
      // Magnet detection follows the sprite center; walk-over detection stays at feet.
      const centerFraction = lengthSquared ? Math.max(0, Math.min(1,
        ((drop.x - previous.x) * dx + (drop.y - previous.y) * dy) / lengthSquared)) : 0;
      const centerDistance = Math.hypot(drop.x - previous.x - dx * centerFraction,
        drop.y - previous.y - dy * centerFraction);
      if (drop.walkOverPickup || centerDistance <= range) drop.attracted = true;
      if (drop.attracted) {
        const targetX = player.x - drop.x, targetY = player.y - drop.y;
        const distance = Math.hypot(targetX, targetY);
        const time = Math.max(0, delta);
        const speed = drop.pickupSpeed || 0;
        drop.pickupSpeed = Math.min(pickupMagnet.maxSpeed, speed + pickupMagnet.acceleration * time);
        const travel = Math.min(distance, (speed + drop.pickupSpeed) / 2 * time);
        if (distance > 0) {
          drop.x += targetX / distance * travel;
          drop.y += targetY / distance * travel;
        }
        // Rendered beneath actors: disappear only on arrival at the actual center.
        if (distance - travel <= 0.5) collectDrop(drop, player);
      }
    }
    if (lootStatus) lootStatus.textContent = `Credits: ${lootTotals.credits} | Secret Tech Notes: ${lootTotals.secretTechNotes} | Ground drops: ${drops.size}`;
  }

  /** Draw only visible reports beneath actors, keeping their orientation fixed. */
  function draw(context, camera, width, height) {
    for (const drop of drops.values()) {
      if (drop.pendingLanding) continue;
      const x = drop.x - camera.x, y = drop.y - camera.y - (drop.lift || 0);
      if (x < -iconWidth || y < -iconWidth || x > width + iconWidth || y > height + iconWidth) continue;
      const icon = drop.kind === 'exp' ? icons[drop.tier]
        : drop.kind === 'credits' ? creditIcon : noteIcon;
      const sourceWidth = icon.naturalWidth;
      const sourceHeight = icon.naturalHeight;
      if (!sourceWidth) continue;
      const iconHeight = iconWidth * sourceHeight / sourceWidth;
      context.save();
      context.translate(x, y);
      context.rotate(drop.rotation);
      context.drawImage(icon, -iconWidth / 2, -iconHeight / 2, iconWidth, iconHeight);
      context.restore();
    }
  }
  return { ready: Promise.all([ready, creditReady, noteReady]), update, draw, clear: clearGroundLoot };
}

--- SNAPSHOT FILE: public/Development/firing-rings.js | sha256=78488905f070ca9e451b0454beec2a816fb50e7740e508f271ffd488e8135b0a | encoding=utf-8-sig ---
/** Common growth keeps the outer rings strictly larger despite their staggered appearances. */
export function firingRingPoses(elapsed,size) {
  const growth=1+Math.min(1,Math.max(0,elapsed)/.5)*1.5;
  return Array.from({length:3},(_,i)=>{
    const age=elapsed-i*.045,t=age/.42;
    return {visible:age>=0&&t<1,x:i*22+Math.max(0,elapsed)*55,
      radius:size*(.65+i*.5)*growth,opacity:Math.max(0,1-t)**2*.75};
  });
}

/** Soft double-stroked muzzle shock rings; local impact only, no screen flash. */
export function drawFiringRings(context,x,y,angle,elapsed,size,blue=false) {
  const rings=firingRingPoses(elapsed,size);if(!rings.some(r=>r.visible))return;
  context.save();context.translate(x,y);context.rotate(angle);context.globalCompositeOperation='lighter';context.shadowBlur=0;
  for(const ring of rings) {
    if(!ring.visible)continue;context.globalAlpha=ring.opacity;context.beginPath();
    for(let point=0;point<=32;point++) {
      const a=point/32*Math.PI*2,px=ring.x+Math.cos(a)*ring.radius*.3,py=Math.sin(a)*ring.radius;
      if(point===0)context.moveTo(px,py);else context.lineTo(px,py);
    }
    context.strokeStyle=blue?'rgba(75,190,255,.4)':'rgba(255,100,220,.4)';context.lineWidth=6;context.stroke();
    context.strokeStyle=blue?'#e5fcff':'#ffe9fc';context.lineWidth=1.6;context.stroke();
  }
  context.restore();
}

import {getEnemyHurtbox} from './combat-hitboxes.js';
export const frozenSettings={duration:3,opacity:.55,coverageScale:1.65,source:'../sprites/icons/effects/frozen.png'};
let ice;
export const frozenReady=typeof Image==='undefined'?Promise.resolve():new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{ice=new Image();ice.onload=resolve;ice.onerror=reject;ice.src=frozenSettings.source;});
export function applyFrozen(enemy,seconds=frozenSettings.duration){
  if(!(seconds>0)||enemy.hp===0)return false;
  enemy.frozenRemaining=Math.max(enemy.frozenRemaining||0,seconds);enemy.moving=false;return true;
}
export function freezeVisibleEnemies(enemies,camera,width,height){
  let count=0;for(const enemy of enemies){const body=getEnemyHurtbox(enemy);
    if(body.x+body.rx<camera.x||body.x-body.rx>camera.x+width||body.y+body.ry<camera.y||body.y-body.ry>camera.y+height)continue;
    if(applyFrozen(enemy))count++;
  }return count;
}
export function drawFrozenStatus(context,camera,enemy){
  if(!(enemy.frozenRemaining>0)||enemy.hp===0||!ice?.naturalWidth)return;
  const body=getEnemyHurtbox(enemy),size=enemy.spriteSize||Math.max(body.rx,body.ry)*2,
    height=size*frozenSettings.coverageScale,
    width=Math.max(size*frozenSettings.coverageScale,height*ice.naturalWidth/ice.naturalHeight);
  context.save();context.globalAlpha=frozenSettings.opacity;
  context.drawImage(ice,enemy.x-camera.x-width/2,enemy.y-camera.y-height/2,width,height);context.restore();
}

/** Visual pursuit continues at normal speed during freeze, stun or flattening. */
export function animateFrozenEnemy(enemy,player,delta){
  const dx=player.x-enemy.x,dy=player.y-enemy.y;
  const directions=['up','upRight','right','downRight','down','downLeft','left','upLeft'];
  if(dx||dy)enemy.direction=directions[(Math.round(Math.atan2(dx,-dy)/(Math.PI/4))+8)%8];
  if(dx)enemy.facing=dx>0?'right':'left';
  enemy.moving=true;enemy.elapsed=(enemy.elapsed||0)+delta*1000;
  if(enemy.transition)enemy.transition.elapsed=(enemy.transition.elapsed||0)+delta*1000;
  if(enemy.attack){
    const duration=(enemy.layout?.columnEdges.length-1)*(enemy.attacks?.[enemy.attack.name]?.frameDuration||0);
    const elapsed=(enemy.attack.elapsed||0)+delta*1000;
    enemy.attack.elapsed=duration>0?elapsed%duration:elapsed;
  }
  if(enemy.bossAction?.clip)enemy.frozenPoseElapsed=(enemy.frozenPoseElapsed??(enemy.bossAction.elapsed||0)*1000)+delta*1000;
}

--- SNAPSHOT FILE: public/Development/fullscreen-preview.js | sha256=d632d9025a7ac2e56a98f4f31c1c8556a20d27c92120c8ab9944bd544790f36f | encoding=utf-8-sig ---
/** Center the reference 1280x720 game area in a dark surround, preserving the session. */
export function setupFullscreenPreview(canvas, releaseControls, {onSimulate=()=>{}}={}) {
  const enter = document.querySelector('#enter-fullscreen-preview');
  const exit = document.querySelector('#exit-fullscreen-preview');
  const layout = document.querySelector('.playtest-layout');
  const main = document.querySelector('#development-content');
  const sidebar = document.querySelector('.playtest-sidebar');
  let active = false;
  let previousInert = [];

  /** Resize via CSS/ResizeObserver; never scale actors or reset world positions. */
  function setFullscreen(enabled) {
    if (active === enabled) return;
    active = enabled;
    releaseControls();
    document.body.classList.toggle('fullscreen-preview', active);
    enter.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(active));
    exit.hidden = !active;
    if (active) {
      // Background admin controls should not receive hidden keyboard focus.
      const controls = [...main.children].filter(element => element !== layout).concat(sidebar);
      previousInert = controls.map(element => [element, element.inert]);
      for (const [element] of previousInert) element.inert = true;
      canvas.focus({ preventScroll: true });
    } else {
      for (const [element, inert] of previousInert) element.inert = inert;
      previousInert = [];
      enter.focus({ preventScroll: true });
    }
  }

  enter.addEventListener('click', () => setFullscreen(true));
  exit.addEventListener('click', () => setFullscreen(false));
  document.querySelector('#simulate-game')?.addEventListener('click', () => {setFullscreen(true);onSimulate();});
}

import { createSportsDrink, sportsDrinkDescription, createMalkuthHat, createRacerPass, createSafetyHelmet, createLifeJacket, createOverheatedOverclocking, overclockingDescription, isContentUnlocked, lifeJacketDescription, safetyHelmetDescription, racerPassDescription, malkuthDescription, isItemUnlocked, isItemRewardEnabled } from './item-catalog.js';
import { rollLevelUpgrades } from './level-upgrades.js';
import { recordWeaponMax } from './weapon-max-order.js';

// Super rewards respect item unlocks; unavailable pools fall back to normal Files.
export const superFileItems=[createMalkuthHat(true),createRacerPass(true),createSafetyHelmet(true),createLifeJacket(true),createOverheatedOverclocking(true),createSportsDrink(true)];
export const fileSettings={superChance:.05,tripleChance:.09,newChance:.1,weaponChance:.7,
  dropChance:0,bossGuaranteed:true,icon:'../sprites/icons/3 Stars Character Icon.png',maxGround:20,
  creditReplacementPerMax:.05,creditReplacementCap:.6};

/** Inclusive integer rolls and the supplied nested-floor Credits formula. */
export function fileCredits(type,random=Math.random,moneyUpBonus=0,stageMultiplier=1) {
  const [a,b]=type==='super'?[399,5]:type==='triple'?[399,3]:[301,1];
  const integer=max=>Math.min(max,Math.floor(random()*(max+1)));
  const multiplier=(1+moneyUpBonus/100)*stageMultiplier;
  return Math.floor(Math.floor(a/(3+integer(2)))*multiplier*(1+b*(20+integer(10))/100*multiplier));
}

/** Apply one accepted product without spending level-up choices; dropping never applies it. */
export function acceptFileProduct(player,product) {
  if(product.weapon?.isCharacterSkill)return false;
  const slots=product.kind==='item'?(player.equipmentSlots??=[]):(player.attackSlots??=[]);
  const owned=slots.find(item=>item?.id===product.weapon.id);
  if(owned) {
    if(product.kind==='item'&&product.weapon.isSuper&&!owned.isSuper&&!owned.awakened){Object.assign(owned,{...product.weapon});return true;}
    if(owned.isSynergy)return false;
    const max=owned.maxLevel||7;if((owned.level||1)>=max)return false;
    owned.level=(owned.level||1)+1;if(product.kind!=='item')recordWeaponMax(player,owned);return true;
  }
  const index=slots.findIndex(item=>!item);
  if(index<0&&slots.filter(Boolean).length>=6)return false;
  const item={...product.weapon};if(index>=0)slots[index]=item;else slots.push(item);return true;
}

/** Generate products using a shadow inventory so triple rewards cannot overfill or overlevel it. */
export function rollFileRewards(player,{random=Math.random,forceType,getOptions=rollLevelUpgrades,superItems=superFileItems}={}) {
  const roll=random();let type=forceType||(roll<fileSettings.superChance?'super':roll<fileSettings.superChance+fileSettings.tripleChance?'triple':'normal');
  const supers=superItems.filter(item=>{
    if(!isItemRewardEnabled(player,item.id))return false;
    const owned=player.equipmentSlots?.find(owned=>owned?.id===item.id);
    if(item.id==='malkuth-hat'&&!isItemUnlocked(item.id)&&!owned)return false;
    if(item.defaultUnlocked===false&&!isContentUnlocked(item.id)&&!owned)return false;
    return owned?!owned.isSuper&&!owned.awakened:(player.equipmentSlots||[]).filter(Boolean).length<6;
  });
  if(type==='super'&&!supers.length)type='normal';
  const result={type,products:[],credits:fileCredits(type,random,player.moneyUpBonus||0,player.stageCoinMultiplier??1)};
  if(type==='super') {
    const item=supers[Math.min(supers.length-1,Math.floor(random()*supers.length))];
    const description=item.id==='sports-drink'?sportsDrinkDescription(item):item.id==='overheated-overclocking'?overclockingDescription(item):item.id==='life-jacket'?lifeJacketDescription(item):item.id==='safety-helmet'?safetyHelmetDescription(item):item.id==='racer-pass'?racerPassDescription(item):item.id==='malkuth-hat'?malkuthDescription(item):undefined;
    result.products.push({kind:'item',weapon:{...item,level:1},name:item.name,super:true,description});return result;
  }
  const shadow={...player,attackSlots:(player.attackSlots||[]).map(w=>w?{...w}:null),equipmentSlots:(player.equipmentSlots||[]).map(w=>w?{...w}:null)};
  const free={weapon:6-shadow.attackSlots.filter(Boolean).length,item:6-shadow.equipmentSlots.filter(Boolean).length};
  for(let index=0;index<(type==='triple'?3:1);index++) {
    const maxed=[...shadow.attackSlots,...shadow.equipmentSlots].filter(w=>w&&(w.isSynergy||(w.level||1)>=(w.maxLevel||7))).length;
    // Editable saturation behavior: each MAX slot adds 5 percentage points toward the 100-Credit substitution.
    if(random()<Math.min(fileSettings.creditReplacementCap,maxed*fileSettings.creditReplacementPerMax)){result.credits+=100;continue;}
    const options=getOptions(shadow,{all:true}).filter(choice=>choice.weapon&&!choice.weapon.isSynergy&&!choice.weapon.isCharacterSkill);
    let selected=null;
    const allowNew=random()<fileSettings.newChance;
    for(let attempt=0;attempt<5&&!selected;attempt++) {
      let kind=random()<fileSettings.weaponChance?'weapon':'item';
      const pool=k=>options.filter(option=>{
        const category=/item|equipment/i.test(option.category||'')?'item':'weapon';
        const owned=(k==='item'?shadow.equipmentSlots:shadow.attackSlots).some(w=>w?.id===option.weapon.id);
        return category===k&&(owned||(allowNew&&free[k]>index));
      });
      let candidates=pool(kind);if(!candidates.length&&kind==='weapon'){kind='item';candidates=pool(kind);}
      if(candidates.length){
        const weights=candidates.map(c=>Math.max(0,Number(c.weapon?.weight??1)||0)),total=weights.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0);let roll=random()*total,pick=candidates.length-1;
        for(let i=0;i<candidates.length;i++){roll-=weights[i];if(roll<0){pick=i;break;}}
        selected={...candidates[pick],kind};
      }
    }
    if(selected&&acceptFileProduct(shadow,selected))result.products.push(selected);else result.credits+=100;
  }
  return result;
}

/** Keep normal odds until 5 endless minutes, then linearly reach all elites at 10. */
export function eliteChanceFormula(endlessSeconds = null) {
  if (endlessSeconds === null) return eliteChance;
  const s = endlessEliteSettings;
  const progress = Math.max(0, Math.min(1,
    (endlessSeconds - s.rampStartSeconds) / Math.max(1, s.rampEndSeconds - s.rampStartSeconds)));
  return Math.max(0, Math.min(1, eliteChance + (s.targetChance - eliteChance) * progress));
}

// Timer text size and gap in pixels below the top EXP bar.
export const survivalTimerSettings = { fontScale: 1.25, offsetBelowExp: 8 };

/** Basic Mob HP: 60 + (350-60) * (survivalSeconds/900)^1, rounded. */
export function basicMobHpFormula(seconds) {
  const progress = Math.max(0, seconds) / mobHealthScaling.targetSeconds;
  return Math.max(1, Math.round(mobBaseHp + (mobHealthScaling.targetHp - mobBaseHp) *
    progress ** mobHealthScaling.exponent));
}

  pityStart: 500, pityStepKills: 50, pityStepChance: 0.005, maxChance: 0.025 };

/** Chance after unlock/cooldown: .25%, plus .5 percentage points per pity step, capped at 2.5%. */
export function yuukaSpawnChanceFormula(kills, hasSpawned = false, bossActive = false) {
  const settings = yuukaSpawnSettings;
  if (kills < settings.unlockKills || (hasSpawned && kills < settings.cooldownKills)) return 0;
  const steps = Math.floor(Math.max(0, kills - settings.pityStart) / settings.pityStepKills);
  return Math.min(settings.maxChance, settings.baseChance + steps * settings.pityStepChance) *
    (bossActive ? specialEnemySettings.bossSpawnMultiplier : 1);
}

// Enemy damage scales with current player level and active survival minutes.
export const enemyDamageScaling = { base: 1, levelDivisor: 6, minutesDivisor: 4 };

/** floor(enemyBase * variantMultiplier * (1 + (level/6) * (minutes/4))). */
export function enemyContactDamageFormula(baseDamage, level, survivalSeconds, variantMultiplier = 1) {
  const s = enemyDamageScaling;
  const minutes = Math.max(0, survivalSeconds) / 60;
  const scale = s.base + (Math.max(1, level) / s.levelDivisor) * (minutes / s.minutesDivisor);
  return Math.max(0, Math.floor(baseDamage * variantMultiplier * scale));
}

/** Nearest integer with ties to even, used by the EXP curve. */
export function roundToEven(value) {
  const lower = Math.floor(value), fraction = value - lower;
  return fraction === 0.5 ? lower + (lower % 2) : Math.round(value);
}
export function levelExpFormula(level) {
  const current = Math.max(1, Math.floor(level));
  return current === 1 ? 79 : roundToEven((4 * (current + 1)) ** 2.1) - roundToEven((4 * current) ** 2.1);
}

/** Standard Mob report: round(3 + playerLevel / (2 + reportTier)). */
export function mobExpFormula(level, tier) {
  return Math.round(reportSettings.mobBase + Math.max(1, Math.floor(level)) /
    (reportSettings.mobDivisor + Math.max(0, Math.min(3, Math.floor(tier)))));
}

/** Yuuka spawn HP: round((normal player damage + 100) / 100 * 900). */
export const yuukaHpSettings = { offset: 100, divisor: 100, base: 900 };
export function yuukaHpFormula(damage) {
  return Math.max(1, Math.round((Math.max(0, damage) + yuukaHpSettings.offset) /
    yuukaHpSettings.divisor * yuukaHpSettings.base));
}

/** ATK/SPD/PICKUP/Haste percent bonus multiplier (25% -> 1.25). */
export function percentBonusFormula(percent) {
  return 1 + Math.max(0, Number.isFinite(Number(percent)) ? Number(percent) : 0) / 100;
}

¦Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¡ÃƒÆ’Ã†â€™Ãƒâ€ Ã¢â‚¬â„¢ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬Ãƒâ€¦Ã‚Â¡ÃƒÆ’Ã†â€™ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã…Â¡ÃƒÆ’Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â±10% above20. Do not randomize values<=2.
  const variance = base > damageRules.randomizeAbove
    ? Math.max(base * damageRules.variancePercent, damageRules.minimumVariance) : 0;
  const randomized = variance ? base - variance + random() * variance * 2 : base;
  return Math.max(0, Math.round(randomized * Math.max(0, damageMod)));
}

/** Crowd-adjusted arrivals: 8/s empty -> 5/s at40 nearby; 2/s at50 visible slots. */
export function spawnRateFormula(nearby, visible) {
  const s = playtestSpawnSettings;
  if (visible >= s.visibleLimit) return s.crowdedPerSecond;
  return Math.round(s.perSecond + (s.maxPerSecond - s.perSecond) *
    (1 - Math.min(1, nearby / s.nearbyTarget)));
}

/** Boss chance per eligible kill; charge freezes while any boss is alive. */
export function bossPityThresholds(endlessSeconds = null) {
  const s = bossSpawnSettings;
  return endlessSeconds !== null && endlessSeconds >= s.lateEndlessSeconds
    ? { unlockKills: s.lateUnlockKills, pityStart: s.latePityStart, guaranteedKills: s.lateGuaranteedKills }
    : { unlockKills: s.unlockKills, pityStart: s.pityStart, guaranteedKills: s.guaranteedKills };
}

/** Select the live pity curve using time since completing Stage 4, keeping the existing kill counter. */
export function bossChanceFormula(kills, endlessSeconds = null) {
  const s = { ...bossSpawnSettings, ...bossPityThresholds(endlessSeconds) };
  if (kills < s.unlockKills) return 0;
  const pity = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (kills - s.pityStart) / (s.guaranteedKills - s.pityStart)));
  return s.baseChance + (1 - s.baseChance) * pity;
}


/** Growth is inactive until purchased; costs are reserved for the future upgrade shop. */
export const growthSettings = {
  defaultRank: 0, maxRank: 3, damagePerLevelPerRank: 0.1,
  rankCosts: [500, 10000, 50000], tickThresholdFrames: 20, minimumTickMultiplier: 0.2
};

/** Multiply independent base-weapon bonuses; Growth stays outside this product.
 * Weapon damage uses factors (120% = 1.2). Hit cooldown is measured in 60Hz frames.
 * Only primary projectiles count toward the split, not secondary/on-hit effects.
 */
export function weaponDamageFormula(baseWeaponDamage, bonusesPercent = [], {
  growthRank = 0, playerLevel = 1, growthEligible = false,
  projectileCount = 1, hitCooldownFrames = 60, enhancementRank = 0
} = {}) {
  const weapon = baseWeaponDamage * bonusesPercent.reduce((value, bonus) => value * (1 + bonus / 100), 1);
  const rank = Math.max(0, Math.min(growthSettings.maxRank, Math.floor(growthRank)));
  const tickMultiplier = Math.min(1, Math.max(growthSettings.minimumTickMultiplier,
    hitCooldownFrames / growthSettings.tickThresholdFrames));
  const growth = growthEligible ? growthSettings.damagePerLevelPerRank / damageRules.baseScale *
    rank * Math.max(1, playerLevel) / Math.max(1, projectileCount) * tickMultiplier : 0;
  // Enhancements add flat damage after level/enchantment bonuses, split over primary projectiles.
  const enhancement=Math.max(0,Math.floor(enhancementRank))*crafterSettings.enhancementDamagePerRank/damageRules.baseScale/Math.max(1,projectileCount);
  return weapon + growth + enhancement;
}


/** Haste changes start-to-start timing only; quantize to60Hz frames, minimum one frame. */
export function attackTimeFormula(baseSeconds, hastePercent = 0, minimumFrames = 1) {
  return Math.max(1, minimumFrames, Math.round(baseSeconds * 60 /
    (1 + Math.max(0, hastePercent) / 100))) / 60;
}

/** Standard base40px; characters may override their starting radius (including zero). */
export function pickupRangeFormula(bonusPercent = 0, baseRadius = 40) {
  return Math.max(0, baseRadius + 0.4 * bonusPercent);
}


/** ATK values are percentage points: base100 + bonuses20+30 = total150%. */
export const attackStatSettings = { baseATK: 100 };
export function totalATKFormula(baseATK = attackStatSettings.baseATK, bonuses = []) {
  return baseATK + bonuses.reduce((sum, bonus) => sum + bonus, 0);
}


/** Critical modifier is bonus percentage points: +50% means1.5x total damage. */
export function totalCritModFormula(baseCritMod = (combatBalance.criticalMultiplier - 1) * 100, bonuses = []) {
  return baseCritMod + bonuses.reduce((sum, bonus) => sum + bonus, 0);
}


/** Target vulnerability debuffs add percentage points, then multiply final damage. */
export function bonusDamageTakenFormula(bonuses = []) {
  return 1 + bonuses.reduce((sum, bonus) => sum + bonus, 0) / 100;
}


/** Damage Bonus sources use multipliers:1.2x and1.3x stack to1.5x. */
export function damageBonusFormula(bonuses = []) {
  return 1 + bonuses.reduce((sum, bonus) => sum + (bonus - 1), 0);
}


/** Independent target reductions multiply; values are percentage points (20 =20%). */
export function damageReductionFormula(reductions = []) {
  return reductions.reduce((multiplier, reduction) =>
    multiplier * (1 - Math.max(0, Math.min(100, reduction)) / 100), 1);
}


/** Halo item: threshold is inclusive for the far bonus; level0 means unequipped. */
export const haloSettings = { distanceThreshold: 130, closeMultiplier: 0.9,
  farMultipliers: [1.2, 1.4, 1.6] };
export function haloDamageFormula(distance, level = 0) {
  const rank = Math.max(0, Math.min(haloSettings.farMultipliers.length, Math.floor(level)));
  if (!rank) return 1;
  return distance < haloSettings.distanceThreshold ? haloSettings.closeMultiplier :
    haloSettings.farMultipliers[rank - 1];
}


/** Combine independent modifier categories; each category aggregates its own sources first. */
export function damageModifiersFormula({ criticalMultiplier = 1, bonusDamageTaken = 1,
  DB = 1, DR = 1, halo = 1, attackModifier = 1 } = {}) {
  return criticalMultiplier * bonusDamageTaken * DB * DR * halo * attackModifier;
}


/** Special-enemy stats are snapshots at spawn, using timer components, not total minutes.
 * SPD is a ratio of unmodified playerSettings.speed; callers convert it to movement units.
 * These profiles are opt-in pending enemy assignments and attack implementation.
 */
export function specialEnemyStatsFormula(type, elapsedSeconds = 0) {
  const seconds = Math.max(0, Math.floor(elapsedSeconds));
  const minuteTimer = Math.floor(seconds / 60) % 60;
  const secondTimer = seconds % 60;
  if (type === 'bomber-boss') {
    return {
      atk: 2 + 0.225 * minuteTimer,
      spd: 0.42 + 0.018 * minuteTimer,
      hp: Math.round(1000 + 1000 ** (1 + minuteTimer / 25)),
      expValue: Math.round(750 ** (1 + minuteTimer / 60)),
      instantKOImmune: true
    };
  }
  if (type !== 'shooter' && type !== 'bomber') {
    throw new RangeError('Special stat profile must be shooter, bomber or bomber-boss.');
  }
  return {
    atk: 2 + minuteTimer * (type === 'shooter' ? 0.8 : 0.15),
    spd: 0.35 + 0.015 * minuteTimer,
    hp: Math.round(4 ** (3.6 + minuteTimer / 8.5) - 127),
    expValue: Math.round(5 ** (1 + (minuteTimer + secondTimer / 30) / 25))
  };
}


/** Reference time scaling uses full elapsed minute/hour components. */
export function enemyTimeScalingFormula(elapsedSeconds = 0) {
  const seconds = Math.max(0, elapsedSeconds);
  const fullMinutes = Math.floor(seconds / 60);
  const minuteTimer = fullMinutes % 60;
  const hourTimer = Math.floor(seconds / 3600);
  const minutesPast30 = Math.max(0, fullMinutes - 30);
  const hourPast1 = Math.max(0, hourTimer - 1);
  return { a: Math.max(0, minuteTimer - 23) + 37 * hourTimer,
    b: minutesPast30 + 60 * hourPast1 };
}

/** Minute-quantized reference stats; rounding HP/ATK is left to damage/entity consumers. */
export function enemyStatsScalingFormula({ baseATK, baseSPD, baseHP }, elapsedSeconds = 0) {
  const { a, b } = enemyTimeScalingFormula(elapsedSeconds);
  return {
    atk: (baseATK + 2 * a) ** (1 + b / 25),
    spd: Math.min(300, (baseSPD + 0.12 * a) ** (1 + b / 25)),
    hp: (baseHP + baseHP * 0.05 * a) ** (1 + b / 50)
  };
}

/** Optional project clock: campaign stays unscaled; endless starts at reference23:00.
 * Supply active seconds since Stage4 completion, or null before endless.
 * Reference a first increases one full minute later; no enemy-pool swap is implied.
 */
export function campaignScalingTimeFormula(endlessSeconds = null) {
  return endlessSeconds === null ? 0 : 23 * 60 + Math.max(0, endlessSeconds);
}


/** Final score weights; boss/miniboss bonuses supplement the overall enemy defeat count. */
export const scoreSettings = {
  enemy: 75, miniBoss: 428, boss: 2251, minutePast30: 20126,
  minute: 126, second: 10, level: 1219,
  hardcoreMinute: 0.01, hardcoreHour: 1.2
};

/** Calculate a score snapshot with timer components, preserving the supplied hour rules.
 * Hardcore is opt-in; this helper does not implement a Hardcore game mode or publish scores.
 */
export function scoreFormula({ enemyDefeated = 0, miniBossDefeated = 0, bossDefeated = 0,
  playerLevel = 1, elapsedSeconds = 0, hardcore = false } = {}) {
  const seconds = Math.max(0, Math.floor(elapsedSeconds));
  const finalHourValue = Math.floor(seconds / 3600);
  const finalMinuteValue = Math.floor(seconds / 60) % 60;
  const finalSecondValue = seconds % 60;
  const s = scoreSettings;
  const baseScore = enemyDefeated * s.enemy + miniBossDefeated * s.miniBoss + bossDefeated * s.boss +
    Math.max(0, finalMinuteValue - 30) * s.minutePast30 + Math.min(59, finalMinuteValue) * s.minute +
    Math.min(59, finalSecondValue) * s.second + playerLevel * s.level;
  const hardcoreBonus = hardcore ? Math.floor(baseScore *
    (finalMinuteValue * s.hardcoreMinute + finalHourValue * s.hardcoreHour)) : 0;
  return { baseScore, hardcoreBonus, finalScore: Math.floor(baseScore + hardcoreBonus) };
}

--- SNAPSHOT FILE: public/Development/gif-animation.js | sha256=85d169d5ceb087474fb51eb11599ffa1dfd18a2664f87a9ea58aa1044331e03f | encoding=utf-8-sig ---
/** Load predecoded GIF display frames while retaining original frame durations. */
export async function loadGifAnimation(character) {
  character.animationFrames = await Promise.all(character.gifFrames.map(frame =>
    new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const image = new Image();
      image.onload = () => resolve({ image, duration: frame.duration });
      image.onerror = () => reject(new Error(`Could not load ${frame.source}.`));
      image.src = frame.source;
    })
  ));
  character.image = character.animationFrames[0].image;
}

/** Select the original GIF frame for elapsed playback time, including while idle. */
export function gifFrameAt(frames, elapsed) {
  const total = frames.reduce((sum, frame) => sum + frame.duration, 0);
  let time = elapsed % total;
  for (let i = 0; i < frames.length; i++) {
    time -= frames[i].duration;
    if (time < 0) return i;
  }
  return 0;
}

--- SNAPSHOT FILE: public/Development/golden-crafter-rules.js | sha256=b821c75f03ad1427231d89c3c9a0c62bba56789f40807da6e406d5a2f708460d | encoding=utf-8-sig ---
import {superSynergyChoices,applySuperSynergyChoice} from './super-synergy-rules.js';
import { synergyRecipes } from './synergy-recipes.js';
import { umbrellaUpgradeSettings, arisWeaponSettings } from './game-config.js';

/** Use each weapon's actual MAX level, including future weapon definitions. */
function maximumLevel(weapon) {
  return weapon.id==='plana-umbrella'?umbrellaUpgradeSettings.maxLevel:
    weapon.id==='aris-laser'?arisWeaponSettings.maxLevel:weapon.maxLevel;
}

/** Only compatible, equipped MAX pairs can cause a Golden Crafter drop or fusion choice. */
export function goldenCrafterChoices(player,recipes=synergyRecipes) {
  const slots=player.attackSlots||[],choices=[];
  for(const recipe of recipes) {
    if(!recipe.id||!recipe.result?.id||recipe.ingredients?.length!==2||slots.some(w=>w?.id===recipe.result.id))continue;
    for(let a=0;a<Math.min(6,slots.length);a++)for(let b=a+1;b<Math.min(6,slots.length);b++) {
      const first=slots[a],second=slots[b];if(!first||!second)continue;
      const ids=[first.id,second.id].sort(),needed=[...recipe.ingredients].sort();
      if(ids[0]!==needed[0]||ids[1]!==needed[1])continue;
      if(!Number.isFinite(maximumLevel(first))||!Number.isFinite(maximumLevel(second))||
        (first.level||1)<maximumLevel(first)||(second.level||1)<maximumLevel(second))continue;
      choices.push({id:`synergy:${recipe.id}:${a}:${b}`,name:recipe.result.name||recipe.result.id,
        label:'Fuse MAX weapons',kind:'synergy',target:recipe.result,recipe,slots:[a,b],disabled:false,
        description:recipe.description||`Fuse ${first.name||first.id} and ${second.name||second.id} into ${recipe.result.name||recipe.result.id}.`});
    }
  }
  return [...choices,...(typeof superSynergyChoices==='function'?superSynergyChoices(player):[])];
}

/** Replace the two ingredients with one synergy atomically; cancellation never calls this. */
export function applyGoldenCrafterChoice(player,id,recipes=synergyRecipes) {
  if(id.startsWith('super-synergy:'))return applySuperSynergyChoice(player,id);
  const choice=goldenCrafterChoices(player,recipes).find(choice=>choice.id===id);
  if(!choice)return {consumed:false,success:false,message:'No compatible MAX-level weapon pair.'};
  let result;
  try{result=choice.recipe.createWeapon?choice.recipe.createWeapon():{...choice.recipe.result};}
  catch{return {consumed:false,success:false,message:'Fusion unavailable. The Golden Crafter was not used.'};}
  if(!result||result.id!==choice.recipe.result.id)return {consumed:false,success:false,message:'Fusion unavailable.'};
  const [a,b]=choice.slots;
  const enchantments=choice.slots.flatMap(index=>{
    const item=player.attackSlots[index];const values=item.enchantments|| (item.enchantment?[item.enchantment]:[]);
    return values.slice(0,1).map(value=>typeof value==='object'?{...value}:value);
  });
  result={...result,level:result.level||1,isSynergy:true,consumedWeaponIds:[...choice.recipe.ingredients]};
  // Draw the first MAX ingredient last, so it is on top of the crossing.
  const earliest=choice.slots.map(index=>player.attackSlots[index]).sort((a,b)=>(a.maxedOrder??Infinity)-(b.maxedOrder??Infinity))[0];
  result.synergyTopWeaponId=earliest.id;
  if(enchantments.length)result.enchantments=enchantments;
  player.attackSlots[a]=result;player.attackSlots[b]=null;
  return {consumed:true,success:true,message:`${result.name||result.id} created!`};
}

import { createBuffHud } from './buff-hud.js';

/** Reserve only visible caption ink, accounting for the slot art's top padding. */
export function levelCaptionSpacing(slotWidth, text) {
  const glyphs = [...text].filter(letter => letter !== ' ').map(glyphRectangle);
  const textWidth = [...text].reduce((sum, letter) => sum +
    (letter === ' ' ? 3 : glyphRectangle(letter).width - 1), 1);
  const inkBottom = Math.max(...glyphs.map(glyph => glyph.offsetY + glyph.height));
  const nextBoxInset = slotWidth * (1 - 237 / 255) / 2;
  return Math.max(0, slotWidth * 0.9 * inkBottom / textWidth - 6 - nextBoxInset);
}

/** Keep the equipment frame 2px below the lowest visible attack-level outline. */
function updateCaptionRowSpacing(container, entries) {
  const visible=entries.filter(entry=>!entry.caption.hidden);
  if(!visible.length){container.style.setProperty('--level-space','0px');return;}
  const textWidth=text=>[...text].reduce((sum,letter)=>sum+(letter===' '?3:glyphRectangle(letter).width-1),1);
  // Scale the entire row together. Fitting each label independently makes LV1 and LV7
  // different heights because their digit glyphs have different widths.
  const scale=Math.min(...visible.map(entry=>entry.slot.getBoundingClientRect().width*.9/textWidth(entry.captionText)));
  let spacing = 0;
  for (const entry of visible) {
    entry.caption.style.width=`${textWidth(entry.captionText)*scale}px`;
    entry.caption.style.height=`${20*scale}px`;
    const inkBottom=Math.max(...[...entry.captionText].filter(letter=>letter!==' ').map(letter=>{
      const glyph=glyphRectangle(letter);return glyph.offsetY+glyph.height;
    }));
    const nextBoxInset=entry.slot.getBoundingClientRect().width*(1-237/255)/2;
    spacing=Math.max(spacing,inkBottom*scale-6-nextBoxInset);
  }
  container.style.setProperty('--level-space', `${spacing}px`);
}

import { normalSpriteSize, spriteDisplayPadding } from './scene-metrics.js';
import { mapSizeMultiplier } from './map-bounds.js';
// EDIT zoom and source-pixel polygons to tune this finite, angled map.
export const islandScale = 2 * mapSizeMultiplier; // Map and obstacle geometry scale together.
export const islandWidth = 1448 * islandScale;
export const islandHeight = 1086 * islandScale;
// Inner seawall/paving edge, including the concave inlet on the south side.
export const islandBoundary = [
  [154,309], [267,235], [506,145], [650,145],
  // Follow the recessed north seawall behind the tower instead of cutting
  // straight across the ocean to the right-hand promenade.
  [770,200], [895,176], [1096,145],
  [1277,345], [1392,502], [1320,671], [1055,822],
  [981,704], [781,756], [576,851], [208,764], [59,540]
];
const shoreClearance = 10; // EDIT extra safety distance from water in source pixels.

// Buildings follow their angled footprints. The center tower has only a LOW
// ground footprint here, leaving its visually tall roof/back projection walkable.
export const islandObstacles = [
  [[235,290],[330,230],[430,290],[440,375],[340,415],[255,370]],
  [[400,210],[490,170],[575,220],[585,300],[475,340],[420,305]],
  [[230,470],[305,455],[425,535],[410,605],[270,650],[215,570]],
  [[1010,275],[1090,240],[1170,315],[1180,380],[1070,420],[1000,365]],
  [[1110,460],[1190,420],[1260,485],[1250,555],[1155,600],[1090,545]],
  [[650,398],[730,375],[775,445],[722,490],[650,460]], // Tower foundation only.
  // Pond and its raised rim, following the angled oval in the map artwork.
  Array.from({ length: 24 }, (_, i) => [
    890 + 54 * Math.cos(i * Math.PI / 12),
    300 + 43 * Math.sin(i * Math.PI / 12)
  ]),
  // Requested large southwest lawn: follow the curb around the grass/trees.
  [[456,688],[472,637],[551,603],[672,722],[538,786]],
  // Requested triangular planted patch southeast of the center tower.
  [[908,550],[923,520],[980,498],[1048,577],[1038,596]],
];

const towerSilhouette = [[653,144],[692,70],[758,93],[768,438],[724,484],[652,450]];

/** Test source-space points against an angled polygon. */
export function pointInPolygon(x,y,polygon) {
  let inside=false;
  for(let i=0,j=polygon.length-1;i<polygon.length;j=i++) {
    const [xi,yi]=polygon[i], [xj,yj]=polygon[j];
    if((yi>y)!==(yj>y) && x<(xj-xi)*(y-yi)/(yj-yi)+xi) inside=!inside;
  }
  return inside;
}

/** Reject any obstacle intersecting the actor's source-space foot rectangle. */
function intersectsBox(polygon,left,top,right,bottom) {
  if([[left,top],[right,top],[right,bottom],[left,bottom]].some(([x,y])=>pointInPolygon(x,y,polygon)))return true;
  if(polygon.some(([x,y])=>x>=left&&x<=right&&y>=top&&y<=bottom))return true;
  for(let i=0;i<polygon.length;i++) {
    const [x,y]=polygon[i], [xx,yy]=polygon[(i+1)%polygon.length];
    // Parametric clipping of each polygon edge against the rectangle.
    let enter=0,exit=1;
    for(const [p,q]of [[-(xx-x),x-left],[xx-x,right-x],[-(yy-y),y-top],[yy-y,bottom-y]]) {
      if(p===0){if(q<0){enter=2;break;}}else if(p<0)enter=Math.max(enter,q/p);else exit=Math.min(exit,q/p);
    }
    if(enter<=exit)return true;
  }
  return false;
}

/** Keep foot corners safely inside the paving, away from the sea-facing wall. */
function insideShore(x, y) {
  if (!pointInPolygon(x, y, islandBoundary)) return false;
  for (let i = 0; i < islandBoundary.length; i++) {
    const [ax, ay] = islandBoundary[i];
    const [bx, by] = islandBoundary[(i + 1) % islandBoundary.length];
    const dx = bx - ax, dy = by - ay;
    const t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, ((x - ax) * dx + (y - ay) * dy) / (dx * dx + dy * dy)));
    if (Math.hypot(x - ax - t * dx, y - ay - t * dy) < shoreClearance) return false;
  }
  return true;
}

/** Keep an entire ground-loot footprint on paving and outside obstacle polygons. */
export function canPlaceIslandLoot(x, y, radius, map) {
  const sx = (x - map.originX) / islandScale, sy = (y - map.originY) / islandScale;
  const r = radius / islandScale;
  return [[sx-r,sy-r],[sx+r,sy-r],[sx+r,sy+r],[sx-r,sy+r]].every(([px,py]) => insideShore(px,py)) &&
    !islandObstacles.some(polygon => intersectsBox(polygon, sx-r, sy-r, sx+r, sy+r));
}

/** Validate island containment and all obstacle footprints at an actor location. */
export function canStandOnIsland(character,x,y,map,ignoreObstacles=false) {
  const size=character.spriteSize||normalSpriteSize;
  const sx=(x-map.originX)/islandScale;
  const sy=(y+size/2-spriteDisplayPadding-map.originY)/islandScale;
  const rx=size*.12/islandScale, ry=size*.05/islandScale;
  const corners=[[sx-rx,sy-ry],[sx+rx,sy-ry],[sx+rx,sy+ry],[sx-rx,sy+ry]];
  return corners.every(([x,y])=>insideShore(x,y)) &&
    (ignoreObstacles || !islandObstacles.some(p=>intersectsBox(p,sx-rx,sy-ry,sx+rx,sy+ry)));
}

/** Find nearby boundary tangents for natural sliding along sloped collision edges. */
function contactTangents(character, x, y, map, ignoreObstacles = false) {
  const size = character.spriteSize || normalSpriteSize;
  const px = (x - map.originX) / islandScale;
  const py = (y + size / 2 - spriteDisplayPadding - map.originY) / islandScale;
  const reach = Math.hypot(size * .12, size * .05) / islandScale + shoreClearance + 6;
  const tangents = [];
  for (const polygon of ignoreObstacles ? [islandBoundary] : [islandBoundary, ...islandObstacles]) {
    for (let i = 0; i < polygon.length; i++) {
      const [ax, ay] = polygon[i];
      const [bx, by] = polygon[(i + 1) % polygon.length];
      const dx = bx - ax, dy = by - ay;
      const length = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
      const t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, ((px - ax) * dx + (py - ay) * dy) / (length * length)));
      if (Math.hypot(px - ax - t * dx, py - ay - t * dy) <= reach) {
        tangents.push([dx / length, dy / length]);
      }
    }
  }
  return tangents;
}

/** Sweep to contact, then project remaining motion onto the actual angled edge. */
export function resolveIslandMotion(character, fromX, fromY, toX, toY, map, ignoreObstacles = false) {
  const steps = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(Math.max(Math.abs(toX - fromX), Math.abs(toY - fromY)) / 6));
  const dx = (toX - fromX) / steps, dy = (toY - fromY) / steps;
  let x = fromX, y = fromY;
  for (let i = 0; i < steps; i++) {
    if (canStandOnIsland(character, x + dx, y + dy, map, ignoreObstacles)) {
      x += dx; y += dy;
      continue;
    }
    // Reach the edge without crossing it; keep the unapplied movement for sliding.
    let low = 0, high = 1;
    for (let iteration = 0; iteration < 10; iteration++) {
      const fraction = (low + high) / 2;
      if (canStandOnIsland(character, x + dx * fraction, y + dy * fraction, map, ignoreObstacles)) low = fraction;
      else high = fraction;
    }
    x += dx * low; y += dy * low;
    const remainingX = dx * (1 - low), remainingY = dy * (1 - low);
    const candidates = [[remainingX, 0], [0, remainingY]];
    for (const [tx, ty] of contactTangents(character, x, y, map, ignoreObstacles)) {
      const along = remainingX * tx + remainingY * ty;
      candidates.push([tx * along, ty * along]);
    }
    let best = [0, 0], bestProgress = 0;
    for (const [sx, sy] of candidates) {
      const progress = sx * remainingX + sy * remainingY;
      if (progress > bestProgress && canStandOnIsland(character, x + sx, y + sy, map, ignoreObstacles)) {
        best = [sx, sy]; bestProgress = progress;
      }
    }
    x += best[0]; y += best[1];
  }
  return { x, y };
}

/** Draw the entire finite image once; the camera zooms into this world-sized map. */
export function drawIsland(context,map,camera,debug=false) {
  context.drawImage(map.image,map.originX-camera.x,map.originY-camera.y,islandWidth,islandHeight);
  if(debug) {
    context.save();context.strokeStyle='#ffcf60';context.lineWidth=2;
    for(const polygon of [islandBoundary,...islandObstacles]) {
      context.beginPath();polygon.forEach(([x,y],i)=>{
        const args=[map.originX+x*islandScale-camera.x,map.originY+y*islandScale-camera.y];
        if(i===0)context.moveTo(...args);else context.lineTo(...args);
      });context.closePath();context.stroke();
    }context.restore();
  }
}

/** Occlude a behind-tower actor only inside its sprite area and the tower silhouette. */
export function drawTowerOcclusion(context,character,map,camera,opacity=1) {
  const size=character.spriteSize||normalSpriteSize;
  const foot=(character.y+size/2-spriteDisplayPadding-map.originY)/islandScale;
  if(foot>=440)return;
  context.save();
    context.globalAlpha *= opacity;
  context.beginPath();context.rect(character.x-camera.x-size/2,character.y-camera.y-size/2,size,size);context.clip();
  context.beginPath();towerSilhouette.forEach(([x,y],i)=>{
    const args=[map.originX+x*islandScale-camera.x,map.originY+y*islandScale-camera.y];
    if(i===0)context.moveTo(...args);else context.lineTo(...args);
  });context.closePath();context.clip();
  drawIsland(context,map,camera);context.restore();
}

import { weaponKnockbackMultiplier } from './game-config.js';
import {tuningPerk} from './tuning-parts.js';
import {applySkillControl} from './enemy-control.js';
export function knockbackTuningMultiplier(player){
  const main=player.mainWeaponId??(player.label==='Plana'?'plana-umbrella':null);
  return main==='plana-umbrella'&&player.tuningParts?1+tuningPerk(player.tuningParts,'knockbackStrengthPercent')/100:1;
}
export function applyTuningKnockback(player,enemy){
  if(!enemy||enemy.hp<=0||!player.tuningParts||knockbackTuningMultiplier(player)===1)return false;
  const frames=tuningPerk(player.tuningParts,'knockbackFrames'),speed=tuningPerk(player.tuningParts,'knockbackSpeed');
  if(!frames||!speed)return false;
  const dx=enemy.x-player.x,dy=enemy.y-player.y,length=Math.hypot(dx,dy),distance=speed*frames*weaponKnockbackMultiplier(player);
  applySkillControl(enemy,(length?dx/length:1)*distance,(length?dy/length:0)*distance,0,frames/60);
  return true;
}

--- SNAPSHOT FILE: public/Development/knockback.js | sha256=9c7ac14946f4f7aa77ee52b5e3afe2fec18adf13516acc17b3a31a379ffeef2e | encoding=utf-8-sig ---
import { knockbackSettings } from './game-config.js';
import { getCombatHitbox, segmentHitsBody } from './combat-hitboxes.js';

/** Age resistance in gameplay seconds, retaining any configured base resistance. */
export function updateKnockbackResistance(enemy, delta) {
  if (enemy.knockbackIdleSeconds === undefined) return;
  enemy.knockbackIdleSeconds += Math.max(0, delta);
  if (enemy.knockbackIdleSeconds >= knockbackSettings.resetSeconds - 1e-8) enemy.knockbackResistanceBonus = 0;
  enemy.knockbackResistance = Math.min(knockbackSettings.maxResistance,
    Math.max(0, enemy.baseKnockbackResistance || 0) + (enemy.knockbackResistanceBonus || 0));
}

/** Scale speed by existing resistance, then add a stack for subsequent knockbacks. */
export function beginKnockback(enemy, dx, dy, duration, { ignoreKnockbackResistance = false } = {}) {
  // Absolute immunity also blocks attacks that bypass resistance.
  if (enemy.knockbackImmune || !(duration > 0) || !(Math.hypot(dx, dy) > 0)) return null;
  updateKnockbackResistance(enemy, 0);
  const resistance = Math.min(knockbackSettings.maxResistance,
    Math.max(0, enemy.baseKnockbackResistance || 0) + (enemy.knockbackResistanceBonus || 0));
  const scale = ignoreKnockbackResistance ? 1 : 1 - resistance;
  enemy.knockbackResistanceBonus = Math.min(knockbackSettings.maxResistance,
    Math.round(((enemy.knockbackResistanceBonus || 0) + knockbackSettings.resistancePerHit) * 1e6) / 1e6);
  enemy.knockbackIdleSeconds = 0;
  enemy.knockbackResistance = Math.min(knockbackSettings.maxResistance,
    Math.max(0, enemy.baseKnockbackResistance || 0) + enemy.knockbackResistanceBonus);
  return { dx: dx * scale, dy: dy * scale, duration, elapsed: 0, applied: 0, stopped: false };
}

/** Stop displacement without removing an independent stun or contact recovery timer. */
export function stopEnemyKnockback(enemy) {
  if (enemy.skillKnockback) enemy.skillKnockback.stopped = true;
  if (enemy.contactReaction) enemy.contactReaction.stopped = true;
}

/** Travel at constant effect speed until duration expires or the mover reports collision. */
export function advanceKnockback(enemy, motion, delta, move) {
  motion.elapsed += Math.max(0, delta);
  const progress = Math.min(1, motion.elapsed / motion.duration);
  const step = progress - motion.applied;
  if (!motion.stopped && step > 0 && move(enemy, motion.dx * step, motion.dy * step) === false) motion.stopped = true;
  motion.applied = progress;
  return !motion.stopped && progress < 1;
}

/** Sweep living enemies and sample solid scenery; never slide or pass through a collision. */
export function createKnockbackMover(getEnemies, isClear) {
  return (enemy, dx, dy) => {
    const start = getCombatHitbox(enemy, true);
    const length = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
    if (!length) return true;
    const candidates = getEnemies().filter(other => other !== enemy && (!enemy.id || other.id !== enemy.id))
      .map(other => ({ other, body: getCombatHitbox(other, true) }))
      .filter(({ body }) => Math.abs(body.x - start.x) <= Math.abs(dx) + body.rx + start.rx &&
        Math.abs(body.y - start.y) <= Math.abs(dy) + body.ry + start.ry);
    const stepSize = Math.max(.25, Math.min(knockbackSettings.collisionStep, start.rx / 2, start.ry / 2));
    const steps = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(length / stepSize));
    const stepX = dx / steps, stepY = dy / steps;
    for (let i = 0; i < steps; i++) {
      const x = enemy.x + stepX, y = enemy.y + stepY;
      const body = getCombatHitbox({ ...enemy, x, y }, true);
      const previous = getCombatHitbox(enemy, true);
      const hit = candidates.find(({ body: other }) => segmentHitsBody({ ...other,
        rx: other.rx + body.rx, ry: other.ry + body.ry }, previous.x, previous.y, body.x, body.y));
      if (hit || !isClear(enemy, x, y)) {
        stopEnemyKnockback(enemy);
        if (hit) stopEnemyKnockback(hit.other);
        return false;
      }
      enemy.x = x; enemy.y = y;
    }
    return true;
  };
}

--- SNAPSHOT FILE: public/Development/level-up-actions.js | sha256=20a58d58145c8ac40c9ff075abdea41e5854f8fa5b70533587bafeb3f13227da | encoding=utf-8-sig ---
import { isContentUnlocked } from './item-catalog.js';
const limits={reroll:10,eliminate:10,hold:5};
export function levelActionUses(player,action){
  const purchased=Math.max(0,Math.min(limits[action],Math.trunc(Number(player.abilityUpgradeRanks?.[action])||0)));
  const granted=isContentUnlocked('developer-level-actions')?limits[action]:purchased;
  return Math.max(0,granted-(player.levelActionSpent?.[action]||0));
}
export function spendLevelAction(player,action){
  if(!levelActionUses(player,action))return false;
  player.levelActionSpent??={};player.levelActionSpent[action]=(player.levelActionSpent[action]||0)+1;return true;
}
export function levelActionChoices(player,pool,random=Math.random){
  const remaining=pool.slice(),choices=[];
  while(remaining.length){
    const weight=choice=>Math.max(0,Number(choice.weapon?.weight??1)||0),total=remaining.reduce((sum,c)=>sum+weight(c),0);
    let roll=random()*total,index=remaining.length-1;
    for(let i=0;i<remaining.length;i++){roll-=weight(remaining[i]);if(roll<0){index=i;break;}}
    choices.push(...remaining.splice(index,1));
  }
  const held=choices.findIndex(choice=>choice.id===player.heldUpgradeId);
  if(held>=0)choices.unshift(...choices.splice(held,1));
  return choices;
}
