/** Manage elite surges and their boss-or-Midori outcome; admin triggers bypass campaign timing. */
export function createEndlessEvents(onBossReady, random = Math.random, onMidoriStart = () => {}, onEventEnd = () => {}) {
  let event = null, definition = null, bossWasAlive = false;
  let midoriRemaining = 0, manual = false;
  let eventKey = null, eventSequence = 0;
  function endCurrent() {
    if (eventKey) onEventEnd(eventKey);
    eventKey = null;
  }

  /** Begin a Midori-only stream in place of requesting the boss wave. */
  function startMidori() {
    endCurrent();
    eventKey = `midori-${++eventSequence}`;
    midoriRemaining = midoriSettings.eventSeconds;
    definition = endlessEventRegistry.midori;
    onMidoriStart();
  }
  /** Resolve an elite army before choosing its replacement encounter. */
  function finishElites() {
    endCurrent();
    if (random() < endlessEventSettings.midoriAfterEliteChance) startMidori();
    else onBossReady();
  }
  function chooseEvent() {
    endCurrent();
    midoriRemaining = 0;
    const ids = endlessEventSettings.enabledEvents.filter(id => endlessEventRegistry[id]?.create);
    const id = ids[Math.floor(random() * ids.length)];
    definition = endlessEventRegistry[id] || null;
    event = definition ? definition.create(finishElites) : null;
    eventKey = definition ? `eliteSurge-${++eventSequence}` : null;
  }
  chooseEvent();
  return {
    get name() { return definition?.name || 'None'; },
    get phase() { return midoriRemaining > 0 ? 'midori' : event?.phase || 'normal'; },
    get seconds() { return midoriRemaining > 0 ? midoriSettings.eventSeconds - midoriRemaining : event?.seconds || 0; },
    get active() { return manual || midoriRemaining > 0; },
    get eliteChance() { return midoriRemaining > 0 ? 0 : event?.eliteChance ?? eliteChance; },
    get spawnEventKey() { return midoriRemaining > 0 || ['ramp', 'elites'].includes(event?.phase) ? eventKey : null; },
    get spawnType() { return midoriRemaining > 0 ? 'midori' : null; },
    get allowsBossWave() { return midoriRemaining <= 0 && (!event || event.phase === 'ready'); },
    spawnRate(normalRate) { return midoriRemaining > 0 ? normalRate : event ? event.spawnRate(normalRate) : normalRate; },
    /** Start either event immediately for testing without enabling endless progression. */
    trigger(id) {
      if (!['midori', 'eliteSurge'].includes(id)) return false;
      manual = true;
      if (id === 'midori') startMidori();
      else if (id === 'eliteSurge') {
        endCurrent();
        eventKey = `eliteSurge-${++eventSequence}`;
        midoriRemaining = 0;
        definition = endlessEventRegistry.eliteSurge;
        event = definition.create(finishElites);
        event.startElites();
      } else { manual = false; return false; }
      return true;
    },
    stop() { manual = false; chooseEvent(); },
    end() { manual = false; chooseEvent(); },
    update(delta, state) {
      if (bossWasAlive && !state.bossAlive) { manual = false; chooseEvent(); }
      bossWasAlive = state.bossAlive;
      if (midoriRemaining > 0) {
        if (state.bossAlive) { manual = false; chooseEvent(); return; }
        if (state.spawning && Number.isFinite(delta)) midoriRemaining -= Math.max(0, delta);
        if (midoriRemaining <= 0) { manual = false; chooseEvent(); }
        return;
      }
      event?.update(delta, { ...state, endless: state.endless || manual });
    }
  };
}

--- SNAPSHOT FILE: public/Game/enemy-control.js | sha256=799ee1d72cbfa99bde5ef0dfaff5a8a68b11662fc1b2cad6f79a783874b1f419 | encoding=utf-8-sig ---
import { beginKnockback, advanceKnockback } from './knockback.js';

/** Stun independently of displacement, respecting knockback resistance and absolute immunity. */
export function applySkillControl(enemy, dx, dy, stunSeconds, travelSeconds, options = {}) {
  enemy.stunRemaining = Math.max(enemy.stunRemaining || 0, stunSeconds);
  enemy.skillKnockback = beginKnockback(enemy, dx, dy, travelSeconds, options);
  enemy.contactReaction = null; enemy.attack = null; enemy.moving = false;
}

/** Resolve stun before AI/contact so a stunned enemy cannot move or damage the player. */
export function updateEnemyControl(enemy, delta, move) {
  if(enemy.frozenRemaining>0){
    enemy.frozenRemaining=Math.max(0,enemy.frozenRemaining-delta);
    if(enemy.frozenRemaining<1e-6)enemy.frozenRemaining=0;
    enemy.moving=false;return true; // Freeze also holds knockback and attack timers.
  }
  const stunned = enemy.stunRemaining > 0;
  if(stunned)enemy.stunVisualElapsed=(enemy.stunVisualElapsed||0)+delta;
  else delete enemy.stunVisualElapsed;
  if (!stunned && !enemy.skillKnockback) return false;
  enemy.stunRemaining = Math.max(0, (enemy.stunRemaining || 0) - delta);
  if (enemy.stunRemaining < 1e-6) enemy.stunRemaining = 0;
  const knockback = enemy.skillKnockback;
  if (knockback) {
    if (!advanceKnockback(enemy, knockback, delta, move)) delete enemy.skillKnockback;
  }
  if (stunned) enemy.moving = false;
  return stunned;
}

import { deathSettings, gachaSettings } from './game-config.js';
export { deathSettings, gachaSettings } from './game-config.js';
// Visual remnants are separate from living NPCs: no AI, collisions, or rewards.
const deaths = new Map();
const gachaEffects = new Map();
let gachaIcon;



/** Load the supplied gacha artwork before the preview begins. */
export function loadEnemyDeathGraphics() {
  gachaIcon = new Image();
  gachaIcon.src = '../sprites/icons/Gacha_Ticket.png';
  return gachaIcon.decode();
}

/** Calculate a fast eased rise, brief stop, then expansion and disappearance. */
export function gachaPose(effect) {
  const rise = Math.min(1, effect.elapsed / gachaSettings.rise);
  const pop = Math.max(0, Math.min(1,
    (effect.elapsed - gachaSettings.rise - gachaSettings.hold) / gachaSettings.pop));
  return { x: effect.x, y: effect.y - effect.height * (1 - (1 - rise) ** 3),
    scale: 0.75 + 0.25 * rise + 0.65 * pop,
    opacity: 1 - pop, behind: rise < 0.55 };
}

/** Freeze the defeated pose and launch it away from the source of the hit. */
export function beginEnemyDeath(enemy, source, { knockback = true } = {}) {
  const dx = source ? enemy.x - source.x : enemy.contactReaction?.nx ?? 1;
  const dy = source ? enemy.y - source.y : enemy.contactReaction?.ny ?? 0;
  const length = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
  const death = { elapsed: 0, originX: enemy.x, originY: enemy.y,
    nx: length ? dx / length : 1, ny: length ? dy / length : 0, opacity: 1, knockback };
  deaths.set(enemy.id, { ...enemy, death, transition: null, moving: false });
  gachaEffects.set(enemy.id, { x: enemy.x, y: enemy.y, elapsed: 0,
    height: (enemy.spriteSize || 112) / 2 + 28 });
}

/** Advance every remnant, including offscreen ones, and remove after the fade. */
export function updateEnemyDeaths(delta) {
  for (const [id, effect] of gachaEffects) {
    effect.elapsed += delta;
    if (effect.elapsed >= gachaSettings.rise + gachaSettings.hold + gachaSettings.pop) gachaEffects.delete(id);
  }
  for (const [id, enemy] of deaths) {
    const death = enemy.death;
    death.elapsed += delta;
    const progress = Math.min(1, death.elapsed / deathSettings.duration);
    const distance = death.knockback === false ? 0 : deathSettings.distance * (1 - (1 - progress) ** 3);
    enemy.x = death.originX + death.nx * distance;
    enemy.y = death.originY + death.ny * distance;
    const fade = Math.max(0, Math.min(1,
      (death.elapsed - deathSettings.fadeStart) / (deathSettings.duration - deathSettings.fadeStart)));
    death.opacity = 1 - fade * fade;
    if (progress === 1) deaths.delete(id);
  }
}

/** Render the rising icon behind bodies first, then above them as it pops. */
export function drawGachaDeaths(context, camera, width, height, behind) {
  if (!gachaIcon?.naturalWidth) return;
  for (const effect of gachaEffects.values()) {
    const pose = gachaPose(effect);
    const x = pose.x - camera.x, y = pose.y - camera.y;
    if (pose.behind !== behind || x < -100 || x > width + 100 || y < -100 || y > height + 100) continue;
    const w = gachaSettings.width * pose.scale;
    const h = w * gachaIcon.naturalHeight / gachaIcon.naturalWidth;
    context.save();
    context.globalAlpha = pose.opacity;
    context.drawImage(gachaIcon, x - w / 2, y - h / 2, w, h);
    context.restore();
  }
}

/** Return visual-only remnants for the same camera culling as normal enemies. */
export function getEnemyDeaths() {
  return [...deaths.values()];
}

/** Visual hop only: collision and world positions stay grounded while Pedrozilla skips. */
export function enemyBounceOffset(character) {
  const bounce=character.movementBounce;
  if (!bounce || !character.moving || character.death) return 0;
  const seconds=character.eventMotionAge ?? (character.elapsed || 0)/1000;
  const period=bounce.periodSeconds*(character.bouncePeriodScale ?? 1);
  const phase=((seconds/period+(character.bouncePhase ?? 0))%1+1)%1;
  return -bounce.height*Math.sin(Math.PI*phase)**2;
}

--- SNAPSHOT FILE: public/Game/enemy-spatial-index.js | sha256=9f8bb912630cea22cc737e463222980d821a8c337069f167efdd6b80d0d098c3 | encoding=utf-8-sig ---
/** Conservative broadphase only; callers retain their existing exact collision tests. */
export function createEnemySpatialIndex(enemies, getBounds, cellSize=128) {
  const cells=new Map();
  enemies.forEach((enemy,order)=>{
    const b=getBounds(enemy),entry={enemy,order};
    for(let y=Math.floor((b.y-b.ry)/cellSize);y<=Math.floor((b.y+b.ry)/cellSize);y++)
      for(let x=Math.floor((b.x-b.rx)/cellSize);x<=Math.floor((b.x+b.rx)/cellSize);x++) {
        const key=x+','+y;
        let bucket=cells.get(key);if(!bucket)cells.set(key,bucket=[]);
        bucket.push(entry);
      }
  });
  return {querySegment(from,to,padding=0) {
    const found=new Set();
    for(let y=Math.floor((Math.min(from.y,to.y)-padding)/cellSize);y<=Math.floor((Math.max(from.y,to.y)+padding)/cellSize);y++)
      for(let x=Math.floor((Math.min(from.x,to.x)-padding)/cellSize);x<=Math.floor((Math.max(from.x,to.x)+padding)/cellSize);x++)
        for(const entry of cells.get(x+','+y)||[])found.add(entry);
    // Preserve Map insertion order: piercing limits and random damage rolls depend on it.
    return [...found].sort((a,b)=>a.order-b.order).map(entry=>entry.enemy);
  }};
}

/** Roll basic-enemy elites; bosses and playable-character test NPCs are excluded. */
export function enemyVariant(type, template, mode = 'random', random = Math.random, survivalSeconds = 0, endlessSeconds = null, eliteProbability = eliteChanceFormula(endlessSeconds)) {
  const elite = template.miniBoss === true || type === 'midori' || (type === 'mob' || template.standard) && (mode === 'elite' || (mode === 'random' && random() < eliteProbability));
  const baseHp = (['mob', 'midori'].includes(type) || template.standard) ? basicMobHpFormula(survivalSeconds)

  const scaled = profile ? enemyStatsScalingFormula(profile, campaignScalingTimeFormula(endlessSeconds)) : null;
  const maxHp = (scaled?.hp ?? baseHp) * (elite && !dedicatedMega ? combatBalance.eliteHpMultiplier : 1);
  return {
    elite,
    miniBoss: template.miniBoss === true || (elite && type !== 'midori'),
    label: dedicatedMega ? (megaType === 'megaSweeper' ? 'Mega Sweeper' : 'Mega Mob') : elite && type !== 'midori' ? `Mega ${template.label}` : template.label,
    spriteSize: (template.spriteSize || normalSpriteSize) * (elite && type !== 'midori' && !template.miniBoss ? (template.megaSizeMultiplier ?? eliteSizeMultiplier) : 1),
    hp: maxHp,
    maxHp,
    contactDamage: type === 'shiroko' ? shirokoBossStats.contactDamage : template.contactDamage,
    contactDamageMultiplier: elite && !dedicatedMega ? 2 : 1,
    ...(profile ? { hp: Math.round(maxHp), maxHp: Math.round(maxHp), perTypeStats: true,
      contactDamage: scaled.atk, expReward: profile.expValue,
      movementSpeedMultiplier: scaled.spd * playerSettings.speed / playerSettings.movementBase } : {})
  };
}

/** Pick from the configured standard enemy pool while keeping Mob most common. */
export function chooseStandardEnemy(random = Math.random, elapsedSeconds = 0, stageId = null) {
  const weights = stageId && enemyStagePools[stageId] ? Object.fromEntries(enemyStagePools[stageId].map(type=>[type,1])) : standardEnemyWeights;
  const entries = Object.entries(weights).filter(([type, weight]) => {
    const profile = enemyTypeStats[type];
    return weight > 0 && (!profile || (elapsedSeconds >= profile.spawnStartSeconds && elapsedSeconds < profile.spawnEndSeconds));
  });
  let roll = random() * entries.reduce((sum, [, weight]) => sum + weight, 0);
  for (const [type, weight] of entries) { roll -= weight; if (roll < 0) return type; }
  return entries.at(-1)?.[0] ?? null;
}

/** Find walkable ground near the intended landing, even if an enemy died inside an obstacle. */
export function safeDropLanding(x, y) {
  if (isLandingClear(x, y, lootLandingRadius)) return { x, y };
  for (let radius = 24; radius <= 2048; radius += 24) {
    const samples = Math.min(64, Math.ceil(radius / 12) * 8);
    for (let index = 0; index < samples; index++) {
      const angle = index / samples * Math.PI * 2;
      const px = x + Math.cos(angle) * radius, py = y + Math.sin(angle) * radius;
      if (isLandingClear(px, py, lootLandingRadius)) return { x: px, y: py };
    }
  }
  return null;
}

/** Redirect a scatter to safe ground; retain unplaceable loot for a later retry. */
export function constrainDropLanding(drop) {
  const flight = drop.scatter;
  const landing = safeDropLanding(flight.x + flight.dx, flight.y + flight.dy);
  drop.pendingLanding = !landing;
  if (landing) {
    flight.dx = landing.x - flight.x;
    flight.dy = landing.y - flight.y;
  }
}

/** Launch loot toward a random nearby landing spot with a small airborne hop. */
export function launchDrop(drop, random = Math.random) {
  const angle = random() * Math.PI * 2;
  const distance = dropScatter.minDistance + random() * (dropScatter.maxDistance - dropScatter.minDistance);
  drop.scatter = { elapsed: 0, x: drop.x, y: drop.y,
    dx: Math.cos(angle) * distance, dy: Math.sin(angle) * distance,
    rotation: drop.rotation, spin: (random() - 0.5) * Math.PI };
  constrainDropLanding(drop);
  return drop;
}

/** Animate the outward toss before enabling pickup attraction or collection. */
export function updateDropScatter(drop, delta) {
  if (!drop.scatter) return false;
  if (drop.pendingLanding) {
    drop.landingRetry = (drop.landingRetry || 0) - delta;
    if (drop.landingRetry <= 0) { constrainDropLanding(drop); drop.landingRetry = 0.5; }
    if (drop.pendingLanding) return true;
  }
  const flight = drop.scatter;
  flight.elapsed += Math.max(0, delta);
  const t = Math.min(1, flight.elapsed / dropScatter.duration);
  const progress = 1 - (1 - t) ** 2;
  drop.x = flight.x + flight.dx * progress;
  drop.y = flight.y + flight.dy * progress;
  drop.lift = 4 * dropScatter.hopHeight * t * (1 - t);
  drop.rotation = flight.rotation + flight.spin * progress;
  if (t === 1) { delete drop.scatter; drop.lift = 0; }
  return true;
}

/** Burst Yuuka credits throughout a disk, with angular coverage in every direction. */
export function dropYuukaCredits(enemy, defeated = false, random = Math.random) {
  const count = defeated ? yuukaSettings.deathCredits : yuukaSettings.hitCredits;
  const radius = bossExpRewards.maxDistance * yuukaSettings.burstRadiusMultiplier;
  const angleOffset = random() * Math.PI * 2;
  const rewards = [];
  for (let index = 0; index < count; index++) {
    const drop = { id: ++nextId, kind: 'credits', value: 1, x: enemy.x,
      y: enemy.y + (enemy.spriteSize || normalSpriteSize) / 2 - spriteDisplayPadding,
      rotation: random() * Math.PI * 2 };
    drops.set(drop.id, drop);
    launchDrop(drop, random);
    if (defeated) {
      const angle = angleOffset + (index + random()) / count * Math.PI * 2;
      // Square root distributes credits by area, throughout the whole radius.
      const distance = Math.sqrt(random()) * radius;
      drop.scatter.dx = Math.cos(angle) * distance;
      drop.scatter.dy = Math.sin(angle) * distance;
      constrainDropLanding(drop);
    }
    rewards.push(drop);
  }
  return rewards;
}

/** Roll independent bonus drops, allowing both rewards on the same defeat. */
export function dropEnemyLoot(enemy, random = Math.random) {
  if (['yuuka','sensei'].includes(enemy.type)) return dropYuukaCredits(enemy, true, random);
  const credits = random() < (enemy.elite ? eliteLoot.creditChance : creditDropChance);
  const note = random() < (enemy.elite ? eliteLoot.noteChance : secretNoteDropChance);
  for (const [kind, awarded] of [['credits', credits], ['secretTechNotes', note]]) {
    if (!awarded) continue;
    const drop = {
      id: ++nextId, kind, value: kind === 'credits' && enemy.elite ? eliteLoot.creditAmount : 1,
      x: enemy.x,
      y: enemy.y + (enemy.spriteSize || normalSpriteSize) / 2 - spriteDisplayPadding,
      rotation: random() * Math.PI * 2
    };
    drops.set(drop.id, drop);
    launchDrop(drop, random);
  }
}

/** Select artwork by EXP value; the highest supplied file is named Report 3. */
export function reportTier(value) {
  return value > reportSettings.thirdMax ? 3 : value >= reportSettings.thirdMin ? 2 : value >= reportSettings.secondMin ? 1 : 0;
}

/** Roll a report's EXP value: elites get Report 1 (80%) or Report 2 (20%). */
export function rollEnemyExp(random = Math.random, elite = false) {
  if (elite) {
    return random() < reportSettings.eliteSecondChance
      ? reportSettings.secondMin + Math.floor(random() * (reportSettings.secondMax - reportSettings.secondMin + 1))
      : reportSettings.thirdMin + Math.floor(random() * (reportSettings.thirdMax - reportSettings.thirdMin + 1));
  }
  const uncommon = random() >= reportSettings.commonChance;
  return uncommon ? reportSettings.secondMin + Math.floor(random() * (reportSettings.secondMax - reportSettings.secondMin + 1))
    : reportSettings.firstMin + Math.floor(random() * (reportSettings.firstMax - reportSettings.firstMin + 1));
}

/** Expose ground records for inspection without deleting off-screen reports. */
export function getExpDrops() {
  return [...drops.values()].filter(drop => drop.kind === 'exp');
}



/** Scale elite rewards down, cap their combined EXP, and preserve positive report pickups. */
export function rollEliteReports(random = Math.random, override, player = getActivePlayer()) {
  const values = Array.from({ length: eliteExpRewards.count }, () =>
    Math.max(reportSettings.secondMin, Math.floor(override ?? rollEnemyExp(random, true))));
  let deficit = eliteExpRewards.minimumTotal - values.reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0);
  const indices = values.map((_, index) => index).sort((a, b) => values[b] - values[a]);
  for (const index of indices) {
    if (deficit <= 0) break;
    const extra = Math.min(deficit, Math.max(0, reportSettings.thirdMax - values[index]));
    values[index] += extra;
    deficit -= extra;
  }
  const rolledTotal = values.reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0);
  const total = eliteExpTotalFormula(rolledTotal, player?.level || 1);
  const count = Math.min(values.length, total);
  if (!count) return [];
  // Give every report one point, then share the remainder by its original roll weight.
  const weights = values.slice(0, count);
  const weightTotal = weights.reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0);
  const rewards = weights.map(weight => 1 + Math.floor((total - count) * weight / weightTotal));
  let remaining = total - rewards.reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0);
  for (let index = 0; remaining > 0; index = (index + 1) % count, remaining--) rewards[index]++;
  return rewards;
}

// Boss reward settings live in game-config.js.


/** Split a level-scaled boss reward into positive reports without losing EXP. */
export function rollBossReports(player, random = Math.random, fixedTotal) {
  if (Number.isFinite(fixedTotal) && fixedTotal > 0) {
    const total = Math.round(fixedTotal);
    const count = Math.min(total, Math.max(bossExpRewards.minimumReports, Math.ceil(total/reportSettings.thirdMax)));
    return Array.from({length:count}, (_,i)=>Math.floor(total/count)+(i<total%count?1:0));
  }
  const requirement = experienceForLevel(player?.level || 1);
  const minimum = Math.max(bossExpRewards.minimumReports,
    Math.ceil(requirement * bossExpRewards.minLevels));
  const maximum = Math.max(minimum, Math.floor(requirement * bossExpRewards.maxLevels));
  const total = minimum + Math.floor(random() * (maximum - minimum + 1));
  const count = Math.max(bossExpRewards.minimumReports, Math.ceil(total / reportSettings.thirdMax));
  const base = Math.floor(total / count), remainder = total % count;
  return Array.from({ length: count }, (_, index) => base + (index < remainder ? 1 : 0));
}

/** Divide player level by (2 + report tier), add 3, then round halves upward. */
export function standardMobExp(player, tier = 0) {
  return mobExpFormula(player?.level || 1, tier);
}

/** Drop a full-circle boss burst, five elite reports, or one ordinary report. */
export function dropEnemyExp(enemy, random = Math.random) {
  const reports = [];
  if(!enemyExpDropsEnabled)return reports;
  if (['yuuka','sensei'].includes(enemy.type)) return reports;
  const boss = enemy.boss === true || (enemy.boss !== false && ['iroha', 'shiroko'].includes(enemy.type));
  // Roll artwork first so its tier bonus does not depend on the resulting EXP.
  const standardMob = (enemy.type === 'mob' || enemy.standard) && !boss && !enemy.elite && enemy.expReward == null;
  const mobTier = standardMob ? (random() < reportSettings.commonChance ? 0 : 1) : undefined;
  const values = boss ? rollBossReports(getActivePlayer(), random, enemy.expReward) : (enemy.elite && !enemy.miniBoss) || enemy.type === 'yuuka' ? rollEliteReports(random, enemy.expReward)
    : [Math.floor(enemy.expReward ?? ((enemy.type === 'mob' || enemy.standard)
      ? standardMobExp(getActivePlayer(), mobTier) : rollEnemyExp(random)))];
  const burstAngle = boss ? random() * Math.PI * 2 : 0;
  for (const [index, value] of values.entries()) {
    const drop = dropExpReport(enemy, random, value, mobTier);
    if (!drop) continue;
    if (boss) {
      // One report per angular sector guarantees coverage in every direction.
      const angle = burstAngle + (index + random() * 0.5) / values.length * Math.PI * 2;
      const distance = bossExpRewards.minDistance + random() *
        (bossExpRewards.maxDistance - bossExpRewards.minDistance);
      drop.scatter.dx = Math.cos(angle) * distance;
      drop.scatter.dy = Math.sin(angle) * distance;
      constrainDropLanding(drop);
    }
    reports.push(drop);
  }
  return reports;
}

/** Create one scattered report; explicit admin EXP overrides remain supported. */
function dropExpReport(enemy, random, value, tier = reportTier(value)) {
  if (!Number.isFinite(value) || value <= 0) return;
  const drop = {
    id: ++nextId, kind: 'exp', value, tier, x: enemy.x,
    y: enemy.y + (enemy.spriteSize || normalSpriteSize) / 2 - spriteDisplayPadding,
    rotation: random() * Math.PI * 2
  };
  drops.set(drop.id, drop);
  launchDrop(drop, random);
  return drop;
}

/** Load report graphics once and provide collection/rendering for the preview. */
export function createExpPickups(getPlayer, options = {}) {
  isLandingClear = options.isLandingClear || (() => true);
  getActivePlayer = getPlayer; // Resolve the controlled avatar at the moment a boss dies.
  const lootStatus = document.querySelector('#player-loot-status');
  const tools = document.querySelector('#loot-tools');
  if (tools) {
    tools.querySelectorAll('[data-loot-action]').forEach(button => {
      button.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const player = getPlayer();
        const action = button.dataset.lootAction;
        if (action === 'clear') drops.clear();
        else if (action === 'collect') {
          for (const drop of drops.values()) collectDrop(drop, player);
        } else if (action === 'reset') {
          lootTotals.credits = 0;
          lootTotals.secretTechNotes = 0;persistLoot();
        } else {
          const amount = Number(tools.querySelector('[name="loot-value"]').value);
          spawnTestDrop(action, Math.min(1000000, amount), player.x + 80,
            player.y + (player.spriteSize || normalSpriteSize) / 2 - spriteDisplayPadding);
        }
      });
    });
  }
  const icons = Array.from({ length: 4 }, (_, tier) => {
    const image = new Image();
    image.src = `../sprites/icons/Exp_Report_${tier}.png`;
    return image;
  });
  const ready = Promise.all(icons.map(image => image.decode()));
  const creditIcon = new Image();
  creditIcon.src = '../sprites/icons/credits.png';
  const creditReady = creditIcon.decode();
  const noteIcon = new Image();
  noteIcon.src = '../sprites/icons/Ultimate_Skill_Book.png';
  const noteReady = noteIcon.decode();

  /** Sweep direct pickups, then accelerate attracted loot toward the active avatar. */
  function update(player, previous, delta = 0) {
    const footOffset = (player.spriteSize || normalSpriteSize) / 2 - spriteDisplayPadding;
    const start = { x: previous.x, y: previous.y + footOffset };
    const end = { x: player.x, y: player.y + footOffset };
    const dx = end.x - start.x, dy = end.y - start.y;
    const lengthSquared = dx * dx + dy * dy;
    for (const drop of drops.values()) {
      // Let the toss finish so contact kills cannot instantly swallow the drops.
      if (updateDropScatter(drop, delta)) continue;
      const fraction = lengthSquared ? Math.max(0, Math.min(1,
        ((drop.x - start.x) * dx + (drop.y - start.y) * dy) / lengthSquared)) : 0;
      const sweptDistance = Math.hypot(drop.x - start.x - dx * fraction, drop.y - start.y - dy * fraction);
      if (drop.pickupTarget !== player) {
        drop.attracted = false;
        drop.walkOverPickup = false;
        drop.pickupSpeed = 0;
        drop.pickupTarget = player;
      }
      // Walking over loot begins the same center-bound flight as a magnet pickup.
      // Arona can finish these pickups without gaining any attraction radius.
      if (sweptDistance <= pickupRadius) drop.walkOverPickup = true;
      const range = pickupRangeFormula(ensureCombatStats(player).pickupPercent+racerPassBonuses(player).pickup, player.pickupRange ?? 40);
      if (!range && !drop.walkOverPickup) {
        // Swapping to an avatar without attraction stops pending magnets immediately.
        drop.attracted = false;
        drop.pickupSpeed = 0;
        continue;
      }
      // Magnet detection follows the sprite center; walk-over detection stays at feet.
      const centerFraction = lengthSquared ? Math.max(0, Math.min(1,
        ((drop.x - previous.x) * dx + (drop.y - previous.y) * dy) / lengthSquared)) : 0;
      const centerDistance = Math.hypot(drop.x - previous.x - dx * centerFraction,
        drop.y - previous.y - dy * centerFraction);
      if (drop.walkOverPickup || centerDistance <= range) drop.attracted = true;
      if (drop.attracted) {
        const targetX = player.x - drop.x, targetY = player.y - drop.y;
        const distance = Math.hypot(targetX, targetY);
        const time = Math.max(0, delta);
        const speed = drop.pickupSpeed || 0;
        drop.pickupSpeed = Math.min(pickupMagnet.maxSpeed, speed + pickupMagnet.acceleration * time);
        const travel = Math.min(distance, (speed + drop.pickupSpeed) / 2 * time);
        if (distance > 0) {
          drop.x += targetX / distance * travel;
          drop.y += targetY / distance * travel;
        }
        // Rendered beneath actors: disappear only on arrival at the actual center.
        if (distance - travel <= 0.5) collectDrop(drop, player);
      }
    }
    if (lootStatus) lootStatus.textContent = `Credits: ${lootTotals.credits} | Secret Tech Notes: ${lootTotals.secretTechNotes} | Ground drops: ${drops.size}`;
  }

  /** Draw only visible reports beneath actors, keeping their orientation fixed. */
  function draw(context, camera, width, height) {
    for (const drop of drops.values()) {
      if (drop.pendingLanding) continue;
      const x = drop.x - camera.x, y = drop.y - camera.y - (drop.lift || 0);
      if (x < -iconWidth || y < -iconWidth || x > width + iconWidth || y > height + iconWidth) continue;
      const icon = drop.kind === 'exp' ? icons[drop.tier]
        : drop.kind === 'credits' ? creditIcon : noteIcon;
      const sourceWidth = icon.naturalWidth;
      const sourceHeight = icon.naturalHeight;
      if (!sourceWidth) continue;
      const iconHeight = iconWidth * sourceHeight / sourceWidth;
      context.save();
      context.translate(x, y);
      context.rotate(drop.rotation);
      context.drawImage(icon, -iconWidth / 2, -iconHeight / 2, iconWidth, iconHeight);
      context.restore();
    }
  }
  return { ready: Promise.all([ready, creditReady, noteReady]), update, draw, clear: clearGroundLoot };
}

--- SNAPSHOT FILE: public/Game/firing-rings.js | sha256=78488905f070ca9e451b0454beec2a816fb50e7740e508f271ffd488e8135b0a | encoding=utf-8-sig ---
/** Common growth keeps the outer rings strictly larger despite their staggered appearances. */
export function firingRingPoses(elapsed,size) {
  const growth=1+Math.min(1,Math.max(0,elapsed)/.5)*1.5;
  return Array.from({length:3},(_,i)=>{
    const age=elapsed-i*.045,t=age/.42;
    return {visible:age>=0&&t<1,x:i*22+Math.max(0,elapsed)*55,
      radius:size*(.65+i*.5)*growth,opacity:Math.max(0,1-t)**2*.75};
  });
}

/** Soft double-stroked muzzle shock rings; local impact only, no screen flash. */
export function drawFiringRings(context,x,y,angle,elapsed,size,blue=false) {
  const rings=firingRingPoses(elapsed,size);if(!rings.some(r=>r.visible))return;
  context.save();context.translate(x,y);context.rotate(angle);context.globalCompositeOperation='lighter';context.shadowBlur=0;
  for(const ring of rings) {
    if(!ring.visible)continue;context.globalAlpha=ring.opacity;context.beginPath();
    for(let point=0;point<=32;point++) {
      const a=point/32*Math.PI*2,px=ring.x+Math.cos(a)*ring.radius*.3,py=Math.sin(a)*ring.radius;
      if(point===0)context.moveTo(px,py);else context.lineTo(px,py);
    }
    context.strokeStyle=blue?'rgba(75,190,255,.4)':'rgba(255,100,220,.4)';context.lineWidth=6;context.stroke();
    context.strokeStyle=blue?'#e5fcff':'#ffe9fc';context.lineWidth=1.6;context.stroke();
  }
  context.restore();
}

import {getEnemyHurtbox} from './combat-hitboxes.js';
export const frozenSettings={duration:3,opacity:.55,coverageScale:1.65,source:'../sprites/icons/effects/frozen.png'};
let ice;
export const frozenReady=typeof Image==='undefined'?Promise.resolve():new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{ice=new Image();ice.onload=resolve;ice.onerror=reject;ice.src=frozenSettings.source;});
export function applyFrozen(enemy,seconds=frozenSettings.duration){
  if(!(seconds>0)||enemy.hp===0)return false;
  enemy.frozenRemaining=Math.max(enemy.frozenRemaining||0,seconds);enemy.moving=false;return true;
}
export function freezeVisibleEnemies(enemies,camera,width,height){
  let count=0;for(const enemy of enemies){const body=getEnemyHurtbox(enemy);
    if(body.x+body.rx<camera.x||body.x-body.rx>camera.x+width||body.y+body.ry<camera.y||body.y-body.ry>camera.y+height)continue;
    if(applyFrozen(enemy))count++;
  }return count;
}
export function drawFrozenStatus(context,camera,enemy){
  if(!(enemy.frozenRemaining>0)||enemy.hp===0||!ice?.naturalWidth)return;
  const body=getEnemyHurtbox(enemy),size=enemy.spriteSize||Math.max(body.rx,body.ry)*2,
    height=size*frozenSettings.coverageScale,
    width=Math.max(size*frozenSettings.coverageScale,height*ice.naturalWidth/ice.naturalHeight);
  context.save();context.globalAlpha=frozenSettings.opacity;
  context.drawImage(ice,enemy.x-camera.x-width/2,enemy.y-camera.y-height/2,width,height);context.restore();
}
export function createFrozenAdmin({root,getEnemies,getCamera,getSize}){
  const status=root.querySelector('[role="status"]');
  root.querySelector('button').addEventListener('click',()=>{const {width,height}=getSize();const count=freezeVisibleEnemies(getEnemies(),getCamera(),width,height);status.textContent=`Frozen ${count} onscreen enemies for 3 seconds.`;});
}

/** Visual pursuit continues at normal speed during freeze, stun or flattening. */
export function animateFrozenEnemy(enemy,player,delta){
  const dx=player.x-enemy.x,dy=player.y-enemy.y;
  const directions=['up','upRight','right','downRight','down','downLeft','left','upLeft'];
  if(dx||dy)enemy.direction=directions[(Math.round(Math.atan2(dx,-dy)/(Math.PI/4))+8)%8];
  if(dx)enemy.facing=dx>0?'right':'left';
  enemy.moving=true;enemy.elapsed=(enemy.elapsed||0)+delta*1000;
  if(enemy.transition)enemy.transition.elapsed=(enemy.transition.elapsed||0)+delta*1000;
  if(enemy.attack){
    const duration=(enemy.layout?.columnEdges.length-1)*(enemy.attacks?.[enemy.attack.name]?.frameDuration||0);
    const elapsed=(enemy.attack.elapsed||0)+delta*1000;
    enemy.attack.elapsed=duration>0?elapsed%duration:elapsed;
  }
  if(enemy.bossAction?.clip)enemy.frozenPoseElapsed=(enemy.frozenPoseElapsed??(enemy.bossAction.elapsed||0)*1000)+delta*1000;
}

--- SNAPSHOT FILE: public/Game/fullscreen-preview.js | sha256=d632d9025a7ac2e56a98f4f31c1c8556a20d27c92120c8ab9944bd544790f36f | encoding=utf-8-sig ---
/** Center the reference 1280x720 game area in a dark surround, preserving the session. */
export function setupFullscreenPreview(canvas, releaseControls, {onSimulate=()=>{}}={}) {
  const enter = document.querySelector('#enter-fullscreen-preview');
  const exit = document.querySelector('#exit-fullscreen-preview');
  const layout = document.querySelector('.playtest-layout');
  const main = document.querySelector('#development-content');
  const sidebar = document.querySelector('.playtest-sidebar');
  let active = false;
  let previousInert = [];

  /** Resize via CSS/ResizeObserver; never scale actors or reset world positions. */
  function setFullscreen(enabled) {
    if (active === enabled) return;
    active = enabled;
    releaseControls();
    document.body.classList.toggle('fullscreen-preview', active);
    enter.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(active));
    exit.hidden = !active;
    if (active) {
      // Background admin controls should not receive hidden keyboard focus.
      const controls = [...main.children].filter(element => element !== layout).concat(sidebar);
      previousInert = controls.map(element => [element, element.inert]);
      for (const [element] of previousInert) element.inert = true;
      canvas.focus({ preventScroll: true });
    } else {
      for (const [element, inert] of previousInert) element.inert = inert;
      previousInert = [];
      enter.focus({ preventScroll: true });
    }
  }

  enter.addEventListener('click', () => setFullscreen(true));
  exit.addEventListener('click', () => setFullscreen(false));
  document.querySelector('#simulate-game')?.addEventListener('click', () => {setFullscreen(true);onSimulate();});
}

import { createSportsDrink, sportsDrinkDescription, createMalkuthHat, createRacerPass, createSafetyHelmet, createLifeJacket, createOverheatedOverclocking, overclockingDescription, isContentUnlocked, lifeJacketDescription, safetyHelmetDescription, racerPassDescription, malkuthDescription, isItemUnlocked, isItemRewardEnabled } from './item-catalog.js';
import { rollLevelUpgrades } from './level-upgrades.js';
import { recordWeaponMax } from './weapon-max-order.js';

// Super rewards respect item unlocks; unavailable pools fall back to normal Files.
export const superFileItems=[createMalkuthHat(true),createRacerPass(true),createSafetyHelmet(true),createLifeJacket(true),createOverheatedOverclocking(true),createSportsDrink(true)];
export const fileSettings={superChance:.05,tripleChance:.09,newChance:.1,weaponChance:.7,
  dropChance:0,bossGuaranteed:true,icon:'../sprites/icons/3 Stars Character Icon.png',maxGround:20,
  creditReplacementPerMax:.05,creditReplacementCap:.6};

/** Inclusive integer rolls and the supplied nested-floor Credits formula. */
export function fileCredits(type,random=Math.random,moneyUpBonus=0,stageMultiplier=1) {
  const [a,b]=type==='super'?[399,5]:type==='triple'?[399,3]:[301,1];
  const integer=max=>Math.min(max,Math.floor(random()*(max+1)));
  const multiplier=(1+moneyUpBonus/100)*stageMultiplier;
  return Math.floor(Math.floor(a/(3+integer(2)))*multiplier*(1+b*(20+integer(10))/100*multiplier));
}

/** Apply one accepted product without spending level-up choices; dropping never applies it. */
export function acceptFileProduct(player,product) {
  if(product.weapon?.isCharacterSkill)return false;
  const slots=product.kind==='item'?(player.equipmentSlots??=[]):(player.attackSlots??=[]);
  const owned=slots.find(item=>item?.id===product.weapon.id);
  if(owned) {
    if(product.kind==='item'&&product.weapon.isSuper&&!owned.isSuper&&!owned.awakened){Object.assign(owned,{...product.weapon});return true;}
    if(owned.isSynergy)return false;
    const max=owned.maxLevel||7;if((owned.level||1)>=max)return false;
    owned.level=(owned.level||1)+1;if(product.kind!=='item')recordWeaponMax(player,owned);return true;
  }
  const index=slots.findIndex(item=>!item);
  if(index<0&&slots.filter(Boolean).length>=6)return false;
  const item={...product.weapon};if(index>=0)slots[index]=item;else slots.push(item);return true;
}

/** Generate products using a shadow inventory so triple rewards cannot overfill or overlevel it. */
export function rollFileRewards(player,{random=Math.random,forceType,getOptions=rollLevelUpgrades,superItems=superFileItems}={}) {
  const roll=random();let type=forceType||(roll<fileSettings.superChance?'super':roll<fileSettings.superChance+fileSettings.tripleChance?'triple':'normal');
  const supers=superItems.filter(item=>{
    if(!isItemRewardEnabled(player,item.id))return false;
    const owned=player.equipmentSlots?.find(owned=>owned?.id===item.id);
    if(item.id==='malkuth-hat'&&!isItemUnlocked(item.id)&&!owned)return false;
    if(item.defaultUnlocked===false&&!isContentUnlocked(item.id)&&!owned)return false;
    return owned?!owned.isSuper&&!owned.awakened:(player.equipmentSlots||[]).filter(Boolean).length<6;
  });
  if(type==='super'&&!supers.length)type='normal';
  const result={type,products:[],credits:fileCredits(type,random,player.moneyUpBonus||0,player.stageCoinMultiplier??1)};
  if(type==='super') {
    const item=supers[Math.min(supers.length-1,Math.floor(random()*supers.length))];
    const description=item.id==='sports-drink'?sportsDrinkDescription(item):item.id==='overheated-overclocking'?overclockingDescription(item):item.id==='life-jacket'?lifeJacketDescription(item):item.id==='safety-helmet'?safetyHelmetDescription(item):item.id==='racer-pass'?racerPassDescription(item):item.id==='malkuth-hat'?malkuthDescription(item):undefined;
    result.products.push({kind:'item',weapon:{...item,level:1},name:item.name,super:true,description});return result;
  }
  const shadow={...player,attackSlots:(player.attackSlots||[]).map(w=>w?{...w}:null),equipmentSlots:(player.equipmentSlots||[]).map(w=>w?{...w}:null)};
  const free={weapon:6-shadow.attackSlots.filter(Boolean).length,item:6-shadow.equipmentSlots.filter(Boolean).length};
  for(let index=0;index<(type==='triple'?3:1);index++) {
    const maxed=[...shadow.attackSlots,...shadow.equipmentSlots].filter(w=>w&&(w.isSynergy||(w.level||1)>=(w.maxLevel||7))).length;
    // Editable saturation behavior: each MAX slot adds 5 percentage points toward the 100-Credit substitution.
    if(random()<Math.min(fileSettings.creditReplacementCap,maxed*fileSettings.creditReplacementPerMax)){result.credits+=100;continue;}
    const options=getOptions(shadow,{all:true}).filter(choice=>choice.weapon&&!choice.weapon.isSynergy&&!choice.weapon.isCharacterSkill);
    let selected=null;
    const allowNew=random()<fileSettings.newChance;
    for(let attempt=0;attempt<5&&!selected;attempt++) {
      let kind=random()<fileSettings.weaponChance?'weapon':'item';
      const pool=k=>options.filter(option=>{
        const category=/item|equipment/i.test(option.category||'')?'item':'weapon';
        const owned=(k==='item'?shadow.equipmentSlots:shadow.attackSlots).some(w=>w?.id===option.weapon.id);
        return category===k&&(owned||(allowNew&&free[k]>index));
      });
      let candidates=pool(kind);if(!candidates.length&&kind==='weapon'){kind='item';candidates=pool(kind);}
      if(candidates.length){
        const weights=candidates.map(c=>Math.max(0,Number(c.weapon?.weight??1)||0)),total=weights.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0);let roll=random()*total,pick=candidates.length-1;
        for(let i=0;i<candidates.length;i++){roll-=weights[i];if(roll<0){pick=i;break;}}
        selected={...candidates[pick],kind};
      }
    }
    if(selected&&acceptFileProduct(shadow,selected))result.products.push(selected);else result.credits+=100;
  }
  return result;
}

/** Boss delivery packages, a paused opening sequence, and individually accepted/dropped products. */
export function createGachaFiles({canvas,getPlayer,onOpen=()=>{},onChange=()=>{}}) {
  const drops=new Map();let nextId=0,active=false,animation=0,alignLight=()=>{};
  const image=new Image();image.src=fileSettings.icon;const ready=image.decode();
  const dialog=document.createElement('dialog');dialog.className='gacha-file-menu';dialog.setAttribute('aria-label','Gacha File');document.body.append(dialog);
  function label(element,value,wrap=false){element.setAttribute('aria-label',value);const graphic=document.createElement('canvas');element.append(graphic);createBitmapText(graphic,{variant:'font2',scale:1.2,wrap,maxWidth:canvas.getBoundingClientRect().width*.68}).setText(value);}
  function align(){const r=canvas.getBoundingClientRect();Object.assign(dialog.style,{left:`${r.left}px`,top:`${r.top}px`,width:`${r.width}px`,height:`${r.height}px`});}
  function syncOverlay(){if(active){align();alignLight();}}
  window.addEventListener('resize',syncOverlay);
  // Fixed dialogs must follow the canvas when the page or an ancestor scroller moves.
  window.addEventListener('scroll',syncOverlay,true);
  if(typeof ResizeObserver!=='undefined')new ResizeObserver(syncOverlay).observe(canvas);
  function close(){cancelAnimationFrame(animation);active=false;dialog.close();canvas.focus();onChange();}
  function open(drop) {
    if(active)return;active=true;drops.delete(drop.id);onOpen();align();dialog.replaceChildren();
    const reward=rollFileRewards(getPlayer(),{forceType:drop.forceType});dialog.classList.toggle('super-file',reward.type==='super');
    const stats=document.createElement('aside');stats.className='gacha-file-stats pause-character-stats';
    createCharacterStatsPanel({root:stats,scale:Math.min(1,canvas.getBoundingClientRect().width/1280)}).update(getPlayer());
    const panel=document.createElement('section');panel.className='gacha-file-panel';
    const heading=document.createElement('h2');label(heading,reward.type==='super'?'SUPER FILE!':reward.type==='triple'?'TRIPLE FILE!':'GACHA FILE');
    const counter=document.createElement('div');counter.className='gacha-file-counter';
    const coin=document.createElement('img');coin.src='../sprites/icons/credits.png';coin.alt='Credits';
    const amount=document.createElement('canvas');const creditText=createBitmapText(amount,{variant:'font2',scale:1.4,wrap:false});creditText.setText('0');counter.append(coin,amount);
    const file=document.createElement('button');file.type='button';file.className='gacha-file-package';file.setAttribute('aria-label','Open File');
    const graphic=document.createElement('img');graphic.src=fileSettings.icon;graphic.alt='Delivery File';graphic.className='gacha-file-base';
    const lid=document.createElement('img');lid.src=fileSettings.icon;lid.alt='';lid.className='gacha-file-lid';
    const sheet=document.createElement('span');sheet.className='gacha-file-sheet';sheet.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');file.append(graphic,sheet,lid);
    const cone=document.createElement('div');cone.className='gacha-file-cone';cone.hidden=true;
    const rays=document.createElement('div');rays.className='gacha-file-rays';rays.hidden=true;
    const rewardIcon=document.createElement('canvas');rewardIcon.width=rewardIcon.height=160;rewardIcon.className='gacha-file-reward-icon';rewardIcon.hidden=true;
    const detail=document.createElement('article');detail.className='gacha-file-detail';detail.hidden=true;
    const actions=document.createElement('div');actions.className='gacha-file-actions';actions.hidden=true;
    const take=document.createElement('button'),discard=document.createElement('button');take.type=discard.type='button';label(take,'Take');label(discard,'Drop');actions.append(take,discard);
    const done=document.createElement('button');done.type='button';done.className='gacha-file-done';done.hidden=true;label(done,'Continue');done.addEventListener('click',close);
    panel.append(heading,counter,cone,rays,rewardIcon,file);dialog.append(stats,panel,detail,actions,done);dialog.showModal();let started=false,finished=false,index=0;
    function alignSpotlight(){
      const stage=panel.getBoundingClientRect(),packet=file.getBoundingClientRect();
      panel.style.setProperty('--file-mouth-bottom',`${stage.bottom-(packet.top+packet.height*.45)}px`);
      panel.style.setProperty('--file-mouth-width',`${packet.width*.65}px`);
    }
    alignLight=alignSpotlight;graphic.addEventListener('load',alignSpotlight);alignSpotlight();
    function showProduct() {
      const product=reward.products[index];detail.replaceChildren();
      if(!product){actions.hidden=true;rewardIcon.hidden=true;rays.hidden=true;cone.hidden=true;done.hidden=false;detail.hidden=true;done.focus();return;}
      actions.hidden=false;detail.hidden=false;rewardIcon.hidden=false;rays.hidden=false;cone.hidden=false;
      rewardIcon.setAttribute('aria-label',product.name||product.weapon.name);
      applyEnhancedWeaponGlow(rewardIcon,product.weapon);
      const title=document.createElement('h3'),category=document.createElement('span'),description=document.createElement('p');
      label(title,product.name||product.weapon.name);label(category,product.super?'SUPER ITEM':product.category||'Weapon');
      label(description,product.description||`Receive ${product.weapon.name||'this product'}.`,true);
      const row=document.createElement('header');row.append(title,category);detail.append(row,description);
      const context=rewardIcon.getContext('2d');context.clearRect(0,0,160,160);
      const current=index;
      if(!drawSynergyIcon(rewardIcon,product.weapon,()=>index===current)) {
        const image=new Image();image.onload=()=>{
          if(index!==current)return;
          const crop=product.weapon.iconCrop||{x:0,y:0,width:image.naturalWidth,height:image.naturalHeight};
          const angle=(product.weapon.iconRotation||0)*Math.PI/180;
          const extent=Math.max(Math.abs(crop.width*Math.cos(angle))+Math.abs(crop.height*Math.sin(angle)),Math.abs(crop.width*Math.sin(angle))+Math.abs(crop.height*Math.cos(angle)));
          const scale=(product.weapon.iconFit?156:140)/extent;context.save();context.translate(80,80);if(product.weapon.iconFlipX)context.scale(-1,1);context.rotate(angle);
          context.drawImage(image,crop.x,crop.y,crop.width,crop.height,-crop.width*scale/2,-crop.height*scale/2,crop.width*scale,crop.height*scale);context.restore();
        };image.src=product.weapon.icon;
      }
      take.focus();
    }
    function resolve(takeProduct){const product=reward.products[index];if(!product)return;if(takeProduct&&!acceptFileProduct(getPlayer(),product))return;index++;onChange();showProduct();}
    take.addEventListener('click',()=>resolve(true));discard.addEventListener('click',()=>resolve(false));
    function reveal(){
      if(finished)return;finished=true;gainCredits(reward.credits);onChange();file.disabled=true;file.classList.add('revealed');
      for(let i=0;i<12;i++){const sparkle=document.createElement('span');sparkle.className='gacha-file-sparkle';sparkle.style.left=`${8+(i*23)%84}%`;sparkle.style.top=`${10+(i*31)%75}%`;sparkle.style.animationDelay=`${i*.13}s`;panel.append(sparkle);}
      showProduct();
    }
    file.addEventListener('click',()=>{
      if(started)return;started=true;alignSpotlight();file.classList.add('opening');cone.hidden=false;rays.hidden=false;const start=performance.now();
      for(let i=0;i<28;i++) {
        const mote=document.createElement('img');mote.src='../sprites/icons/credits.png';mote.alt='';mote.className='gacha-credit-mote';
        mote.style.setProperty('--start-x',`${8+(i*37)%84}%`);mote.style.setProperty('--start-y',`${30+(i*19)%65}%`);mote.style.animationDelay=`${i*.035}s`;dialog.append(mote);
      }
      function tick(now){if(!active)return;const t=Math.min(1,(now-start)/2200);creditText.setText(String(Math.floor(reward.credits*(1-(1-t)**3))));if(t<1)animation=requestAnimationFrame(tick);else reveal();}
      animation=requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    });
    dialog.oncancel=event=>{event.preventDefault();if(finished&&index>=reward.products.length)close();};
    dialog.oncontextmenu=event=>{event.preventDefault();if(finished&&index>=reward.products.length)close();};
  }
  function spawn(x,y,forceType){if(drops.size>=fileSettings.maxGround)return false;const point=safeDropLanding(x,y);if(!point)return false;const drop={id:++nextId,...point,forceType};drops.set(drop.id,drop);return drop;}
  return {ready,spawn,get active(){return active;},get count(){return drops.size;},
    roll(enemy){return (enemy.boss===true||['shiroko','iroha','arisu','neru'].includes(enemy.type))&&fileSettings.bossGuaranteed?spawn(enemy.x,enemy.y):false;},
    update(player,previous){if(active)return;const body=getCombatHitbox(player,false);for(const drop of drops.values())if(segmentHitsBody({x:drop.x,y:drop.y,rx:22+body.rx,ry:22+body.ry},previous?.x??player.x,previous?.y??player.y,body.x,body.y)){open(drop);break;}},
    draw(context,camera){if(!image.naturalWidth)return;for(const drop of drops.values()){const x=drop.x-camera.x,y=drop.y-camera.y;if(x<-30||y<-30||x>canvas.width+30||y>canvas.height+30)continue;context.drawImage(image,x-22,y-22,44,44);}},
    relocate(x,y){let index=0;for(const drop of drops.values()){
      const point=safeDropLanding(x+48+index*28,y);if(point)Object.assign(drop,point);else Object.assign(drop,{x,y});index++;
    }},
    clear(){drops.clear();if(active)close();}};
}

import {getFirebaseAuth} from '../firebase-client.js';
import {isGuestSession} from '../guest-session.js';
/** The live arena remains hidden until both session restoration and asset loading finish. */
export async function requireGameAccess(){
 const content=document.querySelector('#development-content');content.hidden=true;
 if(isGuestSession())return true;
 try{const {auth,sdk}=await getFirebaseAuth();return await new Promise(resolve=>{sdk.onAuthStateChanged(auth,user=>{if(!user){content.hidden=true;window.location.replace('../index.html');}resolve(Boolean(user));},()=>{window.location.replace('../index.html');resolve(false);});});}
 catch{window.location.replace('../index.html');return false;}
}
